277213.evaluate: The story begins on the pirate Zap's ship. His two members of his crew, Bonnie and Max, are tired and want to run away, but unfortunately, they have no money. Three children were being held captive on the ship overheard them. The eldest, Amanda, whose father was a pro treasure hunter, knows the whereabouts of a great treasure and offers them a deal. If they help them make a clean escape, they could take all the treasure they wanted. They agree, and the five of them barely escape and make it onto a small island where they meet Luffy and his crew. Unfortunately, they were pursued and Luffy and Amanda are captured and brought back to their boss, the head of the Bayan Pirates, who is also after the treasure. Luffy and his friends must fight the Bayan Pirates and find the treasure that Amanda's father left to the children. Amanda, who has always resented adventures and treasures, finally understands his feelings, as his father kept looking for adventures and treasures.
277213.seasonTitle: One Piece Special: Open Upon the Great Sea! A Father's Huge, HUGE Dream!

277215.title: One Piece Special: Protect! The Last Great Performance
277215.evaluate:
In the past years, former Marine Lieutenant Randolph and his troupe have performed plays aboard his ship. Randolph, who lost his family to pirates, wants to give courage to those who lost loved ones to pirates. 
Unfortunately, Randolph will have to retire soon and he is currently giving his final performances. Luffy and his friends came to see the play and somehow succeeded in participating in the play themselves. But from Randolph's past comes a vengeful subordinate with a diabolical plan who has finally become commander in order to capture Randolph. Luffy and his Nakama now must prove to the people that not all pirates are scum, and protect Randolph's final farewell performance from the bitter commander.
277215.seasonTitle: One Piece Special: Protect! The Last Great Performance

277216.title: One Piece: Adventure of Nebulandia
277216.evaluate: The story takes place in the New World, a "Seal Island of Capable Persons" that can seal the power of Devil Fruits. After arriving in the new world where navigation is very difficult, the strength of the Silver Fox Foxy Pirates has become stronger, leading a talented strategist and two other powerful newbies to make a comeback, and with the members of the Straw Hat Pirates came a mysterious battle...

277221.title: One Piece 3D: Straw Hat Chase
277221.evaluate: The straw hat that was still there last night has disappeared! Luffy once met his idol when he was a child, the big pirate red-haired Shanks. It was Shanks who gave him this straw hat and made an agreement with him to determine his life goals. For Luffy, The straw hat is a treasure that is more important than life, no matter what kind of danger it encounters, it will not be abandoned. Luffy frantically searched around and finally found a sea eagle holding his precious straw hat. At the same time, Chopper and Usopp encountered a shipwreck on their way to find the hat, and they rescued an old pirate. The pirate tells them an amazing story about the straw hat. What appeared in front of them was a naval base. Can the Straw Hat Pirates get their iconic straw hat back?!

277238.title: One Piece: Episode of East Blue - Luffy to 4-nin no Nakama no Daibouken
277238.evaluate: The words spoken by the pirate king Gold Roger just before his death make the world go wild, and the world plunges into the Great Pirate Era! There is a group of young pirates who are about to set sail on the Grand Line. Monkey D. Luffy, a rubber man. Roronoa Zoro aka “Pirate Hunter.” Usopp, a sniper. Sanji, a seafaring cook. And “Cat Burglar” Nami. They, the Straw Hats Group, all place a foot upon a barrel and make their vows before their next journey across the great ocean. Let's get back to the time when Luffy shouts “In order to be the King of the Pirates!”, a decade ago in the Windmill Village...
277238.seasonTitle: One Piece: Episode of East Blue - Luffy to 4-nin no Nakama no Daibouken

277240.title: One Piece: Episode of Skypiea
277240.evaluate: In the "Episode of" series, the special will be the first to address the Skypeia arc. More new partners will join the group as they continue their voyage.

277247.title: Planetarian: Snow Globe
277247.evaluate:
The PC game "planetarian" produced by KEY Corporation will celebrate its 15th anniversary in 2019. Beautiful and boundless starlight that will never dissipate... A sky full of stars awaits you. 
The new OVA will feature the prequel short story "Snow Globe," which debuted as part of a light novel volume that bundled with a limited-edition version of the original PC game.

277249.title: The Heike Story
277249.evaluate:
"The sound of the Gion Shōja bells echoes the impermanence of all things; the color of the sāla flowers reveals the truth that prosperity must decline".
At the end of the Heian period, the Heike clan was on the verge of peak prosperity in terms of power, military power, and financial strength.
Taira Shigemori, a man who can see the spirits, meets Biwa, a magical girl who can see the future and predict the fall of the Heike family.
A historical shift of Japan from aristocratic society to samurai society, indicating the start of 15 years turbulent period.

277251.title: Heaven Official's Blessing (JP ver.)
277251.evaluate: For you, I’ll become invincible! "Have you heard? The rubbish Heaven Official is having an affair with the ghost realm’s number one bigshot!" Eight hundred years ago, Xie Lian was the Crown Prince of the Xian Le kingdom; one who was beloved by his citizens and the darling of the world. Unsurprisingly, he ascended to the Heavens at a very young age. Now, eight hundred years later, Xie Lian ascends to the Heavens for the third time as the laughing stock of all three realms. On his first task as a god, he meets a mysterious demon who rules the ghosts and terrifies the Heavens……yet unbeknownst to Xie Lian, this demon king has been paying attention to him for a very, very long time.

277252.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Thai Dub)
277252.evaluate: Lonely thirty-seven-year-old Mikami Satoru is stuck in a dead-end job, unhappy with his mundane life, but after dying at the hands of a robber, he awakens to a fresh start in a fantasy realm...as a slime monster! As he acclimates to his goopy new existence, his exploits with the other monsters set off a chain of events that will change his new world forever!
277252.seasonTitle: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Thai Dub)

They begin to meet every Monday on the train, with the man serving as her bodyguard on the crowded commute while they chat. Let's enjoy the Mondays in Season 2!

Unbeknownst to him, however, Douki-chan secretly has feelings for him. As Douki-chan struggles to confess her feelings, her rivals, both the junior and senior, continue to vie for his affection.
Ganbare Douki-chan realistically depicts the texture of clothes, cute expressions, and exciting situations with plenty of temptation, featuring plenty of satisfying highlights.

Futuba despises his chuckle, his height, and his tendency to treat her like a young child. Futuba's diminutive stature and youthful appearance do not indicate that she is a kid, and just because she spends so much time with Harumi does not imply that she finds him to be a bothersome senpai. Maybe she does!

277265.title: SAKUGAN
277265.evaluate:
It comes to the distant future. Humans live side by side in "colonies" separated by rocks. Outside the colony, there is a dangerous undeveloped area called "Labyrinth".

Those who risk their lives to develop "Labyrinths" that marks undeveloped areas are called "markers". Memempu, a girl who hopes to be a marker one day, and Gagumber, a man who used to be a marker. Mismatched father and daughter now challenge the Labyrinth

277266.evaluate: Red was once a member of the Hero's Party, a powerful group that saved the world from the evil forces of the raging Demon Lord Taraxon. That is until one of his comrades kicked him out. Hoping to live an easy life on the frontier, Red's new goal is to open an apothecary. However, keeping the secret of his former life may not be as simple as he thinks. Especially when his past adventurer, the beautiful Lit, shows up and asks him to move in with him!

277271.title: The Faraway Paladin
277271.evaluate:
A lone human infant dwells in a city of the dead that has long since been destroyed and is removed from human civilization. Will is being nurtured by three undead: Blood, a brave skeletal warrior; Mary, a graceful mummified priestess; Gus, a gruff spirit sorcerer. The three shower the kid with affection and impart all of their knowledge to him.
Suddenly, Will begins to doubt his own identity. Will needs to discover the secrets of this dead man's land and learn the hidden history of the undead. He learns the compassion and love of the kind gods, as well as the prejudice and madness of the evil ones. This young guy starts the process of becoming a Paladin.
episodeTitles: The Boy in the City of the Dead

277274.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window
277274.evaluate: Kosuke Mikado, a shy bookstore clerk, has the ability to see ghosts and spirits. An exorcist whose supernatural powers are as strong as his social graces are weak, Rihito Hiyakawa seems to fear nothing, human or not. When this odd couple gets together to solve the bizarre cases that come their way, their work methods may not be entirely safe for work!
277274.seasonTitle: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window

277275.title: Takt Op. Destiny
277275.evaluate: The night when the black meteorite "Kuroya Meteorite" fell from the sky, everything changed silently. A weird creature created by the black meteorite, "D2", begins to invade the earth and mankind. D2 is attracted to the melody played by humans, which ultimately leads to the banning of "music". And how will the world change...

277277.title: Mieruko-chan
277277.evaluate: One day, Miko unexpectedly started to see strange grotesque that no one else could see. Her response is not to run away, not to confront them, but tend to ignore them completely! Will she be able to keep a straight face and continue her daily life surrounded by terrifying monsters?

277279.title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
277279.evaluate:
The best assassin on earth was the only one who had an idea about how to live as a tool for his employer. Reincarnated into a world of swords and magic by the grace of the Goddess, he has been offered the opportunity to do something different this time, but there are pitfalls...
He has to eliminate a super-powerful hero who will bring about the end of the world unless he is stopped. Now known as Lugh Tuatha Dé, the master assassin certainly has his hands full, particularly because of all the beautiful girls who constantly surround him. Lugh may have been an incomparable killer, but how will he fare against foes with powerful magic?
277279.seasonTitle: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat

The seemingly boring way of spending summer vacation changes completely with the arrival of a guest from the mainland, Ichiro Suzuki. Hotel rooftop. "Deji" is an Okinawan word that means "troublesome" or "a lot".

One random day, the radio announces that the whole school is about to be transported to an alternate world. In this fantasy world, everyone will have their own rank and skills.
Each class forms groups and waits to be transported, but Seiichi is left out and alone. As such, he is summoned to a completely different area and begins his journey alone.

Then Haru, who claims to be an alien, appears beside him, and Haru decides to teach Yuki how to fish. Natsuki is an irascible native with a hard-tongued mouth but a warm heart. Akira is a mysterious Indian who watches every move of the Enoshima people from a distance. The four meet, fish, and are on their way to find adventure on their small island...

277461.evaluate: The stage is in London. Lupin's goal is to secretly manipulate the treasure hidden by Raven, the mysterious organization of the British government - the clue is a painting. His opponents are Scotland Yard and MI6. The Zenigata Police Department also noticed Lupin's actions and appeared. Then, the detective who appeared in front of Lupin - his name is Sherlock Holmes! "Deduction Lupin" with many mysteries is now open!

277474.title: Kyoukai Senki
277474.evaluate:
Japan has lost its sovereignty as of 2061 AD. After being divided into four major trade factions and subjected to their rule, the Japanese people spend their days as oppressed citizens.
Following the deployment of AMAIM—a humanoid special mobile weapon, the nation rose to the top of the global stage.
Amou Shiiba is a young child who enjoys mechanics. One day he meets Gai, a self-regulating AI. Amou seizes the chance presented by Gai and joins the fight to retake Japan.

277477.title: Build Divide: Code Black
277477.evaluate: There are many rumours about the new Kyoto and its ruler. In this world, a person's value is based on their capability in the trading card game Build Divide, where winner will be granted any wish. To challenge the king, players engage in TCG fights known as Rebuild. Teruto Kurabe, a young man who swears to overthrow the monarch, and Sakura Banka, the enigmatic girl who serves as his mentor, join the Rebuild conflict together. A new conflict starts.

277482.title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S (Thai ver.)
277482.evaluate:
With Tooru continuing his quest to become the best maid and Kanna Kamui fully immersed in life as an elementary school student, there are no dull days in the Kobayashi family when mischief is a daily staple. A large-scale landslide occurs on the hill where Tohru and Tohru met for the first time. When none of the dragons they know claim responsibility, the perpetrators themselves descend from the sky. Llulu, who is a radical Chaos Dragon with immense power that rivals Tooru.

Tired of Tooru's engaging with humans, Ilulu resorts to the typical dragon way of resolving conflicts: mortal combat. Despite such behavior, she is intrigued by Kobayashi's ability to befriend dragons, and instead decides to observe why Kobayashi is so special. A quirky life with a dragon maid becomes more and more fun.
277482.seasonTitle: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S (Thai ver.)

277487.title: Drowning Sorrows in Raging Fire
277487.evaluate: In the current era, a small percentage of people called "Special Abilities" have skills and powers normal humans do not possess. An autonomous organization, the Deviant Control Office, keeps these Special Abilities in check. Though some wish to maintain this order and peace, some wish to take advantage of their abilities and obtain more power in this world.

277490.title: Cinderella Chef S2
277490.evaluate: Ye Jiayao is a young and talented cook who dreams of becoming a renowned chef one day. As luck would have it, she's magically transported back in time to Imperial China, and in the body of an extremely useless girl. Ye Jiayao is immediately kidnapped and held for ransom, but she manages to use her wits (and her sense of humor) to get whatever she wants.

277491.title: 中华民族英雄 第一季
277491.evaluate: 《中华民族英雄 第一季》是一部以中国古代历史人物为题材的纪录片，项目以真实历史资料为根基，以AI影视技术还原，展现从古代到近现代的对中国历史进程有突出贡献，被后人传诵的民族英雄的人生历程和壮烈事迹。

277492.title: My ACG Parents
277492.evaluate:
My ACG Parents
Tong Qi, who was instilled Otaku culture by her parents when she was a child, but tried hard to keep away from "Otaku", always regarded her deskmate Yang Wei, as her idol. She never thought that one day, she heard the word "BL culture" from the "idol". The laughter life of the two dimension and the third dimension is about to begin.

277503.title: Foodie Boy’s Classic of Mountains & Seas
277503.evaluate:
What is "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" actually talking about? A gourmet called "Bu Bai Chi" back in the days of "The Classic of Mountains and Seas", exploring the famous mountains and seas in the books and actually found that it is all so amazing! 
It turns out that the mermaids in Chinese fairy tales are not at all beautiful girls! The ancient people have already given employees the meat of "Changfu" birds to keep them working eternally! The Queen Mother of the West is not an elegant girl but an eccentric old lady! Yu the Great has combated the water goblins when he controlled the flood! 
All the most interesting stories of "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" are in the Foodie Boy’s Classic of Mountains & Seas!
277503.seasonTitle: Foodie Boy’s Classic of Mountains & Seas
episodeTitles: The Secret of Having Lots of Offspring
Getting Rich from Mountains and Seas

277504.title: Ancient Girl's-Frame
277504.evaluate:
At the end of the 21st century, the discovery of a new energy source called "DG energy" (short for "divine grace energy") has revolutionized Earth's economy and allowed humanity to colonize space. However, when the initial expedition reaches Pluto, they are attacked by a mysterious, giant life-form known as "Nergal."

The Earth Alliance Army fights back by creating an "AG Unit" using ancient robot weapons known as the "G's Frame" which were excavated from archaeological sites all around the world. Girls with special qualities known as "Ancient Girls" can pilot these robots against the Nergal. However, the first AG Unit suffers heavy casualties in the Jupiter Trojan campaign, and the pilot of Unit 04, Minamiya Reiu, goes missing-in-action...

Years later, Minamiya Reika, the younger sister of Reiu, enlists with the AG Unit to search for her sister and to protect the Earth from the Nergal. A story of friendship, ancient robot weapons, and battles to the death with the Nergal ensues.

277518.title: The Best Friend
277518.evaluate: The story mainly tells that from 2007 to 2008, a group of young girls with different personalities met because they entered the same university. Due to their different growth backgrounds, they gradually open their hearts and become good friends from not understanding each other.

277521.title: Strike the Blood
277521.evaluate: The Fourth Primogenitor, who is the world's strongest vampire that only exists in legends. Accompanied by twelve Kenjuu and spreading calamity, rumor says that this phantom vampire appeared in Japan finally. For the purpose of observation and obliteration, the government and Lion King organization decided to dispatch an attack mage known as a Sword Shaman. However, for some reason, the one chosen for the observation was an apprentice Sword Shaman girl, Himegari Yukina. Wielding the strongest anti-primogenitor spirit spear, Yukina arrived at Demon District, Itogami City. So what is the true identity of Akatsuki Kojou, the 4th Progenitor she meets!?

Jasmine meets red fox Keemun, samoyed Pu'er, and other partners one after another in this half-orc world, and starts her wonderful adventure!

277557.title: Raccoon Town in the Phone S2

The raccoon town in the cell phone is like a miniature human society, where there are various institutions and systems such as police stations, hospitals, entertainment venues, restaurants, air transport, public transport, etc., and of course, there is culture and festivals as well.

Legend has it that a demon slayer also roams the night, hunting down these bloodthirsty demons. For young Tanjirou, these rumors will soon to become his harsh reality...

Ever since the death of his father, Tanjirou has taken it upon himself to support his family. Although their lives may be hardened by tragedy, they've found happiness. But that ephemeral warmth is shattered one day when Tanjirou finds is family slaughtered and the lone survivor, his sister Nezuko, turned into a demon. To his surprise, however, Nezuko still shows signs of human emotion and thought... Thus begins Tanjirou's quest to fight demons and turn his sister human again.

277571.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc (ID Dub)
277571.evaluate:
A mysterious continuous disappearance on a certain train has caught the attention of the Demon Slayer Corps, and they have sent one of their best sword master, Kyoujurou Rengoku, to exterminate the truth. However, the plan to board the Mugen Train is delayed by a lesser demon who is terrorizing the mechanics and targeting a kind, elderly woman and her granddaughter. As the Flame Pillar, Kyoujurou Rengoku must eliminate the threat before boarding the train.

Tanjirou Kamado, Inosuke Hashibira, and Zenitsu Agatsuma enter the train prepared to fight to assist the Pillar. But their monstrous target already has a devious plan in store for them and the two hundred passengers: by delving deep into their consciousness, the demon intends to obliterate everyone in a stunning display of the power held by the most frightening villain, the Twelve Demon Moons...
277571.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc (ID Dub)

277582.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba (VN Dub)
277582.evaluate: Since ancient times, rumors have abounded of man-eating demons lurking in the woods. Because of this, the local townsfolk never venture outside at night. Legend has it that a demon slayer also roams the night, hunting down these bloodthirsty demons. For young Tanjirou, these rumors will soon to become his harsh reality...

277593.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2
277593.evaluate:
After parting from his former classmates, the protagonist Hajime Nagumo begins a new journey with the party he leads to obtain the magic of the gods.
On his journey, he encounters the imprisoned vampire Yue, the rabbit-eared man Shea, and the perverted dragon Tio, and his party grows. At the same time, the trials and difficulties faced increased.
He suffered betrayal, fell into a dungeon and came back from the dead... The adventure won't stop there. Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2 officially opens!

277594.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san Season 3
277594.evaluate: Nishikata and Takagi have a close sit next to each other in class. Takagi enjoys teasing Nishikata with embarrassing pranks and jokes. In response, Nishikata creates plans to avenge Takagi but he fails all the time especially when she identifies his weaknesses and capitalizes on them. However, Takagi loses the challenge sometimes, even though Nishikata still does not feel like he won. Could Nishikata find Takagi's real feeling?
episodeTitles: Grip Strength Guy; Sunburn; New Semester
Sensor; Checking Personal Belongings; Library Committee Member; Sunset
Fan; Magic Ball; Cat Rescue; Rain

277595.title: Requiem of the Rose King
277595.evaluate: The British Duke of York always wants to unseat King Henry VI and let himself become the king. His son, Richard Plantagenet, who possesses characteristics of both sexes is reviled by Richard’s mother, and this leads to his adverse reaction to being called a DEMON. However, Richard believes that by helping his father become the king he can attain salvation for himself. So, will Richard's actions instead drag his family down into darkness?
episodeTitles: I Am the Shadow, the Darkness Behind the Light

277596.title: In the Land of Leadale
277596.evaluate: The story begins in this Familiar Lands. After a horrific accident put her on life support, the last vestige of freedom Keina Kagami found that she was in the VRMMORPG World of Leadale. When she woke up in the body of her game avatar, though, Keina—now named Cayna—found that the worries of her old life appear to be a thing of the past, but somehow this new land didn't seem to be the same Leadale which she remembered...

277597.title: My Dress-Up Darling
277597.evaluate: Wakana Gojou is exceptionally skilled at making clothes for Hinaningyou but he has no friends in high school as a freshman. His finesse with the sewing machine is soon discovered by his beautiful classmate Marin Kitagawa, whose boldness and honesty Gojou both admires and envies. She is interested in cosplay as characters from erotic video games but cannot sew her own costumes, which leads her to seek Gojou's expertise. Thus, despite the polar opposites, the relationship between Gojou and Marin slowly blossoms through their aptitude in helping each other.
episodeTitles: Someone Who Lives in a World Completely Opposite of Mine
Let's Get Down and Do It?

277599.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt
277599.evaluate:
The prince of this weak kingdom has a dream: to sell his country and live a life of peace! As his achievements grew, he earned the respect and expectations of a larger population ....... This makes the dream even more difficult to achieve!
The fact that the prince doesn't realise that the biggest obstacle to this dream is his own talent cannot be ignored.
277599.seasonTitle: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt
episodeTitles: Hey, How About Selling the Country?
Wein Salema Arbalest on the Battlefield
Hey, How About a Political Marriage?

277601.title: AKEBI'S SAILOR UNIFORM
277601.evaluate: Akebi Komichi lives with her family far from the countryside. She's got the entrance to the prestigious Roubai Academy middle school for girls and what she wants now are only two things—wearing the school's sailor uniform and making a hundred friends!
episodeTitles: Have You Decided On a Club Yet?

277602.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
277602.evaluate: It's a world full of magic, the powers and future of a mage are predetermined at birth through so-called "Marks". An incredibly skilled sage with unsatisfied Marks decided to reincarnate thousands of years in the future, reborn as Mathias Hildesheimr with his desired mark. When Matthias turns 12, his unparalleled swordsmanship has ripples both inside and outside the academy. However, the ex-sages reveal signs of a dark force working in the shadows, and with humanity weakened more than ever, it's up to Matthias to thwart their evil plans.
277602.seasonTitle: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
episodeTitles: The Strongest Sage Heads to the Dungeon
The Strongest Sage Meets Iris the Dragon

277603.title: Salaryman’s Club
277603.evaluate: It's a Salaryman’s Club that is set in a badminton business group, depicting the two different aspects of daily life as a salaryman, as well as growth and conflicts as players. The anime follows Mikoto Shiratori, ace badminton player who suffers from trauma following a loss at the inter-high tournament. He becomes a salaryman at the Sunlight Beverage company and makes friends with Tatsuru Miyazumi, the best-performing player and salesman on the team. What will happen after their encounter...

277611.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom 2nd Season
277611.evaluate: How a realist hero rebuilt his kingdom tells the story of Kazuya Sōma. Before being transported, Kazuya was a student of humanities with knowledge of realism and Machiavellianism. During a ritual, he is summoned by the kingdom of Elfrieden. Now Kazuya will have to use his knowledge from his previous life to deal with the problems of the kingdom.
277611.seasonTitle: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom 2nd Season
episodeTitles: Amidonia Borrows the Might of the Tiger
An Oppressive Government is Fiercer Than a Tiger

277616.title: Slow Loop
277616.evaluate:
A young girl named Hiyori⁠ whose deceased father taught her the joys of fishing headed out to sea for some alone time, while she never thought that she would encounter another girl there.

After a while, this girl⁠—named Koharu⁠—and her end up fishing and cooking together, and they get to know each other a bit in the meantime. During their brief time together Koharu finds out that the reason Hiyori went out to sea that day was that she was hesitant about meeting her new step-family that same evening. But what a coincidence! Koharu is also meeting her new family tonight! "No. It can't be a coincidence..." It's a story about these two 'sisters' and their new life together!

277618.title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
277618.evaluate:
In a world of virtual reality, Kagami is one of the Nine Sages and has a high social status among magicians. One day, when he opened his eyes, he found himself in a completely different world. Now he has gone from being a majestic veteran to an innocent little girl.
If his true identity is revealed, the majestic image he has been building up is likely to be destroyed. To solve this problem, the excuse he came up with is...
277618.seasonTitle: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
episodeTitles: I'm... Vulnerable to this Kind of Thing

277622.title: RUSTED ARMORS -Dawn-
277622.evaluate: Due to the long war, the Muromachi shogunate gradually declined and the world entered the secret realm of mountains and seas in the Warring States Period, which advocated blood debt and blood. They work as mercenaries, galloping on the battlefield, and their name is "Saika Ikki". The person who inherited the name of the leader of the Saika Ikki is Magoichi, a young man who has drifted here from a foreign country. On the other hand, Saburo, who was the first to perceive the aggressive intentions of the European powers, was running around to protect Japan.

277624.title: Life With an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated Into a Total Fantasy Knockout
277624.evaluate: Suddenly, a curmudgeonly old man and his best friend are summoned to another world by a goddess! However, due to the goddess' mischief, the old man is transformed into a noble and beautiful girl? In order to get his body back, he needs to join his best friend to defeat the demon king!!! The journey to another world full of madness and romance begins!!!
277624.seasonTitle: Life With an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated Into a Total Fantasy Knockout
episodeTitles: An Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout And an Ordinary Guy
An Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated Into A Total Fantasy Knockout And The Peerless Beauty
An Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated Into A Total Fantasy Knockout And An Angry Elf

277627.title: ORIENT
277627.evaluate: Musashi and his companion Kojirou Kanemaki pledged to become samurai, create a league, and embark on demon-slaying missions five years ago. However, with demons now being exalted and worshipped, society has avoided and denigrated the samurai. Musashi conceals his swordsmanship while blending in with the town's orthodoxy because of fear that he may expose his dream. Despite striving and failing, Kojirou still sets off on a voyage with Musashi in the hopes of discovering his genuine sentiments. The pair plunges deeply into the mysterious realm of beast-slaying without knowing what their future holds.

277634.title: Futsal Boys!!!!!
277634.evaluate: In the world over a decade, after futsal has skyrocketed in global popularity, the franchise's story is set. Protagonist Haru Yamato watches the championship of the U-18 world cup and is inspired by a Japanese player whose name is Tokinari Tenōji. He joins the Koyo Academy High School's futsal team with the dream of becoming a player like Tenōji. There, he finds friends as well as their rivals.

277638.title: budget travel VS luxury travel S1
277638.evaluate: “Poor Rich Travelogue Season 1” is a documentary reality‑show created by Tomohiro Yamashita and produced by his team, with exclusive streaming on Bilibili. The program adopts a group‑based format: since there are countless ways to enjoy a trip around Japan depending on your budget, the cast is divided into a “low‑budget team” and a “spend‑as‑you‑please team.” The show itself explores the same travel routes in completely different styles, presenting the various challenges they encounter along the way through quirky, offbeat storytelling. The regular cast includes Tomohiro Yamashita, Liu Muzi, Ji Ze, and Fanqie Niang. “Poor Rich Travelogue Season 1” premiered on Bilibili every Friday at 7:00 PM starting January 19, 2018, and concluded on February 9, 2018.
277638.seasonTitle: budget travel VS luxury travel S1

277640.title: budget travel VS luxury travel S2
277640.evaluate: “Poor Rich Man’s Travelogue Season 2” is a documentary reality show created by Tomohiro Yamashita and produced by his team, with exclusive streaming on Bilibili. The program features a team-based format, and this new season takes the journey to a whole new level: one car, four people, traveling from Mount Fuji to Nagoya. Along the way, there are nonstop “poor vs. rich” showdowns, with daily meals and accommodations decided through challenges—win and it’s paradise, lose and it’s hell. The core cast includes Tomohiro Yamashita, Chinese Boy Super Gorilla, the zombie with twin pigtails, and Tsugi-zawa. “Poor Rich Man’s Travelogue Season 2” premiered on Bilibili every Friday at 7:00 PM starting April 25, 2019, and concluded on February 9, 2018.
277640.seasonTitle: budget travel VS luxury travel S2

277643.title: budget travel VS luxury travel S3
277643.evaluate: Season 3 of “The Poor-but-Luxurious Travelogue,” produced by Bilibili and co-produced by Mola Culture, with production by Tomohiro Yamashita, is back! In addition to the popular UP masters China Boy, Sangmei, Huashao Bei, and the Vegetarian Lion, this season also features some unexpected mystery guests. The new journey will take you from Nagoya to Kyoto, offering an even more extreme — yet still lavish — travel experience!
277643.seasonTitle: budget travel VS luxury travel S3

episodeTitles: I, A DIFFERENT KIND OF COLOR
I, WISH TO BE KNOWN TO THE WORLD

277652.title: LOVE of KILL
277652.evaluate:
Bounty hunter Chateau Dankworth is silent and stoic, and her target, Son Ryang-ha, who killed 18 high-class officials in a single night. To this day, his murders remain swift, efficient, and bloody. However, after Son Ryang-ha overpowers Chateau in their first encounter, he reveals his own intentions: he too is after her, aiming for her heart.
Son Ryang-ha's attempts to catch her eye are quite unique, to say the least. Son Ryang-ha offers gifts to her in the form of her current targets, tied up and battered, and will do anything he can to spend more time with this lady. Reluctantly, Chateau goes along with this act, and so begins the cat-and-mouse game of love between the two killers.

277653.title: Sasaki to Miyano
277653.evaluate: Yoshikazu Miyano is a timid high school student who likes to read boys-love comics. He gets himself into trouble one day. Fortunately, it is resolved by senior Shuumei Sasaki. Miyano has secretly looked up to him ever since that day. However, Miyano realises that Sasaki is more annoying than admirable. Surprisingly, Sasaki became addicted to boys-love after reading Miyano's boys-love manga. Could it possibly grow into something bettrer?

277656.title: Fly Me to the Moon (Thai Dub)
277656.evaluate: Nasa Yuzaki, a boy with a peculiar name,gets hit by a truck on the day of his high school entrance exams. He encounters and follows a beautiful girl who saves him, confessing his love for her at a bus stop. The girl, Tsukasa Tsukuyomi, agrees to become his girlfriend, but only if they are married first.
277656.seasonTitle: Fly Me to the Moon (Thai Dub)

At The End of The Day

277707.title: House of Five Leaves
277707.evaluate:
Masanosuke "Masa" Akitsu is a lost ronin in the tranquil Edo era of Japan. Masa is a superb swordsman, but his timid nature has earned him the title of "unreliable," and he is frequently fired without warning by his employers, which causes him to doubt his commitment as a samurai.

When Masa is at his lowest, Yaichi, a carefree man dressed in pink, approaches him and appears to employ him as his bodyguard on a whim. Masa is dragged into the group's illegal activities without realizing it since the job is not as benign as it first appears to be. Yaichi is the group's leader. Masa fights with his own morals as he grows more and more involved with the Five Leaves gang. But his curiosity drives him to investigate.

277709.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime S2 (Thai Dub)
277709.evaluate: With the help of Queen Ramiris, the children are now in stable condition and should lead normal lives, much to Rimuru’s relief. But all is not well… In fact, there are forces of humankind in this fantasy world that do not look kindly upon a slime-led nation of monsters. And now, insidious threats to Rimuru and the country of Tempest may be lurking around every corner!
277709.seasonTitle: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime S2 (Thai Dub)

277713.title: Gintama the Very Final
277713.evaluate: The story happened after Tendoshuu's invasion of the O-Edo Central Terminal. Foreseeing Utsuro's return, Gintoki Sakata begins surveying Earth's ley lines for traces of the other man's Altana. Later, the regrouped Shinsengumi and Yorozuya begin an attack on the occupied Central Terminal. To fulfill the wishes of their teacher, Shouyou Yoshida's former students unite and relive their pasts one final time in an attempt to save their futures. It is for the 15th anniversary of Gintama TV series.

277717.title: Attack On Titan The Final Season Part 2
277717.evaluate:
"Attack on Titan" tells the story of mysterious titans creature that appeared in this world inexplicably about a hundred years ago, and continued to brutally eat people. In the face of titans, tiny humans can hardly compete with them. In the end, human beings built three towering city walls with a width of 3 meters and a height of 50 meters. Human beings were protected within the walls to be safe, and no titans have been able to break through it for a hundred years. So people gradually got used to the life of being confined within the walls, and began to become numb, afraid of adventure and change. Until 845, Maria's outermost wall was pierced through the city wall by a 60m-high titan and a titan covered in armor. Countless titans poured into the wall. Eren, who witnessed the tragedy of his mother being swallowed by a titan, swears on this day to destroy all the titans.
The plot of this season mainly describes that Allen and his party will officially start war with the human beings in this country after discovering that there are not only titans but also another very developed country "Marley" outside the wall. After the titan's 13-year term expires, the story timeline will jump to five to six years. Marley's new warriors have already begun to be selected, and Eren on Parady Island has also, because of the power of the ancestor titan in his body, the world countries that are eyeing it will come, and the two sides will start an unprecedented war.
277717.seasonTitle: Attack On Titan The Final Season Part 2

277718.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc(VN Dub)
277718.evaluate:
Four months after the Mugen Train Incident, Kamado Tanjiro and Nezuko returned to the Butterfly House after completing their mission, and they met Tengen Uzui, who tried to forcibly take away Kanzaki Aoi. Tengen Uzui let Aoi go at Tanjiro's request, and then agreed to the request of Tanjiro, Gasai Zenitsu and Hashibira Inosuke, and let the three sneak into Yoshihara Entertainment District instead of Aoi, and split up to find his wives Suma, Makio and Hinatsuru who was missing because of the sneak investigation of the evil spirits. 

Under the investigation of the three people, it was found that the identity of Entertainment District's popular oiran was the land of the "Twelve Ghost Moons", Daki, but Zenitsu was captured by the Daki. After learning about the incident, Uzui felt guilty and asked Tanjiro and Inosuke to leave Entertainment District immediately. As Tanjirou prepared to leave and join Inosuke, he found the trail of the Daki and engages her. On the other hand, Inosuke, who couldn't wait for anyone, found a ghost hiding in the ground, so he got into the ground and found the imprisoned Zenitsu, Makio, and Suma, as well as the ghost guarding them. After rescuing them, Inosuke fought the Belt Demon with them, and the latter is also defeated by Uzui, who arrived later.

After the fight, Uzui, who was seriously injured, decided to retire; Ubuyashiki Kagaya, who learned the result of the battle, was overjoyed and believed that this generation would definitely defeat Kibutsuji Muzan. On the other hand, due to the killing of the string, Akaza and other members of the twelve ghost moons were summoned to the infinite city...
277718.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc(VN Dub)

277723.title: The Soul of Soldier Master
277723.evaluate:
The Soul of Soldier Master
When Li Shi was born, strange cosmic phenomena occurred and he became a vessel that held the soul fragment of the Master of Weapons. He was hunted by all the clans in the world because of it. Later, he decided to enter a clan to train and find the enemies who tried to kill him and his parents. He accidentally discovered Bai Xiang, a demon tribe formation master from the Hou Clan, who wanted to eat the various tribes of the Mountains and Seas. Ying Gou helped with the test of formation. A conspiracy was about to unfold in the city of Linhai.

277726.title: IMMORTALITY
277726.evaluate:
IMMORTALITY
Fang Han, a humble family slave, always held the belief that "I would rather be a beggar than a slave", traversing the world only by himself. With an unyielding stubbornness, he cracked the mystery of supernatural powers and forged his body into an immortal body. He worked hard to step into the fairyland, and eventually became the peak king.

277727.title: Dragon's Disciple
277727.evaluate:
Dragon's Disciple
The frail boy but with a strong sense of justice, under the guidance of Tang Zichen, a master of Chinese martial arts, embarks on the road of learning traditional martial arts, how to open up and surpass himself. He will experience the spirit of martial arts people who use martial arts to stop the fight and convince people with morality, and also inherit traditional martial arts and promote righteousness.

277729.title: The Indomitable
277729.evaluate:
The Indomitable
The dream of the young man "Qian Cong" is to be able to study at school and to become "the strongest commander of hunting guards ". This is a long and challenging road.

277731.title: SABIKUI BISCO(Thai Dub)
277731.evaluate:
A plague of wind blows across the dry sands of post-apocalyptic Japan. The cause of the world state of catastrophe is thought to be mushroom spores. Known as the "Man-Eating Mushroom", Biscochi is a wanted criminal archer who instantly grows mushrooms wherever his arrows go. However, he was actually a "mushroom protector", someone who spread the fungus to enrich the land and restore it to its original state.

Along with crab Akutagawa and young doctor Milo Nekoyanagi, Bisco ventures across the wastelands of Japan in search of the fabled "Sabikui" - a panacea said to devour all kinds of rust.

However, he was actually a "mushroom protector", someone who spread the fungus to enrich the land and restore it to its original state.

Along with crab Akutagawa and young doctor Milo Nekoyanagi, Bisco ventures across the wastelands of Japan in search of the fabled "Sabikui" - a panacea said to devour all kinds of rust.

277738.title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man(Thai Dub)
277738.evaluate:
In a world of virtual reality, Kagami is one of the Nine Sages and has a high social status among magicians. One day, when he opened his eyes, he found himself in a completely different world. Now he has gone from being a majestic veteran to an innocent little girl.
If his true identity is revealed, the majestic image he has been building up is likely to be destroyed. To solve this problem, the excuse he came up with is...

277745.title: Attack on Titan: No Regret (Thai Dub)
277745.evaluate:
This is a story when the young Levi struggles to survive in the capital's garbage dump, the Underground before becoming the famed captain of the Survey Corps. As the boss of his own criminal operation, Levi attempts to get by with meager earnings while aided by fellow criminals, Isabel Magnolia and Farlan Church. Due to the little hope for his future, Levi accepts a deal from the anti-expedition faction leader Nicholas Lobov, who promises the trio citizenship aboveground if they are able to successfully assassinate Erwin Smith, a squad leader of the Survey Corps.

As Levi and Erwin cross paths, Erwin acknowledges Levi's agility and skill and gives him the option to either become part of the expedition team, or be turned over to the Military Police Brigade, to atone for his crimes. Now closer to the man they are tasked to kill, the group plans to complete their mission and save themselves from a grim demise in the dim recesses of their past home. However, they are about to learn that the surface world is not as liberating as they had thought and that sometimes, freedom can come at a heavy price.

Attack on Titan: No Regret is based on the popular spin-off manga of the same name, Shingeki no Kyojin: Kuinaki Sentaku illustrates the encounter between two of this work's pivotal characters, as well as the events of the 23rd expedition beyond the walls.
277745.seasonTitle: Attack on Titan: No Regret (Thai Dub)

277746.title: Attack on Titan: Konnan (Thai Dub)
277746.evaluate: The 104th Training Corps was tasked with a horse trek into the forest. The purpose of the mission was to test how much alert they were able to maintain without a threat, but the mission seemed boring and could lead to infighting among the members. Especially one of the groups led by Marco Bott. Some want to stay true to the mission they've been given, while others would rather slack off and focus on more exciting activities. And then trouble came quietly, but most people were completely unprepared to deal with it.

277747.title: Attack on Titan: Ilse's Journal (Thai Dub)
277747.evaluate: During the 49th recon mission of the Survey Corps, Hange Zoë decided to capture a titan alive as a specimen for study. Commander Erwin Smith thought it was too dangerous and did not allow it, but when Hange found a titan in the nearby woodland, she went to find the titan on horseback without permission, and regardless of her own safety, she led the way and risked her life to the titan and many questions were asked. However, the titan, who seemed to be a strange creature, behaved unpredictably, and quickly turned around and entered the woods again, leading her to a specific place. In front of Hange is the legacy of former scout Ilse Langnar, a notebook full of handwriting. Although she is long dead, she provided a valuable piece of information that may even be a breakthrough in titan research.
277747.seasonTitle: Attack on Titan: Ilse's Journal (Thai Dub)

277748.title: Attack on Titan: The Sudden Visitor (Thai Dub)
277748.evaluate: Jean Kirschstein's desire to escape his boring family and his domineering mother at any cost became his ideal. Joining the Military Police Brigade after joining the army, and living and working in peace and contentment has become his ultimate goal. However, during his tenure in the 104th Training Corps, nothing developed according to Jean's thoughts, and he was full of resentment and unwillingness. After the game, he and Sasha and other teammates quarreled, and vowed to decide the winner in the next day's duel. At this moment, the drunken Commander Pixis suddenly appeared. He declared that he would act as the referee, and the content of the game was changed to a cooking showdown. In order to find the best ingredients, he and his mates went out to the wild, ready to hunt the wild boars that had harmed the village before, but Sasha and his party also followed. Sasha and the others were the first to encounter the wild boar, and the situation developed in an unpredictable direction...
277748.seasonTitle: Attack on Titan: The Sudden Visitor (Thai Dub)

277749.title: Attack on Titan: Lost Girls(Thai Dub)
277749.evaluate:
Attack on Titan: Lost Girls is consist of two parts originating from the novel. They are "Wall Sina, Goodbye" and "Lost in the Cruel World".

Wall Sina, Goodbye
Annie Leonhart has a job to do—and a resulting absence that must stay off her record at all costs. With no one else to turn to, she asks her comrade Hitch Dreyse to cover for her. She agrees but puts forward a single condition: Annie must solve the fruitless missing person case Hitch was assigned. The case revolves around Carly Stratmann, a university graduate and the daughter of wealthy businessman Elliot Stratmann. With only a single day to solve the case and the underground of the Stohess District crawling with thugs, Annie must put her all into finding this girl. Yet, every answer she uncovers only leads to further questions—how has the illegal drug coderoin found its way to Stohess, what is Elliot hiding, and where has Carly disappeared to?

Lost in the Cruel World
With worry for Eren Yeager gripping her heart, Mikasa Ackerman begins to remember. She remembers her conversations with Armin Arlert, her concern for her friends, and most painfully, the time she had almost lost everything. As fear takes control, she begins to experience an alternate version of her past—some things can be changed, but are there events so inescapable that she can't even prevent them in her dreams?
277749.seasonTitle: Attack on Titan: Lost Girls(Thai Dub)

277750.title: My Journey in an Alternate World
277750.evaluate:
My Journey in an Alternate World
Young Chen Xiaofan entered an alternate world after he accidentally swallowed a Chaos Orb, and became Young Master Chen, the prettiest man in Muyun City. Although he was adored by all the ladies in Muyun City, he was useless as he was not able to cultivate. With his mind set on going back to his original world, he gave up his stable lifestyle as a young master and went against his family’s wishes, determined to walk the path of a cultivator.
277750.seasonTitle: My Journey in an Alternate World
episodeTitles: Unexpected Journey to the Alternate World

277751.title: BUSTED! DARKLORD
277751.evaluate: In order to better survive in this world, the devil's son, Yu Renjie, was ordered to come to the "Zhengdao Academy", which only recruits prominent disciples from distinguished families, and successfully infiltrated. Yu Renjie's goal is very simple, that is, to obtain a "good witness" that can whitewash his demonic identity. But this is actually an extremely dangerous behavior, because once the true identity of the demon is revealed, it will be met with countless justice knights on the spot, and will be brutally killed by law enforcement on the spot. Although Yu Renjie was very aware of this and was extremely careful not to disclose information, on the day of registration, Yu Renjie was embarrassed to find that his personal information had been found out, and the infiltration operation declared a failure. In desperation, in order to hide his identity, Yu Renjie gritted his teeth and decided to wear women's clothes... So the dangerous and lively campus life is about to begin!

277757.title: Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryouiki Camelot 2 - Paladin; Agateram
277757.seasonTitle: Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryouiki Camelot 2 - Paladin; Agateram
episodeTitles: Fate/Grand Order - Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot - The Movie: Paladin; Agateram

277758.title: Attack On Titan The Final Season Part 2 (Thai ver.)
277758.evaluate:
"Attack on Titan" tells the story of mysterious titans creature that appeared in this world inexplicably about a hundred years ago, and continued to brutally eat people. In the face of titans, tiny humans can hardly compete with them. In the end, human beings built three towering city walls with a width of 3 meters and a height of 50 meters. Human beings were protected within the walls to be safe, and no titans have been able to break through it for a hundred years. So people gradually got used to the life of being confined within the walls, and began to become numb, afraid of adventure and change. Until 845, Maria's outermost wall was pierced through the city wall by a 60m-high titan and a titan covered in armor. Countless titans poured into the wall. Eren, who witnessed the tragedy of his mother being swallowed by a titan, swears on this day to destroy all the titans.
The plot of this season mainly describes that Allen and his party will officially start war with the human beings in this country after discovering that there are not only titans but also another very developed country "Marley" outside the wall. After the titan's 13-year term expires, the story timeline will jump to five to six years. Marley's new warriors have already begun to be selected, and Eren on Parady Island has also, because of the power of the ancestor titan in his body, the world countries that are eyeing it will come, and the two sides will start an unprecedented war.
277758.seasonTitle: Attack On Titan The Final Season Part 2 (Thai ver.)

277760.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (Thai Dub)
277760.evaluate: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn‘t care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadow stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.
277760.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (Thai Dub)

277764.title: Estab-Life: Great Escape
277764.evaluate: In the future world far away from the present, human civilization is highly developed, and as a result of the use of various resources, the population on the earth has reached a peak and then began to decline, and the number of human beings has decreased significantly. Artificial intelligence was developed in response to a growing crisis, to help protect species, manage ecosystems, and conduct a grand experiment in human diversity. Through genetic engineering, the “various races”, including ordinary people, beastfolk, and magical beings, were created to live in a diverse city named "CLUSTA". Each cluster developed a unique culture, befitting the people that lived there. Their lives, and the system, are continually maintained by the AI to ensure survival.

277765.title: LINK CLICK (Thai Dub)
277765.evaluate: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfill the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

277767.title: Aharen-san wa Hakarenai
277767.evaluate: The petite classmate Reina Aharen is quiet and cute, but it seems that her sense of distance is quite bad, and she is often inaccurate in measuring space and will have various problems. For a series of incomprehensible antics made by classmate Aharen, there is only one person trying to understand these, and he is Raidou. On this day, Raidou found that Aharen's eraser fell on the ground he leaned over to pick it up for her and handed it to her without thinking. Since then, the strange friendship between the two began to blossom. The "Sometimes Too Far" and "Sometimes Too Close" teen romance comedy kicks off!

277770.title: Ya Boy Kongming!
277770.evaluate:
Kong Ming, a great strategist during the Three Kingdoms period, achieved an extraordinary life through his lifelong struggles and countless battles. So when Kong Ming was dying, his only wish was to be reborn into a world full of peace and no wars... Then Kong Ming was sent directly to the modern city of Tokyo! Can a brilliant strategist like Kong Ming adapt to the modern wild beat?
Later, Kong Ming met Eiko Tsukimi in Shibuya, and Kongming, who was deeply attracted by her singing, became Eiko's military advisor. The overwhelming ingenuity of the genius military advisor led to the birth of a new legend in the music scene, and then...

277777.title: The King of Pigs
277777.evaluate:
Two friends meet up and recall their experiences as victims of school bullying when they receive a message from a friend from 20 years ago and mysterious serial killings begin to occur. 
Kyung Min lives with the trauma of the school violence he experienced twenty years ago and an unexpected case causes his suppressed emotions to reappear. Meanwhile, Detective Jong Suk receives a mysterious message sent from a friend from 20 years ago which reminds him of the school violence that took place back then. Chasing the mysterious message, he tries to put a stop to the murders...

277780.title: Heaven Official's Blessing (Thai Dub)
277780.evaluate: For you, I’ll become invincible! "Have you heard? The rubbish Heaven Official is having an affair with the ghost realm’s number one bigshot!" Eight hundred years ago, Xie Lian was the Crown Prince of the Xian Le kingdom; one who was beloved by his citizens and the darling of the world. Unsurprisingly, he ascended to the Heavens at a very young age. Now, eight hundred years later, Xie Lian ascends to the Heavens for the third time as the laughing stock of all three realms. On his first task as a god, he meets a mysterious demon who rules the ghosts and terrifies the Heavens……yet unbeknownst to Xie Lian, this demon king has been paying attention to him for a very, very long time.

277781.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn As A Typical Nobody
277781.evaluate:
As the most powerful Demon Lord of all time, although Varvatos was admired, he was too powerful to be approached, so he always felt alone and decided to reincarnate as an 'ordinary' villager, Ard, in an attempt to start a new life.
No matter how much he avoids being an extraordinary presence, Ard cannot hide the fact that his power is far beyond normal people. His life is filled with people who loathe him, want to murder him, and want him to dominate the world.
Will the Demon Lord be able to live a peaceful and ordinary life?
A schoolyard hero fantasy with a twist is about to begin!
277781.seasonTitle: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn As A Typical Nobody

277782.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World
277782.evaluate: This is a heavy gamer. One day, he played video games as always, and he fell asleep in a daze... When he woke up, the changes in the surrounding environment made him pale, because he found himself in the game world, and what was even more unbelievable was that he turned into a skeleton! Although equipped with the powerful weapons and armor in the game, the appearance is still the terrifying skeleton image, and Arc must find a foothold for himself in this novel land. Then he met a beautiful elven warrior who broke his small desire to live a peaceful life and set him on a journey full of conflict and adventure...
episodeTitles: The Wandering Traveler is on a Journey to Make the World Better
First Job, A Girl's Request and Creeping Shadow
The Gallant Elf is in Action to Save Her Brethren

277783.title: Heroines Run The Show
277783.evaluate: This story mainly tells about Hiyori Suzumi, who continued to pursue track and field sports without giving up after leaving her hometown. Hiyori studied at Sakuraoka High School in Tokyo, juggling her studies and athletics, while looking for part-time jobs to meet her expenses. In the process of looking for a part-time job, Hiyori met the idol group LIPxLIP and became the apprentice manager of its members Yūjirō Someya and Aizo Shibasaki. In this way, Hiyori began to take care of school classes, extracurricular activities, part-time jobs, and the idol group LIPxLIP performing on stage at the same time, swaying the sweat called "youth".

277784.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2
277784.evaluate:
Naofumi Iwatani, a university student, is summoned to the other world as one of the Four Holy Bravehearts, the "Brave of the Shield".
Despite being persecuted for countless indiscretions, he struggled with his companions to defend people from the "wave" of disasters that threatened the world.
	However, strange happenings, such as the bat familiars and the Four Cardinal Heroes, cause the queen to doubt if the Spirit Tortoise has been reborn. The calm started to gradually be disrupted.
	What can be done to defeat this demon that has brought tremendous disaster? How to track the person who illegally awakened the spirit tortoise? Naofumi Iwatani's journey will never end！
277784.seasonTitle: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2

277785.title: RPG Real Estate
277785.evaluate: It has been 15 years since the Demon King was defeated and the world returned to peace, and the story of this work unfolds here. The heroine is Kotone, who has just graduated from school and successfully became a magician. To find a new residence, Kotone goes to RPG Real Estate, which belongs to the kingdom, to inquire about housing. Afterwards, RPG Real Estate also became Kotone's actual working place, where together with the lively demihuman Fa, the calm priest Rufuria, and the brave warrior Rakira, they helped the various clients consulted earlier to find a satisfactory one. new home. From this, the fantasy story of another world begins!
episodeTitles: Welcome to RPG Real Estate! Looking for a Place to Live for the First Time Ever!
Problematic Properties! First Business Trip to the Demon King's Castle!
They're Here! Dragons, Ghosts, and Incredible Magi Powers!?

277786.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Collision
277786.evaluate: The story takes place in Space Age Calendar 797 (Imperial Calendar 488). Both the Galactic Empire and the Alliance of Free Planets have experienced civil wars severe enough to shake the nation. In this war, Reinhard established his dominance in the empire by eliminating the nobles of the enemy country, but he also paid a heavy price, that is, he lost an irreplaceable friend. On the other hand, although a domestic coup was successfully quelled by Yang, an unprecedented danger is quietly approaching him. The next year, the Empire and the Alliance went to war again, these two geniuses met on the battlefield and sparked...
277786.seasonTitle: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Collision

277787.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
277787.evaluate:
Leon, an office worker, gets reincarnated into a dating sim game world where women take the dominant position. Moreover, men are viewed as stepping stones, except for a group of charming men led by the crown prince.
As for Leon, he has a special weapon: he can recall every detail of his previous experience in the original world, where he was forced to finish the whole game.
Initially intending to live the mundane life of a roadie in the countryside, Leon uses his understanding of the game to inadvertently join the fight against hordes of women and handsome men.
277787.seasonTitle: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
episodeTitles: Hi gorgeous, wanna have tea with me?

277790.title: Miss Shachiku and the Little Baby Ghost.
277790.evaluate:
A little ghost girl gets worried when Ms. Fushihara, a corporate slave, is working till midnight and tries to make her go home. While saying "Leave now~," the ghost girl helps and brings her refreshments, healing Ms. Fushihara's heart with her preciousness. Be healed by the heartwarming daily life of the cute little ghost and the corporate slave Ms. Fushihara.

The ghost wants Miss Fushihara to get off work quickly for her health, and Miss Fushihara doesn't want to get off work because the ghost is too cute. This is a healing and lovely touching story weaved by such two people(?).
277790.seasonTitle: Miss Shachiku and the Little Baby Ghost.

277791.title: The Demon Girl Next Door S2
277791.seasonTitle: The Demon Girl Next Door S2
episodeTitles: Confrontation Again! A New Style of Magical Girl!
Ruins search! Imperfect Mikan and Excited Demon
Dark witch again! Hot water from hell!

277792.title: Healer Girl
277792.evaluate:
Third Medicine, Healing, or "Sound Medicine", which heals diseases and scars by singing. Therefore, people who heal others by singing are called "healers".
Three trainee healers working at Karasumaru Sound Therapy Center. An energetic atmosphere maker, Kana Fujii. A slightly stronger eldest, Reimi Itsushiro. A steady and reliable big sister, Hibiki Morishima. After school, the three freshmen of high school are training to become independent healers at the Karasumaru Treatment Center! Returnee Yanagi Sonia, who holds a C-level healer certificate, also joined the group. The girls are marching toward their dreams, and they will sing the song of healing today!
episodeTitles: Can I Take Pictures or Videos?

277793.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It r=1-sinθ
277793.evaluate: In the Okinawa Hejuku, on the bridge that reached the highest atmospheric value due to the cloud gap light of the rising sun, Yukimura and Himuro kissed with the highest theoretical value, but since the amount of saliva collected was not enough, it was decided to measure again. In order to visit the saliva testing experts, the group went to the School of Life Sciences of the Ministry of Science and Technology. In front of them appeared Suiu, a gorgeous woman dressed as an oiran and dressed in white, and her lover Chris. Yukimura invites Suiu and the two to help them complete the "experiment to prove their love", but because of this, they see the overwhelming aura of Suiu's love...
277793.seasonTitle: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It r=1-sinθ
episodeTitles: Proof 1: Science-types Fell in Love, So They Tried Comparing With Couples
Proof 2: Science-types Fell In Love, So They Tried Finding a New Theory.
Proof 3: Science-types Fell In Love, So They Tried Taking a Nap.

277794.title: ONIPAN!
episodeTitles: Oni Appears In The Shopping Arcade

277795.title: Kingdom Season 4
277795.evaluate: One of the largest battles in history against the allied forces left a gaping hole in the Qin state and China as a whole. Ying Zheng tells Prince Cheng Jiao about his ambition to become the dominant ruler of a united China.

277796.title: SPY x FAMILY
277796.evaluate:
Corrupt politicians, frenzied nationalists, and other warmongering forces constantly jeopardize the thin veneer of peace between neighboring countries Ostania and Westalis. In spite of their plots, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" fulfills dangerous missions one after another in the hope that no child will have to experience the horrors of war.

In the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint, Twilight dons the alias of "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist. However, his true intention is to gather intelligence on prominent politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears rarely in public at his son's school: the prestigious Eden Academy. Enlisting the help of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar to act as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter, Loid enacts his master plan. He will enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where Loid hopes she will excel and give him the opportunity to meet Donovan without arousing suspicion.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his talents has trouble playing the figure of a loving father and husband. And just like Loid is hiding his true identity, Yor—who is an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to disclose their own secrets either. Although this picture-perfect family is founded on deception, the Forgers gradually come to understand that the love they share for one another trumps all else.

277797.title: KAGUYA-SAMA LOVE IS WAR ーUltra Romanticー
277797.evaluate:
Falling in love can turn geniuses into idiots! 
At the elite school where the geniuses gather, Kaguya-sama, the vice president of the student council, and Shirogane Miyuki, the president, are recognized as a perfect match for each other. They seem to be on the verge of starting a relationship, but because of their strong self-esteem, neither of them has confessed!  In the battle of “how to make each other confess their love first”, they use all their wits ......
How will their relationship situation change by the last day of the Cultural Festival? A super romantic comedy will start again!
277797.seasonTitle: KAGUYA-SAMA LOVE IS WAR ーUltra Romanticー
episodeTitles: Miko Iino Wants to Be Soothed/Kaguya-sama Doesn't Realize/Chika Fujiwara Wants to Battle
Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Mediate/Kaguya Wants To Take Him Out/Kaguya Wants to Interrupt
Nagisa Kashiwagi Wants to Execute Him/Maki Shijo Wants to Do Something/Miyuki Shirogane Wants to Be

277798.title: Date A Live IV
277798.evaluate: Shidou encounters a starving woman lying on the street and ends up helping her. The woman introduces herself as Nia Honjou—a popular comic artist working under a pen name. However, Nia reveals that she is also a Spirit and is aware of Shidou's secret operation...
episodeTitles: Don't Panic. This Is A Spirit's Trap

277799.title: The Dawn of the Witch
277799.evaluate:
The war that raged between the Church and the Witches for five centuries finally ended in peace but the embers of that age-old conflict still smolder.

A struggling student named Sable has no memories of his time before being enrolled. At the command of Headmaster Albus, he left the Kingdom to travel to the southern reaches of the continent. Accompanying him are a party of individuals strong in both ability and personality; there's the one known as the Witch of the Dawn, Roux Cristasse, who seeks the forbidden knowledge of primeval magic in the 'Grimoire of Zero', the genius girl Holtz, as well as the school's sole beast, Kudd.

Just what truth shall they uncover in their journey to the south...?
episodeTitles: The Underachiever and The Witch of the scepter

277801.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Season3
277801.evaluate:
Towards a world where everyone can read!
Maine, who possesses powerful magic and incredible knowledge is secretly targeted by the nobles who find useful value in her, and the nobles who resent her. With more and more things for Maine to protect, she has to face claws and dangers...
What will happen to Maine?!

277802.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
277802.evaluate: Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend: cute, fun to be around, sweet when she wants to be... but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right circumstances. And her boyfriend Izumi loves to be around when that happens!

277804.title: Love after World Domination
277804.evaluate: Fudou, also known as "Red Gelato", is the leader of the hero squadron "Gelato 5", whose mission is to bring about world peace. On the other hand, Desumi is the minion leader of "Gecko", a villainous organization seeking world domination. However, despite these differences, their relationship is not quite what it seems. When they are not making a show of being at each other's threats, Desumi and Fudou continue to pursue a forbidden love.

277807.title: I'm Quitting Heroing
277807.evaluate:
Leo saved the world from the attacks of the Demon King's army, but this power was also a threat to the people who ushered in a world of peace. He was eventually banished, losing his status, honour and home. The wandering hero chose to join the army of the Demon King who had just experienced defeat.
Leo concealed his identity and use his abilities to solve the financial problems, assisting king to reorganise the army. Suddenly, the appearance of Echidna unleashes a new and unexpected story for Leo..
episodeTitles: Next Gig At the Demon Queen's Castle
Do Work That Makes It Easier For you Tomorrow
A Little Effort Can Increase Work Efficiency

277808.title: DEAIMON
277808.evaluate: When his father is hospitalised, Nagomu Irino returns to his Kyoto home for the first time in ten years. Nagomu decides to take over the Ryokushou family's Japanese sweet shop, but there is an alternate heir in the shop. As they spend time together, the two get to know each other...

277809.title: Love All Play
277809.evaluate:
Ryou Mizushima has always had a great passion for badminton. After joining a badminton club in junior high school, Mizushima continued to improve himself with this effort, although he did not have the right coach to guide him.
Finally, Ebihara, the high school badminton coach, made an offer to him. However, Mizushima's indecisiveness made him hesitant to enter such a prestigious school. With a strong push from his sister Rika, he decided to go to Yokohama Minato. Will Mizushima keep winning in the high school league in the future under the guidance of a good coach?

277810.title: BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls’ Story-
277810.evaluate:
Nafrece, in a particular nation in Europe.
Eve, who has a natural talent for the game, plays golf every day to support herself. One day, she met Aoi Amawashi, the elite golfer and daughter of a conglomerate, in a fatal encounter. Two brilliant people who reside in totally separate worlds. Only one bullet each into the heart. Aoi, the "innocent tyrant," who is carefree and only enjoys golf, and Eve of the "Rainbow Bullet," the bullet with a rainbow of colors. The two are drawn to one another, have an impact on one another, and alter one another. The narrative of a golf girl created by the fusion of abilities.
The first original animated television series in the world featuring a female golfer premieres!
"Spread your wings and fly to the world!"

277811.title: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
277811.evaluate: The Lost Ones are wanderers from a faraway world known as "Japan" who have brought disaster and misfortune into the present day. The responsibility to destroy them, therefore, belongs to Menou, the young executioner. However, Akari appears to hinder Menou's murderous progress. An amazing journey begins when Menou sets out to find a way to defeat the immortals ......
277811.seasonTitle: The Executioner and Her Way of Life

ALVIN WHO IS TRYING TO BE AN ADVENTURER IN

ALVIN WANTED TO COLLECT DETOXIFYING HERBS  WITH THE HEALER KARLA
ALVIN, WHO CONTINUES TO STRIVE TO BECOME A MONSTER-HUNTING ADVENTURER, MAY HAVE A GREAT AMBITION.

277814.title: In the Heart of Kunoichi Tsubaki
277814.evaluate:
Akane Clan is an all-girls institution that focuses on training young martial artists in isolation. There is an unbreakable rule that "men are forbidden to associate with them because they are dangerous beings".

Kunoichi Tsubaki, as captain, is an excellent trainee. With a great future ahead of her, she begins to experience a strange feeling that the mere mention of boys is...
