episodeTitles:
Talent and Effort
&
The Escape Plan and Tsubaki Nee-sama

THE BUDDY SHOWDOWN
&
MALE DEMON SHOWS UP

277815.title: A Couple of Cuckoos
277815.evaluate:
With the exception of Nagi, a solemn and shy young man who only cares about his studies, the members of the Umino family are all quite similar: they are all extremely active and enthusiastic. Like his younger sister Sachi, who is a reflection of her outgoing parents, he is the exact antithesis of that person. Therefore, it shouldn't be shocking that Nagi was switched with another child at birth.
Erika Amano, a young social media sensation, is encountered by Nagi as he travels to see his real parents. He finds out about Erika's forced marriage while spending the day with her. Later on that day, Nagi finds out that Erika's fiancé is actually him, thus they can be recognised as members of each other's families. Nagi's biological father sets up for the engaged couple to begin living together in an effort to strengthen their love! No matter what their parents do, Nagi won't agree to marry Erika. That's because he already has Hiro Segawa in his sights, who is both attractive and intelligent.

277817.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War S2 OVA
277817.evaluate:
The leading representatives of the student body at the prestigious Shuchiin Academy are Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya. Miyuki, president of the student council, is regarded as the best student in the country and is well-liked by both mentors and peers. Vice president Kaguya, the oldest child of the affluent Shinomiya family, outperforms him in every sphere of endeavour. Their reputation as the ideal pair makes them the envy of the whole student body.
While having previously grown fond of each other,  both of them are hesitant to express their feelings. The first to admit defeat will be despised and seen as less than. Miyuki and Kaguya are equally motivated to prevail on the battlefield of love since their pride and dignity are on the line.
277817.seasonTitle: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War S2 OVA

277818.title: Love Class
277818.evaluate: Depicts a youth drama about a first love that is full of excitement through the protagonist, who learns the meaning of family and community.

277819.title: Shine On! Bakumatsu Bad Boys
277819.evaluate: When the samurai took charge of Japan, an unidentified attacker destroyed the Shinsengumi, a samurai group, and left only one survivor. As doubles for the Shinsengumi, seven convicts are picked. A doubles mythology begins to play out to safeguard Kyoto's security.
episodeTitles: A Scheme! The Shinsengumi Made of Criminals
Shine on! The Keepsake Japanese Sword
Disguise! Sneaking in the Red-Light District

277820.title: Rift
277820.evaluate: The Rift between the present world and the alternative world caused by the instability of energy is the only passage to the present world for the monsters in the alternative world. In order to block the invasion of monsters, in the present world, a group of people with special power bravely went into the Rift to defend the world.

277822.title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside(Thai Dub)
277822.evaluate:
A 30-year-old office worker named Liu Yinuo was unintentionally called into the virtual world.
Excellent gamer Liu Yinuo started teaching Tian Enya, an 18-year-old girl who is the gaming world's saviour, how to play games in order to return to reality.
The two ladies eventually achieved their objective in the virtual world with the assistance of other partners, and they left the virtual world with a more upbeat outlook on life.
277822.seasonTitle: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside(Thai Dub)

277823.title: Word of Honor
277823.evaluate: The four teenagers left the academy to find the truth and solve the mystery of their births. They experience all kinds of difficulties and dangers and finally grow into men of honor.
episodeTitles: Rain-Soaking White Clothes in Late Night
Traveling Miles for Study and Escaping Attacks from Foes

277824.title: You're A Genius!
277824.evaluate: There are Western Continent and Eastern Continent in an alternative world. The northern part of the Western Continent is inhabited by mysterious Snow Mountain tribes, while the southern part is occupied by the Great Qin Empire. The Magic is the source of energy in the world. By the power of the Magic, the Great Qin Empire became powerful. Then a young boy with special power from the north began a journey of the practice against the Magic in the Southern Continent.

277854.title: The Last Summoner
277854.evaluate: This is a fiction world of Summoners. The person who can summon the spirits of all objects is called the Summoner. Since ancient times, the legend of the Summoners has been deeply embedded in the corner of history. In the new era, there are five Summoners who awaken to fight against the mysterious power. Five friends fight shoulder to shoulder to discover the truth in the Summoner world.

277855.title: Face on Lie
277855.evaluate: The ugly girl, Han Yuxi starts a new bright life after the plastic surgery. So she will have a happy life? Or hence, her life will be conspiratorially controlled...

277882.title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon R: Make Up! Sailor Senshi
277882.seasonTitle: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon R: Make Up! Sailor Senshi

277894.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World (Thai Dub)
277894.evaluate: This is a heavy gamer. One day, he played video games as always, and he fell asleep in a daze... When he woke up, the changes in the surrounding environment made him pale, because he found himself in the game world, and what was even more unbelievable was that he turned into a skeleton! Although equipped with the powerful weapons and armor in the game, the appearance is still the terrifying skeleton image, and Arc must find a foothold for himself in this novel land. Then he met a beautiful elven warrior who broke his small desire to live a peaceful life and set him on a journey full of conflict and adventure...
277894.seasonTitle: Skeleton Knight in Another World (Thai Dub)

277895.title: KAGUYA-SAMA LOVE IS WAR ーUltra Romanticー (Thai Dub)
277895.evaluate:
Falling in love can turn geniuses into idiots!
At the elite school where the geniuses gather, Kaguya-sama, the vice president of the student council, and Shirogane Miyuki, the president, are recognized as a perfect match for each other. They seem to be on the verge of starting a relationship, but because of their strong self-esteem, neither of them has confessed! In the battle of “how to make each other confess their love first”, they use all their wits ......
How will their relationship situation change by the last day of the Cultural Festival? A super romantic comedy will start again!
277895.seasonTitle: KAGUYA-SAMA LOVE IS WAR ーUltra Romanticー (Thai Dub)

277896.title: SPY x FAMILY (Thai Dub)
277896.evaluate: To make the operation a success, Twilight, also known as "Lloyd Forger", immediately recruits humble orphan Anya to play the role of her six-year-old daughter and future Eden Academy student. As a wife, he meets Yor Briar, an absent-minded office worker who needs a pretend partner to impress her friends. Anya is no ordinary girl on the surface; she's a psychic, the product of a secret experiment that allows her to read minds. Even though she has discovered their true identities, Anya is glad her new parents are cool agents!

277900.title: Dancing through the Millennia
277900.evaluate: "Dancing Through the Millennia" is a Chinese dance cultural variety show produced by bilibili and Henan Provincial TV. The show intends to bring the essence of China's 5,000-year history to life in front of audiences through the art of dance. The show breaks tradition as it makes the loss of the Twelve Divine Dances manuscript the basis of its story. Appointing five leading dancers, Qiao Zhenyu, Zhang Xiaolong, Hu Yang, Hua Xiaoyi and Xu Minghao (The8), it assigns then to recommend performances to restore the manuscript. Five dancers, also the five referees, will time travel to explore the most representative dances throughout history, role-playing their way through a series of plots set against the four dynasties.

277901.title: Let Me Check the Walkthrough First
277901.evaluate: A 30-year-old office worker named Liu Yinuo was unintentionally called into the virtual world. Excellent gamer Liu Yinuo started teaching Tian Enya, an 18-year-old girl who is the gaming world's saviour, how to play games in order to return to reality. The two ladies eventually achieved their objective in the virtual world with the assistance of other partners, and they left the virtual world with a more upbeat outlook on life.
277901.seasonTitle: Let Me Check the Walkthrough First

277902.title: Summer refuge
277902.evaluate: Summer Refuge is an intergenerational observation reality show produced by Bilibili. The program, in cooperation with the China Aging Association affiliated to the State Council, invited three experienced elders who living alone in Shanghai to start a 21 day intergenerational living experience with some Shanghai floating youth who have a unique attitude towards life. By truly recording the lives of the elderly and young people under the same roof, the program allows the two generations to approach and understand each other's world, so as to explore a new way of life in the future, and create a "home" with no blood relationship but family affection in the city.

277903.title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles (Thai Dub)
277903.evaluate: Rio is a cold-hearted orphan who resides in the slums. At the young age of 7, he discovers that he is the reincarnation of Amakawa Haruto, a tragically deceased Japanese university student. Rio discovers he has extraordinarily powerful magical skills while still suffering from this unexpected realisation, and he utilises his new abilities to solve the kidnapping case of a little girl. His kind act is recognised, and as payment, he is accepted into... a renowned academy for noble children?

277904.title: My Dress-Up Darling (Thai Dub)
277904.evaluate: Despite being a shy high school student without friends, Wakana Gojou is an extraordinarily talented dressmaker. His lovely classmate Marin Kitagawa quickly learns of his sewing prowess, and Gojou is both envious of her courage and honesty as well as his sewing skill. She enjoys dressing up as pornographic video game characters but is unable to sew her own outfits, so she seeks Gojou's help. Because of their ability to support one another, despite being polar opposites, their friendship progressively develops.

277905.title: Informal Talks S7
277905.evaluate: Informal Talks is a Chinese talk show co-produced by bilibili and Hubei Television. Every episode has 11 young men and women express their opinions on the core issues that young people are concerned about, and begins with a Culture Discussion, followed by debates related to the discussion topic. The tone of the show can range from serious to emotional to humorous. Break down our perceptions and discover new worlds!

277907.title: Ranking of Kings
277907.evaluate:
The youthful Prince Bojji, who is deaf and mute, is despised by the populace of the kingdom. They mock his alleged folly, calling him "The Useless Prince."
Bojji isn't very powerful physically, but he's definitely not a coward. Instead of traumatising him, a fortuitous meeting with a shadow monster leads him to assume that he has found a friend among others who only prefer to focus on his flaws. He begins meeting with Kage, the shadow, frequently to the point that even the usually hostile animal starts to like him.
The prince's quest to overcome his anxieties and doubts is beginning to take shape thanks to the unexpected connection that Kage and Bojji have developed. Bojji decides to achieve his goal of becoming the finest monarch he can be despite the ongoing mockery he endures.

277912.title: Bleach Movie 2: The DiamondDust Rebellion - Mou Hitotsu no Hyourinmaru
277912.seasonTitle: Bleach Movie 2: The DiamondDust Rebellion - Mou Hitotsu no Hyourinmaru

277913.seasonTitle: Bleach Movie 3: Fade to Black - Kimi no Na wo Yobu

277917.evaluate: The tale of Ichigo Momomiya, a young girl who uses the Iriomote leopard cat's transformation power to change into Mew Ichigo (Strawberry) in order to save Earth from the parasitic Chimera Anima invaders.
episodeTitles: What's Going on!? Be a Champion of Justice from Today on!
Plundered lips!? Here Comes the Mew Bu-Ling!

277918.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?
277918.evaluate:
Ayumu Tanaka and Urushi Yaotome are both members of the school chess club, Ayumu is a freshman in high school and Urushi is her senior.
In a game of chess, Urushi beats Ayumu, and Urushi is determined to get Ayumu to admit that she likes him, but Ayumu keeps a poker face about it...
277918.seasonTitle: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?
episodeTitles: Because I Want to Make You Happy
Because I Want to Have a First Date with You

277919.title: Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation
277919.evaluate: The plot centres on five girls known as the "Pentagrams," who aspire to become "true ladies worthy of the name". They often learn the arts of magic and etiquette while cultivating their overall culture in Ashram boarding school. The five pupils in question, Arsnotoria, Mell, Little Alberta, Picatrix, and Abramelin, attend lessons together, engage inactivities, and even drink tea after class in a secret chamber. The story is unfolding...
277919.seasonTitle: Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation

277920.title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth
277920.evaluate: In Mask of Truth, chaos has overtaken the nation when a cunning commander forcibly assumed control of the ancient Yamato Empire. The only opponents in his path are a pair of well-known figures who must unite many kingdoms and take on the formidable Imperial army.
episodeTitles: In the Company of the Iron Fan

277921.title: Extreme Hearts
277921.evaluate: Sports enthusiasts of all ages like the discipline of hypersport in particular. Players can employ support items and outfit themselves with particular equipment to practise it. Hiyori Hayama as a school idol has never tried the sport, but his meeting with Saki Kodaka and Sumika Maehara is likely to change his life completely...

277922.title: The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting
277922.evaluate:
Kirishima Tooru is such an evil 'Yakuza' that he has earned the nickname 'The Demon of Sakuragi'. In order to control him, the boss suddenly gives him a new task - to look after his daughter!".
The heartwarming comedy of the young boss and the team leader's only daughter - A brand new daily routine for the two begins.
episodeTitles: Episode 1: The Mob Boss's Daughter and Her Babysitter

277923.title: Black Summoner
277923.evaluate:
Kelvin discovers that during his most recent transmigration, when he awoke in a strange new location with no memory of his previous existence, he had actually traded those precise memories for new skills. With the goddess who carried him over as his first follower, he is about to enter a brand-new realm as a Summoner. After starting his new life as an adventurer, Kelvin realises that he has a hidden propensity for fighting.
He relishes the struggle against each daunting adversary, from the Black Knight of the Ancient Castle of Evil Spirits to the monster hidden inside the Hidden Cave of the Sage. Come along with this OP adventurer as he and his companions etch their names into the pages of history in this thrilling epic drama!
episodeTitles: The Slave Girl and A Secret Agreement with the Guild

277924.title: ORIENT 2
277924.evaluate: Musashi and his companion Kojirou Kanemaki pledged to become samurai, create a league, and embark on demon-slaying missions five years ago. However, with demons now being exalted and worshipped, society has avoided and denigrated the samurai. Musashi conceals his swordsmanship while blending in with the town's orthodoxy because of fear that he may expose his dream. Despite striving and failing, Kojirou still sets off on a voyage with Musashi in the hopes of discovering his genuine sentiments. The pair plunges deeply into the mysterious realm of beast-slaying without knowing what their future holds.

277925.title: The Devil Is a Part-Timer! Season 2
277925.evaluate:
With only one last step left to conquer the world, Satan loses to the hero Emilia Justina and flees to another world: modern-day Tokyo.
In the new world, his world-conquering skills are completely useless and he has to find a part-time job to make ends meet. The hero follows in his footsteps and comes to this world too, working in a customer support call centre. Under the new names of Maou Sadao and Yusa Emi, the two meet again.
277925.seasonTitle: The Devil Is a Part-Timer! Season 2
episodeTitles: The Devil and Hero Unknowingly Became Parents
The Devil and Hero Dutifully Visit a Theme Park

277926.title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2
277926.evaluate:
Kōdo Ikusei Senior High School is a reputable school with cutting-edge facilities where nearly all graduates go on to university or find work. Students are able to wear any haircut and bring any personal belongings they like. 
Kiyotaka Ayanokji fails his entrance examinations for some reason and is assigned to Class-D. Class-D is where the school abandons "inferior" students to ridicule them. When he meets Suzune Horikita and Kiky Kushida, things start to change.
episodeTitles: Remember to keep a level head in times of trouble.
There are two primary mortal sins, from which all others derive: impatience and idleness.
The greatest minds are capable of the greatest vices, and the greatest virtues.

277927.title: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer
277927.evaluate: Amamiya Yuuhi is a normal student in a normal college. Everything about him is ordinary: his grades, his good looks and his breezy approach to life. One day, a talking lizard tells him that there is a giant hammer in outer space ready to split the Earth into pieces and asks for his allegiance against the forces of evil. The tranquilly is disturbed as Yuuhi hooks up with the unpredictable Princess to assemble a disparate band of allies to fight back against the villainous mage.
episodeTitles: Yuhi Amamiya and the Lizard Knight

277928.title: Sekai no Owari ni Shiba Inu to
277928.evaluate: A catastrophic event has reduced Earth to a lifeless wasteland, leaving a little girl as the lone remaining member of the human race. She has a strange companion with her as she travels through this apocalyptic setting: a talking Shiba Inu! With his clever pranks, this quirky dog Haru helps travellers cope with the isolation of the road. Haru makes sure that his owner's experience is anything from boring, whether it is by igniting philosophical debates or competing with other canines over affection.
277928.seasonTitle: Sekai no Owari ni Shiba Inu to

277929.title: Nights with a Cat
277929.evaluate: A story about Fuuta's relationship with her new cat. After a long day at work, the boy enjoys nothing more than spending time with his furry friend and making fun of his typical house cat's peculiar behaviour.
episodeTitles: Night 1 The Day a Cat Came to my House
A Cat That Tends to Drop Things

277930.title: Overlord IV
277930.evaluate:
Virtual reality gaming is extremely popular in 2138. 
As a well-liked online game, Yggdrasil is abruptly taken offline. Nevertheless, Momonga, a player who refuses to log-out, takes on the form of a skeleton and becomes "the most powerful wizard."
The gaming environment continued to develop as non-player characters (NPCs) started to exhibit emotions. Without family or friends in this game, Momonga must overcome various barriers to rule the game's brand-new world.
episodeTitles: Ainz Ooal Gown Nation of Leading Darkness

277931.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? IV
277931.evaluate:
In Orario, Bell Cranel is the only adventurer of the Hestia Familia living here. He is weak compared to the senior dungeon crawlers but he possesses a special skill. 

As long as he keeps his feelings for the Sword princess Aiz unchanged, he can become powerful instantly. Moreover, with the help of his goddess Hestia, he vows to become strong enough to fight alongside Aiz and protect others!
277931.seasonTitle: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? IV

277932.title: Lycoris Recoil
277932.evaluate: A secret is hidden in the peace of life: the DA (Direct Attack), a secret organization for crime prevention. LYCORIS, a group of young girls who work as agents, works in the LycoReco branch of the café. They take orders for everything from coffee and desserts to childcare, Japanese teachers and monster fighting. Whatever your order, leave it to LycoReco!

277933.title: My Stepmom's Daughter Is My Ex
277933.evaluate: After a horrible middle school relationship, high school is the best place to start over. It was supposed to be a peaceful refuge where I could avoid seeing my ex again, but now it's a nightmare! My ex and I went to the same school and became step-brothers. Wherever I go, I can see her - my home, my school, my class...  Yes, we are family now. I am her older brother. Although we used to love each other, both of us eventually grew to realise that we were not suited to each other. We may remain siblings, but things will never return to the way they used to be.
277933.seasonTitle: My Stepmom's Daughter Is My Ex
episodeTitles: #1 The Ex-Couples Refuses to Address Each Other Like That
#2 The Day the Ex Takes Care of the Patient

277934.title: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World
277934.evaluate:
Sano Yuji is an ordinary employee employed by a black company. Suddenly, he is summoned to another world and becomes a beast tamer. Occasionally, he meets some slimes who have read magical books that help him gain magical powers and a second career, Sage. 
Despite obtaining overwhelming power, Yuji is unaware of himself. Under the unconscious, Yuji Become the strongest in the world！
277934.seasonTitle: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World
episodeTitles: Episode1 Desire to Protect the City
Episode 3 It Means It's Too Powerful

277935.title: SHADOWS HOUSE 2
277935.evaluate: A magnificent mansion is home to a faceless clan who poses as aristocrats. Living dolls who look after them spend their days clearing up the messes the renters make. However, there is a greater mystery at work, and the house's secret will be revealed.

277936.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun
277936.evaluate: The mystery of the Abyss, with all its uncanny features, has attracted many people to venture into it. Gradually, people began to refer to the adventurers who challenged the great cave many times as "cave explorers". What new stories are in store for Reg, Riko, and Nanachi?
277936.seasonTitle: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun
episodeTitles: The Compass Pointed to the Darkness

277937.title: The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious
277937.evaluate:
This is the story of an odd maid and a lonely boy.
The maid I recently hired was pretty odd. Nobody in the real world could be so stunning, make such great cuisine, or anticipate my needs. she must be employing magic. Yes, only a spell could account for why my chest tightens up whenever I see her. I believe I need to discover what makes this maid so enigmatic!
277937.seasonTitle: The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious
episodeTitles: The Maid I Hired Recently is Mysterious
Young Master, Cat and Morning Glory
Tsukasa Gojouin is a Little Adult

277940.title: Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World
277940.evaluate: A man is looking for ways to die on the internet in an attempt to commit suicide, but a strange website attracts his attention. The website asks a variety of questions and eventually generates a character with skill and ability. When he finished setting up his character, a warning popped up "You will now be transported to a world in the setting of your choice, returning is not possible, do you still accept". Without hesitation, he pressed "yes" and travelled to another world...
277940.seasonTitle: Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World

277941.title: Shoot! Goal to the Future
277941.evaluate: Former Kakegawa High School captain Atsushi Kamiya is acclaimed as the "courageous captain" of a well-known Italian soccer team. A student at the same school named Hideto Tsuji appears bored in the depleted soccer team. Their encounter marks the beginning of a new story.

277942.title: CARDFIGHT!! VANGUARD will+Dress
277942.evaluate:
After the Battle of Nagoya Castle, Yu-yu and his comrades were invited to competition four months later.
This "deluxe" tournament pits the best fighters against one another for the flag, including both "frontline fighters" involved in the main competition and "counter fighters" with a secretive edge like "Black Wind."
To determine who is the strongest of them all, existing characters from overDress will face off against brand-new characters from will+Dress like Raika, Michiru, and Urara.

277943.title: League of Nations Air Force Aviation Magic Band Luminous Witcheseses
277943.evaluate: Unlike the witches of the traditional Defence Fleet, there is this group of witches who defend everyone's smiles and fight their enemies through the healing power of music, these witches are known as the icons of Music Squadron.
277943.seasonTitle: League of Nations Air Force Aviation Magic Band Luminous Witcheseses

277944.title: Fuuto PI
277944.evaluate: Criminals in the city of Fuuto transform into super monsters known as "Dopants" by using USB-like gadgets called "Gaia Memories," causing chaos in an otherwise tranquil city. Shoutarou Hidari, a self-described "seasoned investigator," is one of the heroes who employ "Gaia Memories" to combat these crooks. Together with his ingenious partner Philip, Kamen Rider W, the renowned hero of Fuuto City, is created.
episodeTitles: Be Wary of the T/The Man that Fell in Love with a Witch
Be Wary of the T/The Culprit is Over There
Be Wary of the T/The Masked Guardian

277946.title: Parallel World Pharmacy
277946.evaluate:
After being devastated by the loss of his little sister, world-renowned medical researcher Kanji Yakutani poured everything he had into inventing new medicines. At the age of 31, the former pharmacist died on the job and awoke to find that he had been reincarnated into a medieval world as Falma, a child of the revered De Médicis family.
Falma realises that his body is the master of a medical patron saint. The boy was given mythical divine magic and the ability to instantly diagnose diseases.
Using modern knowledge and his divine powers, Falma wins the approval of the court and is given a pharmacy of his own. But his goal does not stop there, he wants to improve the state of medical care in the S an Fleuve Empire and make it accessible to all.
episodeTitles: The Reborn Pharmacist and Parallel World
The 1st Rank Court Pharmacist and Reborn Pharmacy Researcher

277947.title: Phantom of the Idol
277947.evaluate:
A scrappy idol with a miracle? Yuuya, a good-looking male idol who can't sing or dance, has no fans and no motivation, enters the entertainment industry to earn money but is fired due to his lack of enthusiasm. One day, he meets the "ghost" of the "God Idol, Mogami Asahi"! The two men, who are very different from each other, join forces to reach the top of the idol world!
This summer, the rare and dull idol Yuuya (in every sense of the word) is in the spotlight!

277948.title: Engage Kiss
277948.evaluate:
On an artificial island in the Pacific Ocean, a giant floating metropolis, created by the discovery of a new energy source, is known as Veyron City.
Here begins a hilarious romantic comedy between three people who have a somewhat unusual relationship; Shuu, young and running a small business in the city, but living on a shoestring due to his mindless spending, and Kisara, a girl who often parties with Shuu. Ayano, Shuu's ex-girlfriend and a senior colleague at his former company, is working and attending high school in Veyron.
episodeTitles: The Loser and Demon, Man and Woman

277951.title: Blood and heart: The legendary life of a Japanese youth in China
277951.evaluate: This work chronicles the legendary life of Japanese-born People’s Liberation Army soldier Sa Yuan Hui, shedding light on the little‑known true history of this unique group. Born in Kyushu, Japan, in 1933, Sa Yuan Hui moved to Northeast China with her parents at an early age. Following Japan’s defeat and surrender, unable to return home, she found herself stranded and took up the task of tending cattle for a landlord in Liaoning. In 1948, adopting the name Zhang Rongqing, she joined the People’s Liberation Army and went on to participate in the Liaoshen and Pingjin Campaigns, dedicating herself to the proletarian revolutionary cause.
277951.seasonTitle: Blood and heart: The legendary life of a Japanese youth in China

277952.title: Fairies Albums S3
277952.evaluate: This story told the experience between Tao Yao, Mo Ya and Childe Liu's tour in JingShi, which showed that the distance between human and human, human and fairy may not be as insurmountable as imagined. Whether the interaction between Tao Yao and Ding Sansi, or the guidance the Old Zhang told to Childe Liu about life-overstep and cooking skills, or the dilemma when Mo Ya faced Xi Nang, these let each of them acquire new growth. Meanwhile, Feng Wule, Chen Baishui and others also obtained their own redemption. It may be that the journey of life is influenced by each other in this way with all of its flavors.

277953.title: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei
277953.evaluate: A 5000-year-old vegan dragon was living peacefully when one day a young girl showed up in his cave. She offered herself as a sacrifice in order to gain favor for her village. He played along as the great "Evil Dragon, the Demon Lord's Army Leader" in order to get rid of her. However, his little white lie awoke her hidden powers and his peaceful life suddenly ended.
277953.seasonTitle: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei

277954.title: War God System! I’m Counting On You!
277954.evaluate: Ordinary young man An Lin from the city stumbles upon a powerful cultivator, who bestows upon him the God of War System and transports him to the Spirit Realm to train. Freshly arrived, An Lin—whose talents are far from exceptional—is derided as the “strongest appointment-based recruit.” Determined to shed that stigma, the optimistic An Lin, with the system’s aid, hones his cultivation prowess. Through a series of remarkable feats, he forges bonds of lifelong camaraderie with a band of brothers who would go through life and death together, embarking on a path of triumphant resurgence.
277954.seasonTitle: War God System! I’m Counting On You!
episodeTitles: Enemy Of The Entire School An Lin
Is This Your Preference? An Lin?

277955.title: God Troubles Me Season 3
277955.evaluate: Su Moting is a young woman working as a corporate slave with the status of "the child of a god and demon". After being driven out of the house by her parents on the grounds of "independence and self-improvement", Su Moting meets a dumb, handsome god, Tian Jixing, and a mysterious cool cat demon, Di Kuixing. They are also exiled to the human world. Having formed a savior group under the leadership of the land god, the three began to show their heartache and funny side in daily life. Stay tuned for exciting stories from God Troubles Me the third season!
episodeTitles: Is There Nothing We Can Do in a Power Outage at Night?

277956.title: Master of the Star Spring
277956.evaluate: Su Jiu accidentally gained the power of "Star Spring" and became the master of it. For this, he set out for a cultivation journey with a fun and extraordinary experience.
episodeTitles: The Star Spring Selects the Loser

277958.title: JX Online3：The Adventure of Shen Jianxin 3rd Season
277958.evaluate: The martial world has long since lost its peace. The Five Saints Sect, once content to hold its ground in a corner of the realm, has repeatedly fallen under attack, while the ruined village of Maple Blossom Valley has begun to stir with inexplicable unrest. The Assassin has returned to the jianghu, and newcomers Qu Yun and A Liang have made their debut… After years adrift on Clearwater Island, Shen Jianxin is suddenly ambushed. What new crisis will he face this time?
277958.seasonTitle: JX Online3：The Adventure of Shen Jianxin 3rd Season

277959.title: A World Worth Protecting
277959.evaluate: In the fantastic future world with rich spiritual energy, the enthusiastic and cheerful little fatty Wang Baole saw through the illusion created by the teachers in the entrance examination of the famous"Mischievous Taoist Academy", who won high scores with his outstanding performance, and obtained the special quota of "Magic Soldier Department". Later, he overcome obstacles and opened up his own way of growing. In the process of cultivating immortals and fighting monsters, he made a large number of close friends, and thus started a series of hilarious adventure stories.

277960.title: Millenniums Of Warring States
277960.evaluate:
Advanced gamer and streamer, Ji Qing traveled back to the Spring and Autumn Period equipped with a cheater "Shaohao Bone". However, the historical event "The Emperor and the Assassin" somehow succeeded, and the Seven Kingdoms fought for controlling each other, thus wars continued for thousands of years. Ren Yong, a bold man with loyalty and righteousness has also participated in the race. 
Now, how will "The Eternal Life" Ji Qing show his talents in the turbulent world?

277961.title: Fairy Mountain
277961.evaluate: The young man from the Eastern Kingdom, “Fantiān,” is on a secret mission when he arrives in the Central Plains and suffers a shipwreck, losing part of his memory. Fantiān is rescued by a girl named “Gōngliáng Shān” who has a leg ailment. To repay her life‑saving kindness, he agrees to Master Niányǐn’s request: to take Shān’ér and the temple’s treasured tome down the mountain in search of the immortal island described within, hoping to cure her leg. Their journey takes them through Huáncuì Bay. Meanwhile, the Central Plains general “Lǐ Mào,” acting on the Empress Dowager’s orders, heads to Huáncuì Bay to track the emperor’s whereabouts. After braving countless perils, all converge at Huáncuì Bay. Fantiān finally recovers his memories—and the mysterious treasures he stumbled upon along the way bring him tantalizingly close to becoming the most powerful man under heaven.

277962.title: SWARM
277962.evaluate: A seemingly ordinary traffic accident led to multiple forces being involved. While everyone rushed to investigate the truth a series of unexpected situations broke out. The crisis hidden behind the unsettled case exceeded everybody's imagination...When human beings are busy exploring their limits, they are not aware of standing at the crossroads of evolution once again, and a magnificent Big Era began...

277963.title: TEPPEN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!: Laughing ’til You Cry
277963.evaluate: Yayoi Sakamoto is a comedian and a die-hard fan of comedy shows. After entering the private Kazuki High School, she reunites with her old friend Yomogi Takahashi, with whom the two used to form the comedy duo "Konamonzu". As before, they are in the park choreographing their entry when suddenly a mysterious girl calls out to them...

277964.title: Dr. Stone: Stone Wars
277964.evaluate:
Senkuu set his goal to bring back all those who had been turned into statues. However, his idea was countered by a man who believed that only the fittest of those petrified could be brought back to life.
As the snow melts and spring arrives, Senkuu and his allies in Ishigami Village complete their preparations for an attack on the Tsukasa Empire. The Kingdom of Science is ready to launch its latest plan to recruit a sizable Tsukasa army to its side. It was a race against time; for every day the Science Kingdom spent perfecting their inventions, the Empire's numbers grew rapidly. With both sides pursuing their ideal world, the Stone War has now begun!

277967.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets Movie
277967.evaluate: Fuutarou, the part-time tutor of quintuplets, has paid off his efforts. The quintuplets who have become senior students in high school have completed their graduation trip, and everyone is moving toward the future. Time flies and the quintuplets have noticed their feelings for Fuutarou...Who will be Fuutarou's bride?

277968.title: Dropkick On My Devil!! X
277968.evaluate:
Third season of Jashin-chan Dropkick.
Jashin-chan Dropkick is a comedy that concentrates on these two reluctant roommates and their eccentric antics.
Yurine Hanazono, a girl who has studied the occult, summons the demon Jashin-chan to Earth, but does not know how to send it back to hell, where it is trapped.
The only way for Jashin-chan to return is to kill her summoner, but that is easier said than done for this incompetent demon. As Jashin-chan is immortal and can regenerate, Yurine attacks her relentlessly with a variety of weapons. The usual tale of cat-and-mouse is played out here.

277969.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun (Thai Dub)
277969.seasonTitle: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun (Thai Dub)

277970.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun (Dub Indo)
277970.seasonTitle: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun (Dub Indo)

277974.title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2 (Thai Dub)
277974.seasonTitle: Classroom of the Elite Season 2 (Thai Dub)

277975.title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2(Dub Indo)
277975.seasonTitle: Classroom of the Elite Season 2(Dub Indo)

277976.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window(Thai Dub)
277976.evaluate: Kosuke Mikado, a shy bookshop employee, can see ghosts and spirits, a talent he wishes he didn't have because what he often sees terrifies him. Rihito Hiyakawa, an exorcist with supernatural abilities as potent as his lack of social graces, doesn't appear to be afraid of anything, mortal or otherwise. This strange duo may not always use approaches that are appropriate for the workplace when they collaborate to tackle the strange problems that come their way!
277976.seasonTitle: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window(Thai Dub)

277977.title: How A Realist Hero Rebuilt The Kingdom (Thai Dub)
277977.evaluate: Unexpectedly transported to another world, Kazuya Souma quickly figures out the situation in the new world and decides to become the hero that people expect. He wanted to rebuild the shaky economy, not through war and reform. This realistic hero starts to gather talented people to help him get the country back on its feet!
277977.seasonTitle: How A Realist Hero Rebuilt The Kingdom (Thai Dub)

277978.title: About Youth
277978.evaluate: When a self‑centered, camera‑loving elite high schooler meets a band prince who, though invisible offstage, transforms into a star on it—different backgrounds, different values—they collide in the heated race for student council president, their clash echoing like a thunderous roar at the twilight of youth. Ye Guang, the frontrunner and campus heartthrob of this year’s election; Xu Qizhang, the promising young owner of the family noodle stall and the band’s ace lead singer‑guitarist. As the campaign unfolds, Ye Guang finds himself drawn to the secret identity his rival, Xu Qizhang, has kept hidden. The outwardly glamorous but inwardly lonely Ye Guang faces the self‑marginalized yet fiercely driven Xu Qizhang: two solitary souls who heal each other, leaning on one another for support. Ye Guang’s gaze begins, almost without his knowing, to follow Xu Qizhang…

277979.title: URUSEI YATSURA
277979.evaluate: The lecherous Ataru Moroboshi is unremarkable, yet his extreme bad luck stands out like the horns on an alien's head. When Earth is attacked by a fleet of Oni alien invaders, Ataru is chosen to represent humanity in a combat with one of them. It's a stroke of luck for Ataru that the duel is actually a game of tag, and that his opponent is Lum, the daughter of the Oni's chief, who prioritizes her own pride over winning—as Ataru discovers by taking Lum's bikini top and thus victory.
episodeTitles: The Lucky Yellow Ribbon Given to You
Trouble Rains Down. Amazed in a Maze

277980.title: Four People and Their Respective Lies
277980.evaluate:
Every girl has a secret ♡.
Rika, Chiyo, Sekine and Tsubasa are the four best friends in the class. The calm on the surface doesn't mean there is no hidden truth behind them, each of them seems to have a terrible secret...?
277980.seasonTitle: Four People and Their Respective Lies

277981.title: Shinobi no Ittoki
277981.evaluate:
Ittoki Sakuraba, the main character, is an ordinary child who initially believed that ninjas did not exist. He should have led a normal, happy, and fulfilling life...
Ittoki was assassinated one day, and he discovered that it was all the work of the Kouga ninjas. Why is Ittoki being hunted down? Because he is Iga Ninja's 19th genuine heir! For many years, Iga and Kouga have been at odds, and Kouga has always desired to invade Iga. Ittoki's only option for survival is to become a ninja!
Ittoki has therefore entered the unknown world of ninjas. To become a mature ninja, you must constantly learn, fight, and face challenges. But Ittoki's cruelty is just getting started.

277982.title: Akiba Maid War
277982.evaluate:
It's 1999, spring.

A young girl travels to Akihabara admiring and aspiring to be a cute maid. There are many different types of maids in the "Akiba" at the turn of the century. Today is also a working day for the maid cafe "Ton Tokoton," also referred to as "Butagoya" (Pig Hut). Because the new maid I had brought into the store with me was so unpredictable, I was in a panic. The red bat swings into action as maids, trainers, and other Akihabara life forms appear. Given to all masters and ladies, this is a complete maid's work-struggle diary. "We're waiting for you to get home, boo."
episodeTitles: Booyah! A New Maid in Akiba Starting Today!
The Maid's Fist. What's the Pancreas Worth?

277983.title: Love Flops
277983.evaluate:
Ordinary boys' high school student Kashiwagi Asahi is on the same path to school as usual. However, just as the wonderful divination played on the TV that was turned on inadvertently before going out, he encountered various disasters this morning.
In one disaster after another, Asahi and 5 teenage girls have the worst encounter ever.
When he was exhausted physically and mentally and finally arrived at the school, the figures of five girls who were transfer students and new teachers appeared in front of him again. Asahi tried to hide his face, but couldn't hide it at all...
Ijūin Yoshio, who claims to be Asahi's friend, asks Asahi about his relationship with the five.
After getting along with the 5 people, the misunderstandings between each other were solved, and the relationship was slightly harmonious.
After school, Asahi opened the shoe cabinet to go home, only to find a love letter inside.
The sender's unidentified love letter reads "Waiting for you under the cherry tree behind the school building". This is also what divination says.

277984.title: Management of Novice Alchemist
277984.evaluate:
Sarasa, the next alchemist, was raised in an orphanage. Her ambition is to follow in the footsteps of her late parents and create a shop. Her owner handed her an empty shop in a remote village as a graduation gift from a training school. Sarasa is overjoyed to see her goal come true, but what awaits her is a decaying store, strange communication, and destroying monsters to collect materials!? Sarasa struggles in a new nation, arming herself with a wealth of knowledge, exceptional magic, and skilled swordsmanship.

Feelings and alchemy permeate throughout the store's management.
Meetings and relationships are formed...

277985.title: The Eminence in Shadow
277985.evaluate:
People aspire to be great heroes and evil villains, but Cid Kagenou is not one of them. He aspires to be the true brain behind it all, pulling the strings and directing the entire plot. He was unable to attain his objectives in his prior existence in modern-day Japan. But now, resurrected into a magical world, he will demonstrate the true majesty of darkness!

As Cid poses as an ordinary mobster, he recruits members for his (false) group Shadow Garden, which aims to bring down the enigmatic cult that lurks in the shadows. Cid leads his (fictional) organization against the filthy (yet unexpectedly real) Diabolos Cult with plenty of ad-libs.

277986.title: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! Double
277986.evaluate: A somewhat withdrawn and quiet third-year college student, Shinichi Sakurai, and Hana Uzaki, graduated from the same high school one year younger. Shinichi is often entangled in various nonsensical entanglements in the name of taking care of a lonely senior by Hana. Although it was a bit annoying at first, gradually he got used to it...
277986.seasonTitle: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! Double
episodeTitles: Uzaki-chan Really Wants to Hang Out!
After Hanging Out, I Wanna Make Udon!
Uzaki-chan Wanna Go to the Campus Festival?

277987.title: Princess of the Bibliophile
277987.evaluate:
Eliana Bernstein, better known as the "Bibliophile Princess," has always preferred the company of books to that of people since she was able to read. However, it is her responsibility as a noble to find a suitor. Fortunately for her, Crown Prince Christopher Selkirk Asherald offers a deal: In exchange for protecting Eliana's free time, he will only consider her to be his legal fiancée.

Eliana learns to be more accepting of others during their years together, which are blissful. But everything good has to come to an end. Eliana shouldn't have a problem ending their pretend relationship because she loves books more than people. Eliana starts to understand that she isn't as indifferent to Christopher as she initially believed as he becomes close with another girl.

277988.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Intrigue
277988.evaluate: Thousands of years later, Humans travel through space and divide into galactic empires and free alliances; on the two planets, tyranny and democracy are practiced differently. Since 150 years ago, the two countries have engaged in a never-ending conflict across the universe's galaxies. corruption of the Galactic Empire's nobility Space years, the end of the 8th century, two geniuses propel history: Reinhard von Loengram, the genius who wins all battles, and Yang Wen Li, the Invincible Wizard, the two led the army to start an endless conflict. Crowd-rule is a drawback of the democratic idea of a free planetary alliance that eats two nations.
277988.seasonTitle: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Intrigue

277989.title: Immoral Guild
277989.evaluate:
This is the youth I want?

The young hunter with the most kills in the guild is Kikuru. He spent his entire childhood honing his hunting skills, and now all he wanted was to quit his job and turn back the clock to his younger years! Training his successor is Kikuru's top priority because he wants to retire as soon as possible! But for some reason, nothing but immorality has taken place under his cunning new guard!

How will the youth of Kikuru grow? The newcomers' training in Kikuru's immorality has begun!
episodeTitles: I’ll Do My Best With Dedication!
A Bolt Out of The Blue

277990.title: Encouragement of Climb: Next Summit
277990.evaluate:
Together, Aoi and Hinata started to ascend mountains, first the 197-meter-high Tenran Mountain, then the 599-meter-high Takao Mountain, and finally the 1786-meter-high Mitog Mountain.
Their outdoor life was enriched by the addition of friends like Kokona, Kaede, and Honoka as they traveled around famous peaks in the Kanto region, including Tanigawa, a mountain with fond memories for both of them.
Aoi has improved her mountain knowledge, gear, and stamina in an effort to advance to higher levels.

277991.title: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
277991.evaluate:
Al Wayne is a young man who has been honing his farming-related skills while living an extraordinary farmer life. The last peasant's skill level was finally increased to the highest.

But for some reason, ever since he mastered the skills required of farmers, his life has fundamentally changed the way a farmer should live.
277991.seasonTitle: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
episodeTitles: The Farmer and Ouroboros the Evil Dragon

277993.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN: ZERO
277993.evaluate:
Violent misfortunes frequently occur around 16-year-old Yuuta Okkotsu, a timid victim of high school bullying. Yuuta is saddled with a monstrous curse, a power that dishes out brutal revenge against his bullies. Rika Orimoto, Yuuta's curse, is a shadow from his tragic childhood and a potentially lethal threat to anyone who dares wrong him.

Yuuta's unique situation catches the attention of Satoru Gojou, a powerful sorcerer who teaches at Tokyo Jujutsu High. Gojou sees immense potential in Yuuta, and he hopes to help the boy channel his deadly burden into a force for good. Yet Yuuta struggles to find his place among his talented classmates: the selectively mute Toge Inumaki, weapons expert Maki Zenin, and Panda.

Yuuta clumsily utilizes Rika on missions with the other first-year students, but the grisly aftermath of Rika's tremendous displays of power draws the interest of the calculating curse user Suguru Getou. As Getou strives to claim Rika's strength and use it to eliminate all non-jujutsu users from the world, Yuuta fights alongside his friends to stop the genocidal plot.

277994.title: Legend of Mana -The Teardrop Crystal-
277994.evaluate:
Shiloh, a young boy who lives near the town of Domina.
One day, he began to hear a mysterious voice in a dream.
The voice told him that he had a mission...
One day, Shiloh meets two people, "Jumei".
Jumei used to be a race, they were targeted for the jewels buried in their chests, and many were killed.
Now, mysterious jewelry thieves are attacking the Jumei family one after another around the world.

277995.title: Mob Psycho 100 Ⅲ
277995.evaluate: Shigeo Kageyama, a regular second-year middle school student, was dubbed a "Mob" due to his feeble presence, but he actually possesses a potent natural superpower. Mob started to believe that their superpowers were dangerous after each growth. Mob has been unconsciously repressing their emotions in order to prevent superpowers from becoming out of control. Even though all he wanted was to go about his daily business as usual, problems of every description kept happening to him.
episodeTitles: Yokai Hunter Haruaki Amakusa appears! ~The Threat of Hyakki!~

277996.title: Peter Grill and the Philosopher's Time - Super Extra
277996.evaluate:
After winning the martial arts competition, Peter Grill was crowned the world's strongest man.
Though he now believes he can wed his longtime girlfriend Luvelia, he continues to be seduced by women of various races for the sake of his offspring.

Peter has the most military might but the least amount of willpower.
He repeatedly gave in to temptation, his lower body slender.
Then word spread that a terrible goblin plague had erupted.
Peter rushes to suppress it, but the battlefield holds a surprise for him.

A village of elves, a village of dwarfs, a goblin's den... Although the scene may have changed, the temptation still exists.
The greatest saint on earth's era is about to start all over again!
277996.seasonTitle: Peter Grill and the Philosopher's Time - Super Extra
episodeTitles: Episode 1: Peter Grill and the Goblin Revelation
Episode 2: Peter Grill and the Goblin's Gratitude
Episode 3: Peter Grill and the Only Proper Thing to Do

277997.title: The Story of Fengzhi Senla
277997.evaluate: The precursor of the storm is about to shake the entire Wind Continent. A wedding with a lot of inside information has attracted people from all walks of life, making Xianluo City a wrestling field for the seven major sects to fight openly and secretly. The ambitious Lancelot, the outstanding swordsman Hanajiro, the mysterious and wise Kogoro, and Snow who fishes in troubled waters, ride this undercurrent, either intentionally or unintentionally, by fate, they gather in Xianluo city, and together they set off the continent of shocking wind of gigantic waves.

277998.title: Blade of Dawn
277998.evaluate: Galway time-travelled to Loren land and appeared as the ancestor of the Cecil family due to an airplane accident. He broadened the territories and encouraged people to maximize their talents. However, crazy evil cultists and hidden evil tides stopped his steps...how can Galway fight against this collapsing world?

277999.title: Qi Refining for 3000 Years
277999.evaluate: Bai Qiuran, a hero refined for 66665 levels failed to build a foundation of Qi. By accident, he got a clue about a mysterious ancient stone tablet, which guided him to discover the way to build his foundation. Bai decided to leave the mountain and step on the journey!

278000.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S3
278000.evaluate:
He killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam when he was six years old. Wang Ling, an omnipotent agriculture wizard, had to conceal his strength in order to exist amid a bunch of common cultivators. This young man is not concerned with the things that regular people are: money, magic, magic weapons, and reputation. He will continue to pursue the crisp noodles despite the affection of his wealthy daughter Sun Rong, the sharpshooter of the top murderer of the dark stream, and the unbroken discussion of his parents.

And now comes Season3 of The Daily Life of the Immortal King!
278000.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S3

278001.title: No Doubt In Us 2
278001.evaluate: The emperor and empress of the Great Chen Dynasty, through an unexpected twist of fate, swapped identities. Once utterly at odds with one another, they now, by stepping into each other’s shoes, came to understand the hardships of their respective roles. As the exchange unfolded, they gradually learned to empathize and trust one another. At a critical juncture when the frontier was under siege, Xiao Jinyun—actually Xu Yu—personally led the imperial army to quell the unrest on the border, ultimately returning in triumph. Just as the imperial couple had overcome countless trials and successfully restored their original bodies, the Tatar queen suddenly appeared at court. Meanwhile, within the court and among the people, the Third Prince’s ambition to seize power had become all too evident…

278002.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
278002.evaluate:
The Black Cats tribe suffers the dreadful fate of being hunted, enslaved, and slain. Fran, a twelve-year-old girl of the persecuted race, yearns for vengeance for the crimes committed against her people. She fantasizes about a brighter future, one for which she is willing to get her hands filthy. A meeting with a talking sword, a reborn man yearning for a beautiful wielder, proves to be the turning point in her fate.

The young Fran plans to recover her kin's glory and honor with the help of her new comrade, chopping down all her foes along the way. She begins on a quest with her amazing sword and unwavering resolve.
episodeTitles: Episode 1 The Catgirl Met a Sword
The Scary Examiner at the Adventurer's Guild

278003.title: My Master Has No Tail
278003.evaluate: Mameda is a Tanuki girl with shape-shifting abilities who aspires to become human one day. She transforms into a stunning woman with black hair one day and leaves for Osaka, but is quickly found! Rakugo-ka is the name of the stunning woman who keeps telling the depressed Mameda to "Go back to where you came from!" (Rakugo storyteller). Here is where your happy Taisho Rakugo fantasy begins!
episodeTitles: I Want to be a Rakugo Master
It's My Ambition, I'll Learn As Much As I Can From Her!

278004.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss
278004.evaluate:
Due to her severe illness, a young girl spends the majority of her life in a hospital room playing otome games. One day, she finds herself in the middle of a short story from one of these games, dressed as the villainous Aileen Loren D'Autriche.
Aileen's childhood friend and the crown prince, Cedric Jeanne Elmeier, announces he is in love with Lilia Rainworth, the game's female protagonist, during the banquet to celebrate the end of the academy's winter term. Having seen ahead of her a tragic future, the young girl makes a conscious decision to change it by making her half-brother, Claude Jeanne Elmeier, fall in love with her in place of the game's final boss, "Demon King".
278004.seasonTitle: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss
episodeTitles: The Villainess Has Many Enemies and Also Many Subordinates
The Villainess Has A Strong Desire, so She Has to Win

278005.title: My Hero Academia Season 6
278005.evaluate:
With the intention of becoming a "hero" who can save society and the populace with his "personality," Deku enrolled in a prestigious school that fosters heroes. He grew up with his classmates in Class A of the first year of the Hero Department.
Deku goes to work as an intern at Endeavour's office along with Bakugou and Todoroki. Deku demonstrates significant hero development after plunging into the realm of the highest level, including mastering the Black Whip, a new "personality" that lurks in everyone's hearts.

Shigaraki Tomura of the Villain Alliance is engaged in combat with Re-Alien Destro's Liberation Army. Shigaraki rediscovered his lost and horrifying childhood memories while fighting Re-Destro, and he came to life. He assumed command of the Alien Liberation Army and increased its strength while also looking for new abilities for himself so he could destroy everything.

Heroes and villains Deku and Shigaraki. Total war is about to break out!

278006.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
278006.evaluate:
A.S. (Ad Stella) 122―
It is an era in which a number of corporations have entered space and have built a vast economic system. The Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group, dominates the mobile suit industry with a lone girl from Mercury transferring to it. The girl's name is Suletta Mercury. She walks step by step through a new world with a scarlet light burning in her heart.
278006.seasonTitle: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury

278007.title: To Your Eternity Season 2
278007.evaluate:
Fushi was the first "ball" to be thrown to the ground. As a baby, Fushi witnessed the passing of many people, from a mother and daughter, an extraordinary brother, a friend on the battlefield, and finally an old lady.
Later he grew up and became close to a person. Decades later, the world is in turmoil once again due to the attack of his nemesis, Nokkers.
Fushi broke the long silence and stood up. But then he realized. He can fight alone, but he cannot protect everyone alone.
Will they fight, even at the cost of new sacrifices, or...?

278008.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun3
278008.evaluate:
Iruma Suzuki, 14, has had a difficult life because he has to work while still a minor in order to support his negligent parents. He eventually learns that his parents had actually sold him to the demon Sullivan. Iruma's concerns about what will happen to him, however, are quickly allayed because Sullivan only wants a grandchild, spoiling him and forcing him to attend the demon school Babyls.

Iruma initially tries to maintain a low profile out of concern that his peers will learn that he is a human. Unfortunately, it turns out to be more challenging than he anticipated. It turns out that Sullivan is the school's chairman, and everyone anticipates that he will succeed the current Demon King as the next!
episodeTitles: New Semester of The Abnormal Class

278009.title: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc Memorial Edition
278009.evaluate:
The film trilogy Berserk: The Golden Age Arc has a TV cut.

He has only put his faith in his own sword. Guts is a lone swordsman who works as a mercenary in a region that has been affected by the Hundred Years War. He has no family, friends, or place to go home to. Guts can handle a sword that is longer than he is tall and defeats strong foes with ease. The "Band of the Hawk's" leader Griffith has his sights set on Guts. Griffith wins a duel with Guts and brings him into the Band of the Hawk to realize his own dream. Griffith, who has great ambitions and a commanding power unimaginable given his attractive appearance.

Their friends bond as a result of their shared experiences in numerous bloody battles. Particularly between Griffith and Guts, their relationship has developed into something special. The Band of the Hawk eventually became the Kingdom of Midland's regular army, but Griffith's ascent to the top did not stop there. Guts, on the other hand, is seduced by Griffith's "dream" and starts to wonder whether his life of solely using a sword is what he really wants. However, Guts is still unaware of the terrible fate that their unending dreams have befallen them.
278009.seasonTitle: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc Memorial Edition

278010.title: BEAST TAMER
278010.evaluate:
Rein is a tamer who wants to help the heroes defeat the Demon Lord. But one day, his friends kicked him out of the party of heroes because they thought he was useless. Rein, who chose the path of the adventurer in order to live freely, met Kanade, a student who had been attacked by demons.
He moved in to defend Kanade, but she slayed the demon with a single blow.
Kanade is a young woman from the Cat Tribe, considered to be one of the "strongest races" with exceptional skills! Would you like to try being my master? Kanade enquires of Rein after being struck by his talent and good nature. Rein enters into a contract with the toughest cat-eared girl and embarks on an adventure-filled new life.
However, the heroes who exiled Rein eventually understood the power...

278011.title: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
278011.evaluate:
Hitori Gotoh, “Bocchi-chan,” is a girl who’s so introverted and shy around people that she’d always start her conversations with “Ah...”
During her middle school years, she started playing the guitar, wanting to join a band because she thought it could be an opportunity for even someone shy like her to also shine. But because she had no friends, she ended up practicing guitar for six hours every day all by herself.
After becoming a skilled guitar player, she uploaded videos of herself playing the guitar to the internet under the name “Guitar Hero” and fantasized about performing at her school’s cultural festival concert. But not only could she not find any bandmates, before she knew it, she was in high school and still wasn’t able to make a single friend!
She was really close to becoming a shut-in, but one day, Nijika Ijichi, the drummer in Kessoku Band, reached out to her. And because of that, her everyday life started to change little by little...

278012.title: BLEACH Thousand-Year Blood War
278012.evaluate:
By chance, Ichigo Kurosaki gained the abilities of the god of death and was dubbed the "agent Soul Reaper."
He grew up in the corpse world, the location where the spirits of those who have died in this lifetime congregate.
And at this point, the Nether Empire formally declared war on the death god.
Five days later, the "invisible empire" destroyed the corpse world.
For a millennium, fate has been the Grim Reaper's burden.
Finally, their causality and underlying truths are revealed.
It's all going to end.

The final battle of Kurosaki Ichigo begins.

278013.title: Chainsaw Man
278013.evaluate:
To spend quality time with the girl he likes and lead a contented life is Denji's simple and ordinary dream. This, however, is far from the truth because Denji's fate is to be made to kill demons by the gang in order to settle his enormous debt. Turning his pet demon Pochita into a weapon, Denji will use any means necessary to make money.

Unfortunately, the demon who had a deal with the gang killed him because he was no longer needed. Pochita, in a shocking turn of events, fuses with Denji's corpse and grants him the abilities of a chainsaw demon. The revived Denji uses his newfound abilities to swiftly and mercilessly eliminate his enemies. Denji gains the ability to transform certain parts of his body into a chainsaw. When the official witcher arrived on the scene, this attracted his attention, and the witcher hired Denji to work as one of them in the Public Security Bureau. Denji now has a strategy for defeating any foe, no matter how formidable, and he will go to any lengths to fulfill his simple teenage dream.

278014.title: Blue Lock
278014.evaluate: Japan had trouble getting back on track after the 2018 World Cup disaster. but constantly feel as though something is lacking? Yes, they have an unbeatable forward who can help them win. The JFA is committed to producing a striker who is hungry for both goals and victory so that he can be a key component in recovering from defeats. 300 of Japan's best players and most talented young players have been gathered for this purpose. Who will emerge as the top member of the leadership group? Will they be able to overcome everyone's biceps and egos that get in their way?

278015.title: VAZZROCK THE ANIMATION
278015.evaluate:
"There is one year. Why don't you take a risk?"

These are the opening remarks made by the president of Tsukino Entertainment Productions regarding the VAZZROCK project.
These 12 artists, who come from various artistic backgrounds, ages, and genres, have been collaborating for a while.
They split into two teams, VAZZY and ROCK DOWN, and worked together as a team, good friends and rivals, squaring off to bring out the best in each other.
They undertake a variety of tasks in addition to musical ones, including performances in plays, theaters, and movies.

Even though they were troubled and hurt, they persisted so that they could shine.

A brand-new illustrious tale is about to start!

278016.title: More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers
278016.evaluate: The story centers on third-year high school student Jiro Yakuin, who gets saddled with his gyaru classmate Akari Watanabe for the class's "marriage training" project about practicing to be a married couple. Jiro is the complete opposite of Akari, but the two know that if they do well they will be able to switch partners to end up with their respective crushes, and so they force themselves to act like the perfect married couple.
278016.seasonTitle: More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers

278017.title: God of Deception
278017.evaluate: Upon exhaustion of the world's energy, people built Feith City, one of the largest cities in the world. A middle school student named Wu Minglu has been judged a villain by the system in Feith City because he has lied too many times, and he has been attacked by the evil species "karma". Wu Minglu was helped by Lian En, the lie watcher who was sent by Feith City to correct his bad habits. Upon meeting, the two were involved in various incidents, from which they gradually revealed little-known secrets...

278018.title: Stars Fall
278018.evaluate: Researchers involved in the research organization code-named  "Mattamore" are frightened to death by the never-ending nightmare they are living in. Bai Xi, a university graduate who is ordinary yet unusual, and Han Zhuo, a mysterious and powerful esper who is near-omnipotent, set out with a group of steadfast friends on a spectacular path to salvation - those dark corners where the sun never reaches, always need a person to shed a tear to light the way.

278019.title: The Furious Yama
278019.evaluate: What sort of experience is being the ruler of hell and having a severe phobia of ghosts? Yan Xiaoluo is my name. My deceased father made plans for me to travel to the outside world to develop my bravery because I was terrified of ghosts. However, the western hell's Satan and Lucifer might eventually stop lusting after the human world and the eastern ghost realm. The bull's head and horse face are ephemeral, and Xiaokui, who was chosen by chance, will help the king deal with them. This art will also depict heaven! That combat-only monkey, too! And occasionally the deceased father will appear to steal the show!

278020.title: Memory of Chang'An
278020.evaluate: I'm Emira, Princess of the Xiyue Kingdom. I was up in a time of war and have been aware of the conflicts among the three nations of Xiyue, Datang, and Nanlu since I was a young child. In the future, I hope to join the Xiyue warrior women and use my own archery prowess to protect the tribe. One day, out of the blue, the Great Khan gave me the order that Xiyue should wed Datang and that I should wed Li Qian, the ninth prince of the Tang Dynasty. How is this advantageous to me, a feisty young woman who has always been rough? But when I consider it, I feel a bit proud of myself if I can actually end the war that the people are going through.

278021.title: Kaifeng Strange Tales: This Lord Bao is Not That Great
278021.evaluate: A legendary character appeared during the North Song Dynasty in ancient China at Kai Feng, the seat of the North Song. He is Zheng Bao, the governor. He is referred to as Bao Gong by the locals (Lord Bao). His extraordinary honesty, uprightness, impartiality, and courage in upholding justice set him apart in a corrupt regime and earned him the nickname "Justice Bao". According to Chinese tradition, Zheng Bao is the supernaturally gifted reincarnation of Megrez, the Chinese God of Wisdom. The Bao Gong mythology is told in a brand-new way in Kai Feng Story.
278021.seasonTitle: Kaifeng Strange Tales: This Lord Bao is Not That Great
episodeTitles: Bao Zheng Cracks the Ox Tongue Case
Their Personal Grudge over the Ten Years

278022.title: Vertical World
278022.evaluate: The "forbidden love" between elementary school students with incredibly long tails and large white dogs, the fairy tale world where axes fly horizontally, the cat-eared lady who travels less and less, dinosaurs with no volume kindergartens, animation studios that don't do animation—all of these things exist in the vertical world. This vertical world will feature all of these stories.
episodeTitles: Production Team: Drying the Hair Is Wearing
Art Director: I Don't Want to Write the End Credit List
Promoting Team: All We Do Is Cheating

278023.title: Fusé: Memoirs of a Huntress
278023.evaluate: Eight samurai serve the Satomi clan in Kyokutei Bakin's classic Japanese epic novel Nansou Satomi Hakkenden during the turbulent Sengoku (Warring States) era of Japan. The souls that Princess Fuse mothered with a dog named Yatsufusa are reborn as the Edo-era samurai. The female hunter Hamaji visits her brother in Fuse Gansaku: Satomi Hakkenden to hunt Fuse. Thus, the long-running karmic cycle of vengeance that started with the Satomi family restarts.

278024.title: Foreordination
278024.evaluate: Cosmic wanderer Li Yuesu inadvertently discovers the “Shangjia,” an interstellar colony ship that vanished years ago, and witnesses terrifying anomalies… Gradually, humanity comes to realize a colossal threat looming ever closer. After much turmoil, the various powers in the Konil Stellar Region are ultimately forced to unite against a formidable foe. Yet the alien enemy proves immeasurably more powerful than anyone could have imagined. With the human forces on the brink of total annihilation, they have no choice but to dispatch Li Yuesu to seek aid from the mighty human civilization at the Galactic Heart.

278025.title: [C] The Money of Soul and Possibility Control
278025.evaluate: The Sovereign Wealth Fund saved the Japanese government from a financial meltdown. But for its residents, life hasn't gotten any better; unemployment, crime, suicide, and hopelessness are all too common. Kimimaro is a scholarship student whose main desire is to have a steady, regular life. He was raised by his maternal aunt after his father vanished and his mother passed away. He runs into a man one day who offers him a large quantity of money in exchange for letting his "future" be kept as collateral. His future is drastically changed from that point on after being dragged into the mysterious Financial District, where he must participate in weekly competitions known as "deals" in order to keep his money and his life.
278025.seasonTitle: [C] The Money of Soul and Possibility Control

278026.title: Date A Live IV(Thai Dub)
278026.evaluate: Shidou encounters a starving woman lying on the street and ends up helping her. The woman introduces herself as Nia Honjou—a popular comic artist working under a pen name. However, Nia reveals that she is also a Spirit and is aware of Shidou's secret operation...

278027.title: Ya Boy Kongming!(Thai Dub)
278027.evaluate:
Kong Ming, a great strategist during the Three Kingdoms period, achieved an extraordinary life through his lifelong struggles and countless battles. So when Kong Ming was dying, his only wish was to be reborn into a world full of peace and no wars... Then Kong Ming was sent directly to the modern city of Tokyo! Can a brilliant strategist like Kong Ming adapt to the modern wild beat?
Later, Kong Ming met Eiko Tsukimi in Shibuya, and Kongming, who was deeply attracted by her singing, became Eiko's military advisor. The overwhelming ingenuity of the genius military advisor led to the birth of a new legend in the music scene, and then...

278028.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War(Thai Dub)
278028.evaluate:
From a good family? Check! A good personality? Check!
Shuchiin Academy is where all these elite students with bright futures flock to.
As the two leaders of the student council, Shinomiya Kaguya and Shirogane Miyuki have supposedly fallen in love...
But after almost half a year, nothing has happened!?
They both have too much pride and can’t be honest.
Things have gotten troublesome, and they are now caught in a war of "How to get the other to confess their love first."

This is a whole new romantic comedy, following an outbreak of cunning warfare between two elite students in love.

278029.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War 2(Thai Dub)
278029.evaluate:
At the renowned Shuchiin Academy, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya are the student body's top representatives. Ranked the top student in the nation and respected by peers and mentors alike, Miyuki serves as the student council president. Alongside him, the vice president Kaguya—eldest daughter of the wealthy Shinomiya family—excels in every field imaginable. They are the envy of the entire student body, regarded as the perfect couple.

However, despite both having already developed feelings for the other, neither are willing to admit them. The first to confess loses, will be looked down upon, and will be considered the lesser. With their honor and pride at stake, Miyuki and Kaguya are both equally determined to be the one to emerge victorious on the battlefield of love!

278030.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War (Dub Indo)
278030.evaluate:
From a good family? Check! A good personality? Check!
Shuchiin Academy is where all these elite students with bright futures flock to.
As the two leaders of the student council, Shinomiya Kaguya and Shirogane Miyuki have supposedly fallen in love...
But after almost half a year, nothing has happened!?
They both have too much pride and can’t be honest.
Things have gotten troublesome, and they are now caught in a war of "How to get the other to confess their love first."

This is a whole new romantic comedy, following an outbreak of cunning warfare between two elite students in love.

278031.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War 2 (Dub Indo)
278031.evaluate:
At the renowned Shuchiin Academy, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya are the student body's top representatives. Ranked the top student in the nation and respected by peers and mentors alike, Miyuki serves as the student council president. Alongside him, the vice president Kaguya—eldest daughter of the wealthy Shinomiya family—excels in every field imaginable. They are the envy of the entire student body, regarded as the perfect couple.

However, despite both having already developed feelings for the other, neither are willing to admit them. The first to confess loses, will be looked down upon, and will be considered the lesser. With their honor and pride at stake, Miyuki and Kaguya are both equally determined to be the one to emerge victorious on the battlefield of love!

278033.title: TONIKAWA: Over the Moon For You -Uniform-
278033.evaluate: In the Arisugawa family, Tsukasa and Nasa are enjoying their first year of marriage. Although the two did have their fateful encounter, they did not have the typical high school experience of falling in love and uniform dating; instead, Tsukasa put on a uniform with the help of Aya. Nasa couldn't contain his excitement when he saw Tsukasa wearing a uniformed secretary. What dramatic event will befall the two individuals?
278033.seasonTitle: TONIKAWA: Over the Moon For You -Uniform-

278035.title: The Infinitors
278035.evaluate: An affluent white-collar worker receives a mysterious invitation: "Would you like to know what life is about?" "Would you like to live your life fully?" It is sent into the unpredictable space of the Lord God, and future human beings will invite and challenge the present world, and the different challenges that humans face during the era of great universe development will be simulated as copies as well. The "copies" will guide the selected people to overcome many traps, meet life-and-death comrades, and become leaders. All of this is in the interest of human evolution, survival, and infinite futures!

278036.title: Carp Reborn 3rd Season
278036.evaluate: Wang Sheng woke up in the modern world, everything was so real and dreamlike. Emergence of the imperial city, appearance of the young master of Family Dai confused the situation. Through a gambling game, Wang Sheng gradually realized it was not just an argument between him and the young master of Family Dai. As a result of the feast, people from all over the world gathered together, and Wang Sheng was once again called to stand in front of the stage. Although Wang Sheng knew that the fights on the field were far less than the dark tide under the field, he didn't realize that the people of the world were quietly becoming another gambling chip ... Even though the dream appeared to wake him suddenly, the key to breaking the situation remained hidden. The inscription nine words wheel is also quietly dialing...
episodeTitles: A Mirage in the Ruined City

278037.title: Chillin' in My 30s after Getting Fired from the Demon King's Army
278037.evaluate: The 30-year-old dark soldier Dariel who can't use magic while in an army of demons was fired for his insufficient capacities. Moreover, his desperate second life has begun in a human village where Dariel has arrived!
278037.seasonTitle: Chillin' in My 30s after Getting Fired from the Demon King's Army
episodeTitles: Dariel on His First Quest as an Adventurer
Dariel Goes to His Old Workplace

278038.title: SPY x FAMILY (English Dubbed)
278038.evaluate:
Corrupt politicians, frenzied nationalists, and other warmongering forces constantly jeopardize the thin veneer of peace between neighboring countries Ostania and Westalis.
