In spite of their plots, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" fulfills dangerous missions one after another in the hope that no child will have to experience the horrors of war.

In the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint, Twilight dons the alias of "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist. However, his true intention is to gather intelligence on prominent politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears rarely in public at his son's school: the prestigious Eden Academy. Enlisting the help of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar to act as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter, Loid enacts his master plan. He will enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where Loid hopes she will excel and give him the opportunity to meet Donovan without arousing suspicion.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his talents has trouble playing the figure of a loving father and husband. And just like Loid is hiding his true identity, Yor—who is an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to disclose their own secrets either. Although this picture-perfect family is founded on deception, the Forgers gradually come to understand that the love they share for one another trumps all else.

278039.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World
278039.evaluate:
After being betrayed by his companions, Haruyoshi, the strongest diviner, was on the verge of dying. Hoping to be happy in the next life, he attempted the secret reincarnation technique and was sent to another world!

Born into a family of magicians, the magic he didn't inherit paled in comparison to his previous abilities as an exorcist. "Who needs magic? I'll survive in this world with my old techniques!"
278039.seasonTitle: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

278040.title: Farming Life in Another World
278040.evaluate: Having died of sickness at 39 years old, Machio Hiraku is given the opportunity to go to another world. When asked what his wish is by God intends to give him strength, he requests to have a healthy body, offered a second wish, and he chooses to live peacefully. The third wish is to be able to know the local language, and the final wish is to be able to be a farmer.

278041.title: Giant Beasts of Ars
278041.evaluate: The great beasts created the land, but humans stole it. Angered, the beasts began eating humans, who in turn called upon the gods to fight the beasts. In the age of the sword, heroes and mythology, giant beasts are hunted by humans for profit. Jiro, who makes his living hunting beasts, encounters Kuumi, who is being chased by someone, and at that moment decides to save her...

278042.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (VN Dub)
278042.evaluate: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn‘t care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadow stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.
278042.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (VN Dub)

278043.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
278043.evaluate:
Along with three other heroes, 27-year-old Mukouda Tsuyoshi is transported into a fantasy world to rescue a kingdom from an unknown threat. However, his only skill turns out to be "Food Menu", which allows him to open an interface where he can purchase and obtain food-related supermarket items from modern Japan.

Tsuyoshi's ability to create delicious dishes unknown to this world soon pays dividends, even attracting the legendary wolf Fenrir. Fenrir is so taken in by the food and formed a contract with Tsuyoshi. Followed by this whimsical mythical being, Tsuyoshi takes up a job as a merchant and adventurer, traveling and cooking up mouth-watering meals that never fail to amaze the inhabitants of this world.
278043.seasonTitle: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
episodeTitles: My Absurd Skill is Unexpectedly Useful
The Salient Familiar is a Living Legend

278045.title: The Fruit of Evolution 2: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made
278045.evaluate: High school student Hiiragi Seiichi used to be bullied by his classmates for being a "loser". One day, the entire school is suddenly transported to a video game-like world of swords and sorcery. When he accidentally eats "the Fruit of Evolution," his life as a successful "winner" begins!
278045.seasonTitle: The Fruit of Evolution 2: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made
episodeTitles: It's Hard to be a Teacher

278048.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie(Thai Dub)
278048.evaluate: Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend: cute, fun to be around, sweet when she wants to be... but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right circumstances. And her boyfriend Izumi loves to be around when that happens!
278048.seasonTitle: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie(Thai Dub)

278049.title: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei（JPN Dub）
278049.evaluate: A 5000-year-old vegan dragon was living peacefully when one day a young girl showed up in his cave. She offered herself as a sacrifice in order to gain favor for her village. He played along as the great "Evil Dragon, the Demon Lord's Army Leader" in order to get rid of her. However, his little white lie awoke her hidden powers and his peaceful life suddenly ended.
278049.seasonTitle: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei（JPN Dub）

278050.title: Endo and Kobayashi Live! The Latest on Tsundere Villainess Lieselotte
278050.evaluate:
Otome villainess Liselotte seems foul in every way, a purely evil character. However, she was always hiding both her pain and her true feelings for Prince Siegward. While she keeps this locked away, an evil witch ultimately possesses her, leading to her demise—a tragic end for the tsundere villainess. This is how the story always goes, an end coded into the game MagiKoi.

Broadcasting club members Aoto Endou and Shihono Kobayashi decide to play this game. In another universe, Prince Siegward hears their voices, believing it to be a divine revelation from a god and goddess. These voices clue him into something he never noticed before: Liselotte is actually overwhelmingly adorable!
278050.seasonTitle: Endo and Kobayashi Live! The Latest on Tsundere Villainess Lieselotte
episodeTitles: A Wand, Max Limit, and Gods' Favor
Ribbons, an Upperclassman, and a Heart in Love

278051.title: Spy Classroom
278051.evaluate:
Lily, a beautiful girl with white locks, is a student in one of the many institutions that train youths into becoming capable spies. Unfortunately, with no real-world skills to speak of, her hopes of graduating are dismal—until she is offered an opportunity to join the mysterious team "Tomoshibi" and partake in an Impassable Mission.

Lily is struck dumb when she arrives at Kagerou Palace and the true purpose of Tomoshibi and its hopeless situation comes to light. Joined by other problematic female spies along with a mysterious young man spearheading the operation, Lily realizes that this is not the ideal escapade she had pictured.

278052.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2
278052.evaluate:
Second season of BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

After an enthusiastic invitation from her friend, Kaede Honjou reluctantly agrees to try New World Online: a very popular VRMMO played by thousands of people across Japan. Naming her in-game character Maple, she sets out on her journey. As a complete novice to such games, she allocates all of her stat points into vitality, desiring to not get hurt. With not a single point in any other stat, Maple has extraordinarily high defense, but she can't move quickly or hit hard.

Despite her overpowered character, Kaede has much to learn. As she progresses through the game, she meets new friends and acquaintances, helping her complete new levels and events. Through all of her adventures, she may even pick up some other crazy skills that exceed all expectations.
278052.seasonTitle: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2
episodeTitles: Defense Specialization and Fifth Floor and Sixth Floor
Defense Specialization and the Seventh Event

278053.title: Malevolent Spirits: Mononogatari
278053.evaluate:
Tsukumogami, spirits, or "marebito" can possess objects of considerable age and gain a physical form. Although he is part of the Saenome clan that is in charge of peacefully sending them back to their own world, Hyouma Kunato despises them because one took away what was very precious to him. 

To cure him of this loathing, Hyouma's grandfather sends him to live with Botan Nagatsuki, a girl who is the master of six "friendly" tsukumogami and lives with them as a family.

278054.title: Saving 80,000 Gold in Another World for my Retirement
278054.evaluate:
Mitsuha Yamano falls off a cliff, at which point she finds herself transported to some sort of medieval European fantasy world! While there, during a battle with some wolves that almost costs her her life, she realizes that she has the ability to shuffle between Earth and this new world. 

Mitsuha decides to use this ability as much as she can. Why? To save up for retirement! She sets her sights on saving eighty thousand gold coins!
278054.seasonTitle: Saving 80,000 Gold in Another World for my Retirement

278055.title: Ningen Fushin: Adventurers Who Don't Believe in Humanity Will Save the World
278055.evaluate: Nick used to be a member of a veteran adventurer party, helping his undisciplined friends with the accounts whenever he could. But what was his reward? Getting accused of embezzlement and kicked out by the leader he trusted and respected... Before long, he finds a few other jaded adventurers and kindred spirits, and together, they form their own unstoppable party!
278055.seasonTitle: Ningen Fushin: Adventurers Who Don't Believe in Humanity Will Save the World
episodeTitles: Apparently, Disillusioned Adventurers Will Save the World_EP01_en_Fingerlinks

278056.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
278056.evaluate: Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy's expectations by developing "magicology", a unique magical theory based on memories from her past life. Anisphia witnesses the noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom's next monarch one day. That's when Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name-which somehow involves them living together and researching magic! Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures but those of the kingdom...and the entire world!
278056.seasonTitle: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady

278057.title: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a
278057.evaluate: When alien forces invade with an army of Machines, the remnants of humanity must depend on Androids of their own design—the placid 2B and the excitable 9S—to survive.

278059.title: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible
278059.evaluate:
High school student Junta Shiraishi has a simple goal—to live a fulfilling youth. In fact, Shiraishi's lack of presence is so severe that people think his seat in class is always empty, and mistakenly assume that he often skips school. There is even a weird rumor, claiming that those who spot Shiraishi will be blessed with good fortune.

The only person who notices his existence is Nagisa Kubo, the girl seated next to him. Unfortunately for him though, Kubo likes to tease him on a daily basis. As Kubo's playful antics continue to involve the reluctant Shiraishi, he may soon discover that his youth might not be as boring as he initially thought.
278059.seasonTitle: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible
episodeTitles: The Heroine Girl and the Invisible Boy
Back Luck and a Visit to His Home

278060.title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire
278060.evaluate:
From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand. Having devoted his life to statecraft and his subjects' well-being, his one unfulfilled wish is to live again: a warrior's life he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power.

His patron goddess, Alistia, hears his plea and smiles upon him, flinging his soul into the far future. Goddesses work in mysterious ways—not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood!
278060.seasonTitle: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire

278061.title: In/Spectre Season 2
278061.evaluate:
In/Spectre Season 2
At the young age of 11, Kotoko Iwanaga was abducted by youkai for two weeks and asked to become their "God of Wisdom", a mediator between the spirit and human worlds, to which the girl quickly agreed but at the cost of her right eye and left leg. 

Kurou Sakuragawa, a 22-year-old university student, has just broken up with his girlfriend after he fled alone when the two encountered a kappa. Seeing this as her chance to become closer to him, Kotoko immediately makes her move, hoping to get married to Kurou one day. However, she quickly realizes there is something more to Kurou. With this knowledge, she asks for his help in solving the various issues presented by the supernatural, all the while wishing her newfound partner will eventually reciprocate her feelings.

278062.title: Bungo Stray Dogs 4
278062.evaluate:
Bungo Stray Dogs 4
The strange men were met by Atsushi Nakashima, a young man who was about to starve to death in the orphanage. He was busy diving and committing suicide, a man with suicidal habits, Osamu Dazai. The man with glasses looking at the notebook nervously, Kunikida alone. 

They are employees of the "Armed Detective Agency" rumored to resolve incidents in which the military and police cannot intervene. Thousands of strange literary heroes fighting with different abilities, this is the beginning!
episodeTitles: The Day is a Dream, The Night is Reality
Secret of the Detective Agency's Establishment

278063.title: Trigun Stampede
278063.evaluate:
A sandstorm rages in the land. The survivors of the human race live in a barren land of writhing and deformed creatures.

In this harsh world, there is one troublemaker with a bounty of $6 million, called "Human Typhoon". Rookie reporter Meryl Stryfe, together with drunken veteran reporter Roberto de Niro, is in search of a big scoop about the human typhoon, and they arrive at a gunfighter in a crimson coat, but what they encounter is a windbag who "never kills people" and is more good-natured than anyone else!

278064.title: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea
278064.evaluate:
A world blanketed in an endless and ever-growing ocean of snow. The people eke out a living, either huddled around the roots of enormous trees dotting the surface, or high in the canopy, which spreads over the planet's atmosphere.

A chance meeting between Kaina, a youth from the canopy, and Liliha, a young woman from the surface, sets off a chain of events that will change the fate of the world.
278064.seasonTitle: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea

278065.title: The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague
278065.evaluate:
Himuro is an office worker who belongs to a race of supernatural beings with strange powers. Whenever he is deep in concentration, he subconsciously plunges his poor coworkers into a close rendition of the Arctic. Even so, Himuro is a warm and kind person. 

Himuro has a soft spot for his colleague Fuyutsuki, a calm woman who has a knack for providing simple solutions to his unconventional problems. Fueled by immense adoration and desire, Himuro is prepared to do whatever it takes to capture her heart.
278065.seasonTitle: The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague
episodeTitles: The Day They Met in Spring and The Blizzard’s Premonition
Becoming One With the Ocean of Okinawa
First Dinner Together and the Secret Photo

278066.title: Handyman Saitou in Another World
278066.evaluate: Saitou is an ordinary handyman that gets transported to another world where his skills are very useful. He starts to really understand what it means to be needed.

278067.title: Sugar Apple Fairy Tale
278067.evaluate:
After her mother passes away, Ann decides to become a Silver Sugar Master like her mother. Ann leaves for the town of Lewiston, and in order to become a Silver Sugar Master, she has to win the top spot and receive a royal medal.

In this world, humans treat fairies as slaves and take one of their wings to control them. Ann reluctantly buys a fairy named Shall to be a bodyguard on her way to Lewiston. Ann is torn between setting Shall free and needing a bodyguard on the dangerous roads to the festival.
episodeTitles: The Sugar Apple Is a Tree of Betrayal

278068.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
278068.evaluate:
After catching a cold by giving his only umbrella to a girl sitting in the rain, Amane Fujimiya only expects her to eventually return it. However, Mahiru Shiina, the "Angel" of Amane's school and his neighbor, instead gives him a lot more than that. 

The only word Mahiru finds in her mouth to describe the chaos is "unsightly". But despite her unsympathetic description, Mahiru proceeds to help the hopeless Amane. Is there anything that the Angel can not do?
278068.seasonTitle: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten

278069.title: My Life as Inukai-san's Dog.
278069.evaluate: The story follows the protagonist who wakes up one day transformed as Pochita, a pet dog of his cool and beautiful classmate Karen Inukai!

278070.title: Sorcerous Stabber Orphen 3
278070.evaluate: Orphen is a powerful sorcerer who is notoriously lazy. Everything changes when he finds a way to save his sister, who was turned into a dragon during their days at the magic academy. Betrayed by friends who refused to help, Orphen will stop at nothing to track her down, even if he has to go it alone.
episodeTitles: The Spectres on the Execution Ground
The Magic Sword That Guides the Fate of My Life

278071.title: Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro 2nd Attack
278071.evaluate: One day, "Senpai" visits the library after school and becomes the target of a super sadistic junior! The name of the girl who teases, torments, and tantalizes Senpai is "Nagatoro!" She's annoying yet adorable. This is a story about an extremely sadistic and temperamental girl and you'll feel something awakened inside of you!
278071.seasonTitle: Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro 2nd Attack

278073.title: By the Grace of the Gods Season 2
278073.evaluate:
By the Grace of the Gods Season 2

One day, the life of middle-aged Japanese businessman Takebayashi Ryouma came to a rather sudden and disappointing end. Ryouma had never had a blessed life, but after his death, three great gods sought his cooperation and reincarnated him as a child in another world with swords and magic! 

Receiving a most cordial and divine welcome from the gods, Ryouma decides to live leisurely on his own in the forest for the time being. Working diligently at magic and hunting, Ryouma's greatest passion comes to be researching his tamed slimes?!
278073.seasonTitle: By the Grace of the Gods Season 2

278074.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
278074.evaluate:
Everyone knows of the most powerful soldier, the Iceblade Magician, Ray White. After weathering through a bloody war, Ray enrolls at Arnold Academy, ready to experience a normal life—a luxury he never had. To further this goal, he keeps his identity as the Iceblade Magician a secret.

Despite being ostracized for being a commoner, Ray befriends the prideful yet kind Amelia Rose, the muscle-brained Evy Armstrong, and the shy and bookish Elisa. However, Ray is tasked with hunting down a spy whose motives remain unclear...
278074.seasonTitle: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
episodeTitles: The World’s Strongest Young Sorcerer Enrols in the Academy of Sorcery
The World’s Strongest Young Sorcerer Begins to Train
The World’s Strongest Young Sorcerer Enjoys a Holiday

278075.title: Onimai: I'm Now Your Sister!
278075.evaluate: Mahiro Oyama was just a normal erotic-game-loving dude...until he woke up one morning as a girl! Turns out his mad-scientist little sister, Mihari, tried out one of her new experiments on him. But Mihari is as determined to study him as he wanted to go back to his shut-in and game-playing life... Life is going to get a whole lot weirder from here on out!
episodeTitles: Mahiro and the Amazing New Body

278076.title: What's Wrong with My Big Brother
278076.evaluate: Dongfang Xianyun, the big brother who finally recognized himself as the "big protagonist", fell into nothingness due to Dongfang Wuxian's misunderstanding. With the help of Bu Suantian, an envoy of the Tao of Heaven who was a time traveler, Dongfang Xianyun was forced to be reborn and once again involved in the battle between good and evil. The war intensified and everyone waited for Dongfang Xianyun's efforts to turn the tide, the big brother finally became reliable.
278076.seasonTitle: What's Wrong with My Big Brother

278080.title: The Dining of Link Lee 2
278080.evaluate: The small restaurant has ushered in a warm spring. The owner, Link Lee, and the cook Wu Di, who also loves cooking, have developed many new dishes for people. Regular customers come in an endless stream, and at the same time, many new faces have been attracted here with some new stories—a father and son who have an awkward relationship, college students who meet to participate in an animation competition, and a toy salesperson who speaks substandard Mandarin. They will find the taste they are most looking forward to in the small restaurant. The Dining of Link Lee season 2 now is available!

278081.title: My Cat Hates Me
278081.evaluate: A young manga artist whose inspiration gradually runs out on the road to creation accidentally adopts two pets when he goes out to find inspiration. The cat is named Huanghuang, and the dog is named Bazahei. Although the two little guys often brought a lot of trouble to the teenager, they also gained two pieces of companionship and love at the same time. Although they are a cat and a dog, the teenager knows that they are family. And then, the noisy but warm and happy life of the teenager began.

278083.title: X&Y
278083.evaluate: Yan Yuechu went back to his hometown to work and met new friends in the company he joined. After entering the XY Chamber of Secrets to play secret room games, he found himself attracted by the owner of the secret room, Xu Aiyou. However, this is the beginning of his falling into one another strange secret room illusion. At the same time, as Yan Yuechu got in touch with Xu Aiyou, more and more incidents happened around Yan Yuechu one after another, and these even involved his friends. In the process of cracking the secret room and finding the mastermind behind the incident, Yan Yuechu gradually came across the hidden truth of the incident...

278084.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san: The Movie
278084.evaluate: Takagi and Nishikata's final summer in junior high is about to begin, and it's already off to a heartwarming start! When the pair find an abandoned kitten, they decide to work together and take care of their adorable new companion until they can locate its missing mother. While searching, they also got new feelings about their relationship.

278085.title: The Last Summoner（JPN Dub）
278085.evaluate: This is a fiction world of Summoners. The person who can summon the spirits of all objects is called the Summoner. Since ancient times, the legend of the Summoners has been deeply embedded in the corner of history. In the new era, there are five Summoners who awaken to fight against the mysterious power. Five friends fight shoulder to shoulder to discover the truth in the Summoner world.

278086.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. (Dub Indo)
278086.evaluate:
After an enthusiastic invitation from her friend, Kaede Honjou reluctantly agrees to try New World Online: a very popular VRMMO played by thousands of people across Japan. Naming her in-game character Maple, she sets out on her journey. As a complete novice to such games, she allocates all of her stat points into vitality, desiring to not get hurt. With not a single point in any other stat, Maple has extraordinarily high defense, but she can't move quickly or hit hard.

This doesn't end badly for her, however. Due to her high defense, Maple acquires overpowered skills such as Total Defense, Poison Immunity, and Devour. These skills, along with the incredibly powerful items she obtains, allow her to obliterate most enemies in a single hit. After only a few days of playing the game, Maple claims third place in a server-wide event, gaining a reputation as a player who is both unkillable and absurdly powerful.

Despite her overpowered character, Kaede has much to learn. As she progresses through the game, she meets new friends and acquaintances, helping her complete new levels and events. Through all of her adventures, she may even pick up some other crazy skills that exceed all expectations.
278086.seasonTitle: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. (Dub Indo)

278087.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill(Thai Dub)
278087.evaluate:
Along with three other heroes, 27-year-old Mukouda Tsuyoshi is transported into a fantasy world to rescue a kingdom from an unknown threat. However, his only skill turns out to be "Food Menu", which allows him to open an interface where he can purchase and obtain food-related supermarket items from modern Japan.

Tsuyoshi's ability to create delicious dishes unknown to this world soon pays dividends, even attracting the legendary wolf Fenrir. Fenrir is so taken in by the food and formed a contract with Tsuyoshi. Followed by this whimsical mythical being, Tsuyoshi takes up a job as a merchant and adventurer, traveling and cooking up mouth-watering meals that never fail to amaze the inhabitants of this world.
278087.seasonTitle: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill(Thai Dub)

278090.title: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei (Thai Dub)
278090.evaluate: A 5000-year-old vegan dragon was living peacefully when one day a young girl showed up in his cave. She offered herself as a sacrifice in order to gain favor for her village. He played along as the great "Evil Dragon, the Demon Lord's Army Leader" in order to get rid of her. However, his little white lie awoke her hidden powers and his peaceful life suddenly ended.
278090.seasonTitle: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei (Thai Dub)

278091.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2 (Thai Dub)

278093.title: Chainsaw Man(Thai Dub)
278093.evaluate:
To spend quality time with the girl he likes and lead a contented life is Denji's simple and ordinary dream. This, however, is far from the truth because Denji's fate is to be made to kill demons by the gang in order to settle his enormous debt. Turning his pet demon Pochita into a weapon, Denji will use any means necessary to make money.

Unfortunately, the demon who had a deal with the gang killed him because he was no longer needed. Pochita, in a shocking turn of events, fuses with Denji's corpse and grants him the abilities of a chainsaw demon. The revived Denji uses his newfound abilities to swiftly and mercilessly eliminate his enemies. Denji gains the ability to transform certain parts of his body into a chainsaw. When the official witcher arrived on the scene, this attracted his attention, and the witcher hired Denji to work as one of them in the Public Security Bureau. Denji now has a strategy for defeating any foe, no matter how formidable, and he will go to any lengths to fulfill his simple teenage dream.

278094.title: Sword Art Online Alicization(Thai Dub)
278094.evaluate: The Soul Translator is a state-of-the-art full-dive interface which interacts with the user's Fluctlight—the technological equivalent of a human soul—and fundamentally differs from the orthodox method of sending signals to the brain. The private institute Rath aims to perfect their creation by enlisting the aid of Sword Art Online survivor Kazuto Kirigaya. He works there as a part-time employee to test the system's capabilities in the Underworld: the fantastical realm generated by the Soul Translator. As per the confidentiality contract, any memories created by the machine in the virtual world are wiped upon returning to the real world. Kazuto can only vaguely recall a single name, Alice, which provokes a sense of unease when mentioned in reality. When Kazuto escorts Asuna Yuuki home one evening, they chance upon a familiar foe. Kazuto is mortally wounded in the ensuing fight and loses consciousness. When he comes to, he discovers that he has made a full-dive into the Underworld with seemingly no way to escape. He sets off on a quest, seeking a way back to the physical world once again.

278096.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (1st Half)
278096.evaluate: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
278096.seasonTitle: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (1st Half)

278097.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S2(Thai Dub)
278097.evaluate: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn't care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadowed stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.
278097.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S2(Thai Dub)

278098.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S3 (Thai Dub)
278098.evaluate:
He killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam when he was six years old. Wang Ling, an omnipotent agriculture wizard, had to conceal his strength in order to exist amid a bunch of common cultivators. This young man is not concerned with the things that regular people are: money, magic, magic weapons, and reputation. He will continue to pursue the crisp noodles despite the affection of his wealthy daughter Sun Rong, the sharpshooter of the top murderer of the dark stream, and the unbroken discussion of his parents.

And now comes Season3 of The Daily Life of the Immortal King!
278098.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S3 (Thai Dub)

278099.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond
278099.evaluate: There is a small country to the west of Tempest called Raja. As Rimuru and his companions investigate the mysterious power of the queen, they become involved in a long-running conspiracy. During their journey, Rimuru and Benimaru meet another survivor of the ogre species, an old brother of Benimaru named Hiiro. What on earth happened to Hiiro? And what experience did he have with Benimaru...
278099.seasonTitle: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

278100.title: Summoned to Another World for a Second Time
278100.evaluate:
Eclair was called to save the planet since it was in peril due to the conflict between the Human, Beastman, and Demon races. He successfully accomplished his task and returned to the Human Land. But the Human King's trap, which was set up because he feared the Hero who had gained power would usurp him, was there to catch him. The Hero was trapped, subjected to transfer magic, and reborn as a baby in the present.

He attended high school under the name Suzaki Setsu 16 years later. Even though he was teased for being a depressing person who only reads books, he persisted in seeking a way to enter Isekai world once more. But all of a sudden, he touched down on the alien ground once more. summoned by the nation's hero this time, along with his other students.

Thankfully, he was called to Isekai five years later. After sneaking out of Humania, he made the decision to encounter characters like the venerable Demon King and the Beast King. This is the tale of the previous hero who lacks motivation, despite continuing to become entangled in evil plots.
278100.seasonTitle: Summoned to Another World for a Second Time
episodeTitles: Off on a Journey for a Second Time
An Ink-redible Recipe for a Second Time

278101.title: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
278101.evaluate:
Yukito Urabe's father was the patriarch of a strange group,
So Yukito was forced to accept the unreasonable practice of the religious group and then died...
impossible!
Yukito meets the popular Another World Tensei!
It was a world without the concepts of "God" and "Religion".
"Isn't this the ideal world for me!?"

But for some reason, Yukito still has to establish a "religion" in a godless world,
A Unique Another World Tensei story, Opening!!
278101.seasonTitle: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
episodeTitles: I Beseech You, Lady Mitama, Cleanse and Purify Me. With Reverence, I Pray.

278102.title: In Another World with My Smartphone 2
278102.evaluate:
15-year-old Touya Mochizuki, is unintentionally killed by God. In order to make amends, God permits his resurrection; however, since he is unable to bring him back to his previous existence, he is instead reincarnated into a fantastical realm along with any particular demands. Touya asked God to modify his request so that he may take his smartphone with him into the new realm. As a result, even though Touya cannot use it to communicate with his previous world, the phone can still work normally, access data from the old world, and use capabilities that are pertinent to his new world, including the GPS function to travel to areas that are fully identified on it.

Touya's magical, mental, and physical powers are also substantially enhanced as an additional expression of God's regret for the inconvenience of having to kill him. Touya makes the most of his second chance at life by making friends with a wide variety of people, mostly women and influential figures in the new society. With his new allies, he sets off to visit several nations, resolving political conflicts and trivial objectives while casually having fun.
278102.seasonTitle: In Another World with My Smartphone 2

278103.title: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too
278103.evaluate:
Yūya Tenjō, a young man has endured brutal treatment since he was young. The "portal to another realm" unlocked for him when he fought for his life! The [Big Demon Realm] is on the opposite side of the gate, and there are many ferocious monsters there.

Yūya, who had just made his maiden foray into a new planet, developed the capacity to be so powerful as to be vile. He persisted in fighting monsters, and his level continually increased. He was finally reincarnated as the strongest and most resilient youngster!

He saved the princess from the monster on a distant planet, where he was the subject of a contentious debate throughout the nation...? In the actual world, many girls started to eagerly pursue him...?

The youngster whose level has been elevated is lying in both the actual world and the other reality. This is where the fantastical tale of life-reversing action begins!
278103.seasonTitle: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too

278104.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead!
278104.evaluate: In Hell's Gate, Sion Bladen imprisoned the Demon King and his army. Sion returns to the fray to fight his sworn foe as the Demon King prepares to rise once more. Sadly, while trying to defend himself from the demons, farmer Touka Scott accidentally kills him in a pig trap he set. Necromancer Anri Haysworth is forced to assume the identity of Sion by putting Touka's perverse soul in his deceased body. The three mismatched protagonists, along with Touka's childhood friend Yuna Eunice, must succeed...

278105.title: The Aristocrat's Otherworldly Adventure: Serving Gods Who Go Too Far
278105.evaluate: The seven gods that live there help a Japanese teenager who is murdered by a thug to become Cain Von Silford, the third son of the illustrious Von Silford family, in an alternate, fantastical universe. Cain is chosen as their Apostle and bestowed with great blessings by the gods after accepting their offer to use the knowledge from his previous life to help them better their world. He is unaware that his true duty is to defend the planet from a forgotten, evil deity that is about to awaken.
278105.seasonTitle: The Aristocrat's Otherworldly Adventure: Serving Gods Who Go Too Far

278106.title: KONO SUBARASHII SEKAI NI BAKUEN WO!
278106.evaluate: One year before a certain useless goddess and NEET extraordinaire hit the scene, Megumin, the "Greatest Genius of the Crimson Magic Clan," is hard at work. Ever since a life-changing encounter in her youth, the young wizard has dedicated her every waking moment to the pursuit of the ultimate offensive magic, Explosion! (Well...every moment not spent hustling food from her self-proclaimed rival.) And while the big sister's away, the little one will play. On a routine trip into the woods, Megumin's little sister, Komekko, finds a strange black kitten. Little does she know that this cat plays a key role in unsealing a Dark God's tomb...
278106.seasonTitle: KONO SUBARASHII SEKAI NI BAKUEN WO!

278107.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride SEASON 2
278107.evaluate:
Chise Hatori, a 15-year-old Japanese girl, was sold for five million pounds at an auction to a tall masked gentleman. Abandoned at a young age and ridiculed by her peers for her unconventional behavior, she was ready to give herself to any buyer if it meant having a place to go home to. In chains and on her way to an unknown fate, she hears whispers from robed men along her path, gossiping and complaining that such a buyer got his hands on a rare "Sleigh Beggy."

Ignoring the murmurs, the mysterious man leads the girl to a study, where he reveals himself to be Elias Ainsworth—a magus. After a brief confrontation and a bit of teleportation magic, the two open their eyes to Elias' picturesque cottage in rural England. Greeted by fairies and surrounded by weird and wonderful beings upon her arrival, these events mark the beginning of Chise's story as the apprentice and supposed bride of the ancient magus.

Here is the Second Season of The Ancient Magus' Bride!
episodeTitles: Birds of a feather flock together. I
Birds of a feather flock together. II

278108.title: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
278108.evaluate: Rinko Hanasaki, a retaker who lived her life in the spotlight, passed away after being knocked to the ground by someone and learning that she had also passed the university she had her heart set on attending. Yet when she finally did awaken, she discovered that she had become Raeliana McMillan, a character from the fantasy book she had been reading. Raeliana made a pact with Noah Voltaire Wynknight, the heir to the throne of Chamos Kingdom, who wields enormous power in this world, knowing that he was the son of a noble family and would betray her by killing her fiancé. Bring it up and ask him to pose as her fiancé for a six-month period. Raeliana will so reside in his mansion as Noah Voltaire's fiancée…
278108.seasonTitle: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
episodeTitles: The Reason Why She Made the Deal
The Reason Why She Signed the Contract
The Reason Why She Trained to Become a Bride

278109.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
278109.evaluate:
To explain to Hotaru Haganezuk, the master swordsmith who forged Tanjiro's sword, why his sword was so severely injured, Tanjiro had to travel to a swordsmith village. And at that time the enemy drew near Tanjiro as he awaited the swordsmith to fix his sword... ...

On the other hand, Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Hashira, is engaged in a violent struggle with the demon, but things do not seem good and the conflict is escalating. Tanjiro and Genya, another demon slayer, are needed to assist him. Fighting two upper-rank demons at once would be bad enough. Moreover, each of these two demons can split into four new bodies, each of which has the ability to regenerate almost instantaneously. Would Tanjiro and the others be able to beat such a foe?
278109.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
episodeTitles: A Sword from Over 300 Years Ago

278110.title: Dr. STONE (Season 3)
278110.evaluate: A mysterious green light terrified the earth for an unidentified purpose, leading the modern society that humans had developed to cruelly retreat back to the primordial life that existed two million years before. Senku Ishigami, the story's protagonist, will use science and knowledge to recreate the tremendous scientific society in this stone world after 3,700 years have passed in order to save all of the earth's petrified inhabitants.

278111.title: DEAD MOUNT DEATH PLAY
278111.evaluate:
In another world, the Corpse God is reincarnated into the body of a young person who was recently murdered in Shinjuku during a fight to the death between the Calamity Crusher and a legendary necromancer known as the Corpse God.

The only thing the Corpse God wants is to live in peace, but as long as there are people out there who still support the execution of his host, true tranquility is elusive. It becomes much more difficult when Shinjuku's inhabitants, such as the police, troublemakers, and other oddball people, start developing personal relationships with the Corpse God himself. Yet, the Corpse God is too old and patient to be so easily discouraged, and he is eager to face new enemies in order to defend fresh allies and the tranquility they bring.

But, life on both sides of the sky promises to be anything but serene with an entity simultaneously boring a hole between Earth and the Other World.

278112.title: Ranking of Kings: The Treasure Chest of Courage
278112.evaluate:
Ranking of Kings Second Season Treasure Chest of Courage

The youthful Prince Bojji, who is deaf and mute, is despised by the populace of the kingdom. They mock his alleged folly, calling him "The Useless Prince."
Bojji isn't very powerful physically, but he's definitely not a coward. Instead of traumatizing him, a fortuitous meeting with a shadow monster leads him to assume that he has found a friend among others who only prefer to focus on his flaws. He begins meeting with Kage, the shadow, frequently to the point that even the usually hostile animal starts to like him.
The prince's quest to overcome his anxieties and doubts is beginning to take shape thanks to the unexpected connection that Kage and Bojji have developed. Bojji decides to achieve his goal of becoming the finest monarch he can be despite the ongoing mockery he endures.
278112.seasonTitle: Ranking of Kings: The Treasure Chest of Courage
episodeTitles: Kage the Errand Boy/Prince and Money

278113.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War -The First Kiss That Never Ends-
278113.evaluate: The vice-president Kaguya Shinomiya and the president of the student council, Miyuki Shirogane, met in the student union of Shuzhiin Academy. After a long battle of love and brains, the two geniuses finally expressed their hearts to each other. "First kiss. However, the two still did not make a clear confession. They thought they were about to become lovers, but they still maintained an ambiguous relationship. Instead, they became more concerned about each other, and the two welcomed Christmas like this. Shirogane, who "desires to be perfect", and Kaguya, who pursues him "imperfectly", this is an extremely "ordinary" love story of geniuses
278113.seasonTitle: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War -The First Kiss That Never Ends-

278114.title: Skip and Loafer
278114.evaluate: Mitsumi Iwakura, a high school student from a sparsely populated rural area studying in Tokyo, previously had a wonderful life plan but ran into significant difficulties on the first day. The simple countryside is entirely different from this. The dynamics of interpersonal connections are extremely complex, especially in large cities and in schools. The daily rituals of city dwellers are very intricate! Ssuke Shima, a laid-back freshman in high school and a casual gentleman, approached her just as she was becoming perplexed.

278115.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts
278115.evaluate:
The girl who was sacrificed as the 99th sacrifice of the King of Beast Families, Sariphi.
She attended the sacrifice ceremony after accepting her fate.
Yet she also got married as a concubine after learning the truth about the feared monarch "Leonhart" who no one dared to approach. The story between a girl and a Beast King has started...
278115.seasonTitle: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts

278116.title: A Galaxy Next Door
278116.evaluate:
Ichiro Kuga struggled day in and day out to raise his younger brother and sister alone when his father passed away after he graduated from high school and started working as a manga artist.

Shiori Goshiki, a god-level helper who is both competent and attractive, appears to him in this manner. Goshiki is like a lifesaver to Kuga, whose deadline is drawing near, but all of a sudden, she said, "I am the princess of the Shooting Star People, and I have concluded a marriage contract with you." A warm romantic comedy of two People who are new to love, which began with a "marriage contract," starts!

278117.title: My Love Story With Yamada-kun at Lv999
278117.evaluate:
When her boyfriend cheats on her with a woman he met online, Akane Kinoshita, a female college student, is informed to break up, which is the worst thing that can happen. Akane started to play internet games to fit the subject. The character born with her boyfriend's affection is the only thing that is still at her side.
Akane lost herself in the online game's hunting grounds in an effort to release the pressure, where she accidentally encountered "Yamada" from the same guild. He heard Akane's complaints about her failed romance and sneered, "I'm not interested," in response. Akane, however, heard this statement once more during an offline gathering she attended to reconnect with her ex-boyfriend after growing more attractive.
That encounter with "Yamada" was fateful—!
278117.seasonTitle: My Love Story With Yamada-kun at Lv999
episodeTitles: This is Why I’ve Had Enough With Gamer Boys!!
It’s Almost Time for the Boss to Spawn
I Wanna Do an Offline Meeting <3

278118.title: 【Oshi No Ko】
278118.evaluate:
In the entertainment industry, lying is the weapon.
Every day, Goro, an obstetrician and gynecologist who works in a small city, leads a life unrelated to the entertainment business.
Yet, the idol Hoshino Ai that he "followed" started to move up the list of stars.
Such two realized their worst-case scenario, and from that point on, the wheels of fate started to turn.

278119.title: Alice Gear Aegis Expansion
278119.evaluate:
The mechanical life form "Weiß" suddenly attacks in the future, forcing people to flee the planet and travel into the cosmos. Space Fleet SHARD created Alice Gear, a high-dimensional suit of armor that enables humans to combat Weiß, during the time of the breakout, and dubbed the excellent ladies who are suitable for using it Actress.
After being recognized by the Weiß organization "AEGiS," private enterprise actresses can eventually seek to evict Weiß, and thus marks the beginning of the tale of ladies wearing "Alice Gear" rescuing roving aliens!
episodeTitles: Actress vs. Maintenance Team/Welcome to Actress Cafe!
Terrifying! The Nightmare of Narukozaka/Ninja Raiya Spin-Off!

278120.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2
278120.evaluate:
Nasa Yuzaki, a boy with a peculiar name, gets hit by a truck on the day of his high school entrance exams. He encounters and follows a beautiful girl who saves him, confessing his love for her at a bus stop. The girl, Tsukasa Tsukuyomi, agrees to become his girlfriend, but only if they are married first...
Let's wait and see what happens in season two!
278120.seasonTitle: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

278121.title: The Girl Downstairs
278121.evaluate: As a freshman, Yuan Juntang applied to Minsong University to get nearer to his senior Zhu Zhu, with whom he had been secretly in love. The two ended up becoming friends and approached Zhu Zhu after unintentionally running into Li Shiya, the former idol and senior sister who had left school. They come together as a trio of pals. Yuan Juntang's admiration for her was evident to Zhu Zhu, but she lacked the guts to accept and steered away from any unclear interactions with him while remaining distant from her friends.

278122.title: OTAKU ELF
278122.evaluate:
The well-known temple, which can be found in Tsukishima, Chuo-district, Tokyo, has a more than 400-year history. The god it honors is a home-sleeping elf who was brought to Japan during the Edo period from a foreign world, but who now exclusively spends the day at the shrine, is terrified of social situations, and is obsessed with video games, anime, and figurines.

Koito Koganei, a Shinto family member and Shinko Miko's daughter, has struggled to serve this spirit god. A snow-white woman who appeared in front of her on a snowy day ten years ago was the object of her heart's desire...

278123.title: Too Cute Crisis
278123.evaluate: Liza Luna is an alien from the advanced culture of the galactic empire Azatos, which rules over a number of worlds. Liza is sent to explore Earth as a part of the survey team in preparation for its invasion. She initially intended to destroy Earth since its culture is far more primitive than hers, but after going by a café and seeing a cat—a species that is "too cute" and cannot be found on any other planet in the universe—she starts to change her mind.

278125.title: Yuri Is My Job!
278125.evaluate: Hime is a high school student who puts a lot of effort into maintaining the image of a kind, selfless princess, but on the inside, she just cares about herself. But when she unintentionally injured Mai, the manager of a café, she is prepared to work extra hours to maintain her persona. Hime eventually finds work as a waitress at a venue that is half café, part theater, where all the waitresses pose as students at Liebe Girls Academy, a made-up all-girls boarding school. Hime is lured to another waitress at the café who shows Hime unheard-of affection and devotion in front of the customers. But, the girl appears to despise her guts in secret.

278126.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead!
278126.evaluate: In Hell's Gate, Sion Bladen imprisoned the Demon King and his army. Sion returns to the fray to fight his sworn foe as the Demon King prepares to rise once more. Sadly, while trying to defend himself from the demons, farmer Touka Scott accidentally kills him in a pig trap he set. Necromancer Anri Haysworth is forced to assume the identity of Sion by putting Touka's perverse soul in his deceased body. The three mismatched protagonists, along with Touka's childhood friend Yuna Eunice, must succeed...

278129.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Infiltration Arc
278129.evaluate:
Before the broadcast of Kimetsu no Yaiba: Swordsmith Village Arc, we decided to broadcast a special edition of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc!

In pursuit of a demon that has been terrorising Yoshiwara's red light district, Tanjirou, Zenitsu, and Inosuke head to the entertainment district with the help of Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui.

This is part of the content of infiltration into the entertainment district!
278129.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Infiltration Arc
episodeTitles: Demon Slayer: Entertainment District Infiltration Arc

278134.title: Monster but Wild
278134.evaluate: The player Dongdong mistakenly entered the game world "Azure" and changed into the skeleton, the weakest wild creature. The unidentified Dongdong used his years of gaming experience to amass a band of wild monsters early on. He met the main character Bubble, made a deal with her to become her strongest pet, and then set off on an amusing and thrilling adventure with Bubble and his new pals in "Azure." The phenomenon of NPCs and wild monsters in the game gradually awakening and yearning for the human world was also identified at this time by Dongdong. To learn the truth and get back to your regular life. The main character group, lead by Dongdong, as well as awakened NPCs, regular players, game developers, and other entities started to debate how the two worlds were connected.

278135.title: The Ravages of Time
278135.evaluate: During the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Dong Zhuo overthrew the government, kidnapped the emperor to command the princes, and held the princes' relatives captive. Following that, Lv Bu's strategy was for burning Luoyang while luring the Allied forces into the urn. The allied troops devised their own special strategies to free the hostages, amorous characters stepped on stage, and the stage of overlords and heroes is about to start.

278137.title: Since I Wasn't the Heroine
278137.evaluate: An important town on the Daqi Kingdom's northern border, Baicheng, was attacked by Beiyi using a strategy. Baicheng's guard Tang Yao led his followers in a valiant effort to fight back, but they were overpowered and all fell victim to sacrifice. Tang Ying, the second daughter, was the only one to live. The fact that his father gave his life in defense of the nation but was then accused of working with the enemy only makes Tang Ying furious. Tang Yingyi traveled to the capital to replace her father but discovered that things were more complicated than she had anticipated. Is Yuan Lang, the Daqi Kingdom's second prince who has been held captive for years, connected to Beiyi? Why is the woman acting so oddly while purporting to be herself? Is Yuan Lang, the Daqi Kingdom's second prince and long-time captive, connected to Beiyi? Why is the lady who is impersonating herself so oddly similar to herself? What ever became of the unearthly individual Yao Niang from the film department was referring to? There are also some oddly familiar recollections that jitterily surfaced. For Tang Ying to solve, there are just too many puzzles.

278138.title: My Heroic Husband
278138.evaluate: In an alternate reality, the commercial elite known as Yining migrated to the Wu Dynasty and took the surname Ning and the given name Yi. Yining just concealed his well-known business skills in the virtual world since he had always dreamed of becoming a generation of martial arts superstars. Unexpectedly, the world's morals are more complex than he anticipated. In addition to being involved in significant legal proceedings after becoming Ning Yi, the Su family he joined was also in danger from formidable foes.

278142.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Decisive Battle Arc
278142.evaluate:
Before the broadcast of Kimetsu no Yaiba: Swordsmith Village Arc, we decided to broadcast a special edition of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc!

In pursuit of a demon that has been terrorising Yoshiwara's red light district, Tanjirou, Zenitsu, and Inosuke head to the entertainment district with the help of Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui.

This part is the decisive battle in the entertainment district!
278142.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Decisive Battle Arc
episodeTitles: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Decisive Battle Arc

278145.title: Reincarnated as a Sword(Thai Dub)
278145.evaluate:
The Black Cats tribe suffers the dreadful fate of being hunted, enslaved, and slain. Fran, a twelve-year-old girl of the persecuted race, yearns for vengeance for the crimes committed against her people. She fantasizes about a brighter future, one for which she is willing to get her hands filthy. A meeting with a talking sword, a reborn man yearning for a beautiful wielder, proves to be the turning point in her fate.

The young Fran plans to recover her kin's glory and honor with the help of her new comrade, chopping down all her foes along the way. She begins on a quest with her amazing sword and unwavering resolve.

278148.title: My Home Hero
278148.evaluate: Tetsuo Tosu, an unimportant office worker who adores his only daughter Reika, first encounters Reika after she started living alone due to her job but discovers that she has bruises on her face. Tetsuo followed a man who appeared to be a prisoner after spotting him on the way home. He sneaks back to his daughter's apartment the following day, but something happens that alters their entire family's course of events. The father started along the Shura path for the benefit of his daughter and the family. A thrilling, climactic story starts.

278150.title: Mashle: Magic and Muscle
278150.evaluate:
Everyone in this world takes having access to magic for granted. There is a young man who labors arduously to develop his muscles in the depths of the forest in the magical realm. Mash Burnedead is his name, and he has a secret: he is incapable of using magic.
He desired to live a tranquil life with his family, but one day he was unexpectedly targeted for death and compelled to enroll in a magic school in order to compete for the title of "Divine Visionary," the top student.
Can he use his time-honed muscles to his advantage in front of expert magicians?
The odd magical fantasy story's first line is "Brush all magic with the power of hard effort"!
episodeTitles: Mash Burnedead and the Body of the Gods
Mash Burnedead and the Mysterious Maze
Mash Burnedead and the Baleful Bully

278151.title: Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury Season2
278151.evaluate:
A.S. (Ad Stella) 122―
It is an era in which a number of corporations have entered space and have built a vast economic system. The Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group, dominates the mobile suit industry with a lone girl from Mercury transferring to it. The girl's name is Suletta Mercury. She walks step by step through a new world with a scarlet light burning in her heart.

And now comes the second half of this story...
278151.seasonTitle: Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury Season2

278152.title: BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls’ Story- Season 2
278152.evaluate: In a certain European country, there is Navres. Eve, blessed with genius golfing talent, makes a living by betting on the sport every day. One fateful day, she crosses paths with Aoi Tenzuru, the heiress of a major corporation and a golf prodigy. Two geniuses from utterly different worlds—just one swing was enough to pierce each other’s hearts. There’s Eve, whose shots are like iridescent bullets—“Rainbow Barrett”—and Aoi, the carefree “innocent‑yet‑domineering tyrant” who simply revels in the pure joy of golf. The two are drawn to one another, influence each other, and transform as they go—the tale of these golfing girls, their talents colliding in dazzling sparks.  The world’s first original anime series centered on women’s golf, now begins!  “Soar high and take flight to the world!”
episodeTitles: The Truth That Lies Dormant in the Girl’s Memories
The Reason Just Playing Golf Makes Me So Happy
The Strange Fates of Two Generations of Young People Who Were Caught up in the Ego of Adults

278153.title: EDENS ZERO 2
278153.evaluate: There are countless unsolved secrets and numerous crises lurking in this enormous cosmos. Walking alone yourself is unavoidably boring, but as the guy runs into his friends, everything starts to get interesting. The voyage to the farthest reaches of the universe is no longer a solo trek; rather, it requires a group effort to battle. This combination of brave hearts creates the power of one plus one larger than two, and a new journey is revealed to them.
episodeTitles: A Wind Blows Through the Sakura Cosmos

278155.title: One Piece Film Red
278155.evaluate:
Uta, the diva who drove the whole world insane.
Although her life history is unknown, her singing is regarded as coming "from another dimension".
She will perform this time, showing the world her true colors for the first time. Luffy and his companions, as well as numerous pirates, members of the navy, and admirers from all over the world, gathered in the venue to enjoy her music.
High-profile tunes from around the globe are set to echo here.
However, the unexpected revelation that Uta is "Shanks's daughter"? Now the story starts!

278156.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc (Thai Dub)
278156.evaluate:
To explain to Hotaru Haganezuk, the master swordsmith who forged Tanjiro's sword, why his sword was so severely injured, Tanjiro had to travel to a swordsmith village. And at that time the enemy drew near Tanjiro as he awaited the swordsmith to fix his sword... ...

On the other hand, Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Hashira, is engaged in a violent struggle with the demon, but things do not seem good and the conflict is escalating. Tanjiro and Genya, another demon slayer, are needed to assist him. Fighting two upper-rank demons at once would be bad enough. Moreover, each of these two demons can split into four new bodies, each of which has the ability to regenerate almost instantaneously. Would Tanjiro and the others be able to beat such a foe?
278156.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc (Thai Dub)

278157.title: The Eminence in Shadow (Thai Dub)
278157.evaluate:
People aspire to be great heroes and evil villains, but Cid Kagenou is not one of them. He aspires to be the true brain behind it all, pulling the strings and directing the entire plot. He was unable to attain his objectives in his prior existence in modern-day Japan. But now, resurrected into a magical world, he will demonstrate the true majesty of darkness!

As Cid poses as an ordinary mobster, he recruits members for his (false) group Shadow Garden, which aims to bring down the enigmatic cult that lurks in the shadows. Cid leads his (fictional) organization against the filthy (yet unexpectedly real) Diabolos Cult with plenty of ad-libs.

278158.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Aria of a Starless Night
278158.evaluate:
This is the tale of "Flash" and "Swordsman in Black" before their respective names were given to them.
By the Sword Art Online game's administration, the real-world death and virtual death are directly related. Following the announcement, there were bewildered yells from every participant throughout the entire game. One of them, Yuuki Asuna, a junior high school student in the third grade who had never played any online games, set out to conquer the intangible steel floating city known as "Aincrad" without having any knowledge of the laws of the outside world...
278158.seasonTitle: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Aria of a Starless Night

278159.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Scherzo of Deep Night
278159.evaluate:
Since 10,000 players were imprisoned in the game's virtual reality environment for more than a month, the first VRMMORPG "Sword Art Online" has devolved into a death game.
One day, the Raiders mission appears to be going well with the assistance of a female informant Argo, but...
A shadowy person is moving about in the shadows behind the scenes.
A threat other than "The Raiders" arrived, and Asuna and Kirito were entangled in a perilous back-to-back fight with death...!
278159.seasonTitle: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Scherzo of Deep Night

278180.title: JJ LIN “HAPPILY PAINFULLY AFTER” LIVE PREMIERE
278180.evaluate:
This is more than just a debut concert.
Swept into the vortex of time,
a live performance up close,
every corner alive with heartfelt faces.
Sometimes singing out loud in harmony,
sometimes listening in quiet.
Falling in an instant, then slowly rising again—
a live show where songs from the heart layer upon layer weave our lives together.

Road to JJ20:
No expectations,
dreaming inward,
gazing at the light outward.
A journey of stumbles and falls,
crafted into notes and brought to life.
Truly here, truly now.
This moment is a comma;
the future holds the courage to return to the beginning.
Happiness isn’t far away—
278180.seasonTitle: JJ LIN “HAPPILY PAINFULLY AFTER” LIVE PREMIERE

278183.title: Am I Actually the Strongest?
278183.evaluate:
I, a Hikikomori, was suddenly reincarnated into a prince in a different realm, but because of my weak magical abilities, I was doomed to die on my very first day of existence.

I came upon a huge creature right when I thought I was alone in the far-off forest.

I attempted to use magic to fight the monster in order to defend myself, but for some reason, the monster changed into a gorgeous female and even became my servant!

In a daze, I became a "Devil King" and began a new harem life!

278184.title: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1
278184.evaluate:
Ryota Sato, who works in an unethical company, has been relocated to a different planet! However, despite his best efforts, the level was only level 1.

Despite the level being unchangeable, Ryota has a super intrinsic skill with an all-S rank drop rate that can drop items that enhance power and are otherwise impossible to get.

Ryota continually develops his skills to become stronger. Despite only being at level 1, his ability value is MAX!
278184.seasonTitle: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1
episodeTitles: A Human Dropped by a Slime
Kill All the Little Black Things

278185.title: Reign of the Seven Spellblades
278185.evaluate: New first-year students arrive at Kimberly Magic Academy in the spring. Oliver Horn, a young man with a burning desire to carry out a purpose, is one of this year's class. Oliver's goal is to get revenge on the Kimberly's faculty members who murdered his mother brutally, but when he meets Nanao Hibiya, a samurai girl from the far-off country of Yamatsu, he finds himself torn between his ambition and his attraction to her. Oliver meets numerous other pupils along with her, and he quickly makes friends with them. Will these friendships hurt Oliver's revenge? The fact that there has never been a single student death at Kimberly Academy was also revealed to him and the other first-years during the admission ceremony. The seven years of torment will Oliver and his friends be able to endure?

278186.title: Classroom for Heroes
278186.evaluate:
The hero is a "super creature"!?
Blade, a previous hero who battled the Demon Lord and lost all of his strength. As he desired, he should have logically been an average student, but the school he attended was actually a top-tier institution for hero cultivation?
Of course, the students who attend are top-notch. While Blade was previously an "authentic" hero, he is now too heroic in terms of his "mind," "body," and "skills"!? He insulted the king in addition to destroying the majority of the school building during the practical class! He can even eat pork cutlet curry alone when the school is in a frenzy since the Dragon Clan escaped!?

During a worldwide conflict in 2010 known as the Second Pacific War, the once-proud country was reduced to rubble and mockingly renamed to Area 11.
However, one student plans to free Japan from Britannia's control through an extraordinary rebellion. His name is Lelouch Lamperouge, and he is fueled with hatred for the Empire, plotting to wipe its accursed name off the face of the planet. Lelouch's malicious plans are unexpectedly accelerated upon meeting the mysterious woman C.C., who grants him a supernatural ability known as Geass that makes anyone Lelouch commands unable to defy his will.
Now armed with a devastating power, Lelouch assumes the persona of Zero, a revolutionary figure who carries the hopes and dreams of the oppressed around the world. He vows to restore the glorious nation of Japan and deliver divine retribution to Britannia.
278300.seasonTitle: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch I - Koudou
episodeTitles: Code Geass - Lelouch of the Rebellion I - Initiation

278302.title: The Eminence In Shadow 2nd Season
278302.evaluate:
Cid Kagenou is not one of those people who aspires to be heroic heroes or terrible villains. He wants to be the actual mastermind, the one who controls everything and plots the entire scheme. In his previous life in present-day Japan, he was unable to accomplish his goals. But now that he has been revived in a fantastical realm, he will show off the true power of the night!

Cid recruits members for his (fake) group Shadow Garden, which seeks to dismantle the mysterious cult that hides in the shadows, while assuming the persona of an everyday mobster. With a lot of improv, Cid leads his (fantasy) group in battle against the evil Diabolos Cult, which turns out to be unexpectedly real. Let's stay tuned for the 2nd Season!

278306.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Rebellion
278306.evaluate: His vision will upend the world—Lelouch, as the masked rebel Zero, steadily strengthens the anti‑Britannian Black Knights; meanwhile, Kallen is appointed as the personal knight of the Third Princess, Euphemia. Each has found their own stage to wield their power, yet at this moment, a fateful turning point quietly approaches. As Deputy Governor of Area 11, Euphemia announces the establishment of the administrative zone “Japan”; however, if that zone comes to fruition, the very reason for the Black Knights’ existence will vanish. To break the deadlock, Lelouch resolves to meet with Euphemia. Determined to protect what he holds dear, Lelouch has long since accepted his resolve. Yet the price of the Geass grants him only a flicker of hope, one soon eclipsed by the weight of age‑old ambition, as the gears of fate inexorably grind toward tragedy.
278306.seasonTitle: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Rebellion
episodeTitles: Code Geass - Lelouch of the Rebellion II - Transgression

278308.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Emperor
278308.evaluate:
Lelouch Lamperouge's dreams of destroying the Holy Britannian Empire are slowly crumbling. His sister, Nunnally, has been kidnapped by Schneizel el Britannia, and Suzaku Kururugi is ignoring his desperate pleas for assistance. The Black Knights are slowly losing faith in Lelouch as their leader, and the United Federation of Nations has declared global war on Britannia.
Having suffered numerous betrayals, a significant loss of power, and an ever-growing resentment towards Emperor Charles zi Britannia, the crippled Lelouch makes a final decision: if he can't destroy the Empire from the outside, he will take it for himself from within.
278308.seasonTitle: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Emperor
episodeTitles: Code Geass - Lelouch of the Rebellion III - Glorification

278310.title: GOBLIN SLAYER II
278310.evaluate:

It is stated that crustling goblins are the only ones who have risen to the silver level (ranked third) in this frontier guild....a divine officer I joined the team for the first time after becoming an adventurer and experienced a crisis during the trip. And it was this man known as the "goblin killer" who rescued her.
He is not afraid to labor hard and solely focuses on sweeping goblins. The tossing goddess officer, the counter girl who is grateful for him, and the cowherd girl who is waiting for his childhood sweetheart are all standing behind him. October 2023, Season 2 starts!

Then, a stunning student from the Holy Sword Academy by the name of Riselia asks him, "Why were you imprisoned in such a place? Now everything is OK; your big sister will take care of you." Leonis, who is under Riselia's custody, is dismayed to discover how drastically things have altered. Leonis finds himself enrolling in the Holy Sword Academy, bewildered and puzzled. What gonna Leonis do?

278313.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 2
278313.evaluate:
Corrupt politicians, fervent nationalists, and other warmongering elements regularly undermine the fragile peace between Ostania and Westalis. Regardless of their designs, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" completes risky missions one after the other in the hope that no kid will have to witness the horrors of war.

Twilight assumes the alias "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist, in the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint. His genuine purpose, however, is to gather intelligence on important politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears in public on rare occasions at his son's school, the elite Eden Academy. Loid enacts his master plan by enlisting the services of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter. He'll enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where he expects she'll succeed and allow him to see Donovan without raising suspicions.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his abilities struggles to portray the role of a loving father and spouse. And, just as Loid is keeping his true identity hidden, Yor—an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to reveal their own. Despite the fact that their picture-perfect family is built on lie, the Forgers gradually realize that their love for one another is more important than anything else. Now let's stay tuned for the Season 2!
episodeTitles: Bond's Strategy to Stay Alive, Damian's Field Research Trip
Mission and Family, The Elegant Bondman, The Heart of a Child/Waking Up

278315.title: Butareba: The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig
278315.evaluate:
I am a lowly otaku who fainted after eating raw pork liver.
I thought I was reborn into another realm, but instead I became a pig!
I was lying in a pig pen when Jess, a girl who is reputed to be able to see into people's emotions, came to my rescue.
Huh! So adorable! The immaculate white from the hem of the skirt can be seen from the perspective of a pig...
"Well, I think I can hear your inner voice..." Oops! "Desire has been revealed!"Take a peek if you really want to—" Hey, wait a minute...!
I am willing to accept my animal-like needs (despite my shyness), and a life of being cared for by such an innocent girl. that, being a pig isn't that horrible, is it?
This story, or so it should be, describes our tremendous adventure.
But, Jess, why do people keep attempting to murder you?
278315.seasonTitle: Butareba: The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig
episodeTitles: Otakus Enjoy Being Treated Like Pigs
Even a Pig Will Dance If You Flatter Them Enough
You Must Not Fall in Love with Your Oshi

278316.title: A Playthrough of a Certain Dude's VRMMO Life
278316.evaluate:
Taichi Tanaka, a regular company employee who enjoys gaming, has entered the realm of "One More Free Life Online," a new sort of VRMMO with a great degree of freedom.

In a world where you can fight enemies with all your might or take risks at your leisure, he chose an unobtrusive gaming technique that required him to develop talents that were deemed useless!

He occasionally creates a slew of labor-intensive remedies, occasionally creates extremely tasty feasts, and occasionally creates incredible weapons with his own hands to enjoy hunting monsters!

Today, the humble uncle continues to forge his own path in the fantasy VRMMO!

Sei, a 20-year-old office worker, is transported to a whole different universe. Unfortunately for Sei, the ceremony that summoned her—meant to generate a "Saint" who would dispel the bad magic—brought over two persons rather than one. And everyone likes the other girl to Sei?! But this is great with Sei, who quits the royal palace to open a shop selling potions and cosmetics made with her newly discovered power. Business is growing, and life may not be that awful after all...as long as her purported Sainthood doesn't come back to haunt her.
And in October 2023, the Season 2 is available!

278330.evaluate: "I won't let my loved ones die again now that I'm back!" The Shadow Labyrinth is the most terrible situation humanity has ever encountered. One of the six human survivors still alive is Desir Arman. The six made an effort to escape the last stage of the labyrinth, but finally were unsuccessful, and the world ended. But just when Desir believed he was going to die, the world is revealed to him. it was thirteen years ago? Desir is transported back in time to the period when he joined in Havrion, the best magic school in the country. In order to rescue the planet and his loved ones, he is ready to alter the history after being reunited with his cherished pals. There are still three years till the Shadow World appears. Change the past and assemble strong allies to save humanity!
278330.seasonTitle: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

278332.title: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me
278332.evaluate:
"I, I like you!" "Eh... you like me?"
Ryuto Kajima is a high school student with an odd attitude.
He also admired Runa Shirakawa, who made her love declaration while they were playing punishment games, and they were both at the top of the school hierarchy pyramid.
But I received a surprising response: "Well, I'm single now anyway."
and got serious about her.
Ryuto pursues Runa once more and overhears the attractive football club player confessing to her.
Runa, who had recently begun dating her, led her back to her room.
Live each day astounded by the contrasts between one other, accepting each other's days, whether they are two people with utterly dissimilar friends or pastimes. Then...the two grew up and gradually united.
This is where a heartwarming love tale starts for everyone who reads it!
