278857.evaluate: Ein's job as "Appraiser" has placed him as far from the "hero" pedestal as possible in a mythical world where "jobs" are divinely assigned from birth. Heroes are born, not created. After being mistreated and subsequently left behind by his fellow explorers, Ein concludes it is simply not worth continuing. However, Ein is fortunate that the end may also be the beginning—and a fresh start. His "worthless" work might actually be the secret to becoming a hero after all.
278857.seasonTitle: Even Given the Worthless "Appraiser" Class, I'm Actually the Strongest (Dub Indo)

278858.title: Blue Exorcist -Beyond the Snow Saga-(Thai Dub)
278858.evaluate:
The truth about the "Blue Night" and the mystery surrounding Okumura Rin and Yukio's birth are revealed in "The End of the Night."
The central mystery of "Blue Exorcist" is ultimately revealed in the story.
278858.seasonTitle: Blue Exorcist -Beyond the Snow Saga-(Thai Dub)

278860.title: WIND BREAKER Season 2
278860.evaluate:
The lone delinquent high schooler, Sakura, arrives at the infamous Furin High, known as the ultimate school for delinquents, aiming to rise to the top through sheer strength.
However, the Furin is no longer the lawless battleground it once was, which now called "Bofurin", it has transformed into a group dedicated to protecting the city.
As a member of Bofurin, Sakura gradually bonds with the people of the town. Through fierce battles against the Shishitoren Gang, he begins to grow.
Now, as class leader, he faces a brand-new enemy—ready to fight once again!

278861.title: The Beginning After the End
278861.evaluate: Grey, the strongest king in history, is the protagonist of the tale.  Despite his unrivaled fame, fortune, and power, nobody supports him... and he doesn't trust anyone.  One day, Grey dies unexpectedly and is reborn in a magical world as Arthur, a helpless baby.  Arthur begins to discover joys in this new life that he was unaware of in his old one, surrounded by a loving family and friends.  But his family is assaulted by bandits while traveling...

278862.title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
278862.evaluate:
Life hasn't been kind to Zenos. He was born in the slums, and his dirt-poor background has denied him almost every opportunity. After an encounter with a healer, he throws himself into studying to become one and finally catches a break when an adventurer invites Zenos into his party. Zenos is thrilled—so thrilled, in fact, that he's willing to put up with his teammates treating him like garbage. They fail to appreciate his talents and ultimately kick him to the curb, claiming he's outlived his usefulness to them.

Now bereft of money and out of options, Zenos decides to put his self-taught skills to use elsewhere and opens an underground clinic. Word quickly spreads about the brilliant healer working incredible magic in the city's shadowy underbelly. Even the royal palace is taking notice...

Can Zenos buck the odds and carve out a life for himself in a world that's spit in his face? And can he save the lives of the patients who wind up on his doorstep in the process?
278862.seasonTitle: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
episodeTitles: Unlicensed Healer in the Ruins Street

278863.title: The Shiunji Family Children
278863.evaluate:
In the prestigious residential district of Setagaya, Tokyo, stands the grand estate of the Shiunjike family.
The seven siblings who reside there are renowned for their intelligence and beauty, and among them, the five eldest sisters—born in consecutive years—are particularly famous for their breathtaking looks.

Living under the same roof with a group of beautiful sisters—an enviable situation for anyone.
However, the eldest brother, Arata, is constantly at the mercy of his five uniquely eccentric sisters, leaving him hopelessly awkward around any other girls.
Though he deeply values his family, he can’t help but fantasize about a life without his five overbearing sisters...

278864.title: Aharen-san wa Hakarenai season 2
278864.evaluate:
And then the new semester comes, now the distance to the transfer student is indecipherable!?

During their time at school, Aharen-san and Raidou-kun frequently encountered "too far" and "too close" distances when they began dating. 

It's an "indecipherable" close relationship in many respects? 
The youthful romance comedy restarted!!

278865.title: Kowloon Generic Romance
278865.evaluate:
In the nostalgia-filled streets of Kowloon Walled City, Reiko Kujirai works at a local real estate agency. She finds herself got a crush on her senior colleague, Hajime Kudo.
One day, as she becomes fully aware of her feelings, she stumbles upon a photograph—revealing that Kudo once had a fiancée. But the shocking truth is that this woman looks exactly like her.
The existence of another Reiko Kujirai forces her to confront a chilling realization—she has no memories of her past...

278866.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
278866.evaluate:
This is a story set years before the events of My Hero Academia!
In a superhuman society where approximately 80% of the population possesses supernatural abilities, the world is constantly teetering on the edge of chaos. Amidst it all, there exists a chosen profession—Heroes—those who protect people from accidents, disasters, and the misuse of Quirks.
But there are also those who, even without being "chosen," can't help but step in to save those in need.
This is the story of one such hero—an off-duty officer who refuses to turn away.

278867.title: Black Butler -Emerald Witch Arc-
278867.evaluate:
By order of the Queen, Sebastian and Ciel set out to investigate a series of mysterious deaths occurring in Germany.
Their search leads them to the dreaded "Forest of the Werewolf", a place whispered to bring death to any who dare enter.
As they delve deeper into the truth behind the legend, a horrifying curse descends upon them—

278868.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2
278868.evaluate:
A goddess's intervention allows Azusa to be reincarnated as an immortal witch in a different world.
She longs for a slow, quiet life, determined to avoid the deadly overwork that killed her in her last life. To make a little extra for her daily expenses, she nonchalantly slays slimes as a regular routine—for 300 years.
Before she realizes it… she has achieved MAX level, becoming the strongest being in the world!
278868.seasonTitle: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2

278869.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend
278869.evaluate:
Aspiring to become a true samurai, Yaiba Kurogane devoted himself to intense training deep in the jungle.
By a twist of fate, he returns to Japan and finds himself staying with the Mine family, who have ties to his father, Kenjuurou.
While Sayaka Mine, the family's daughter, struggles to adjust to Yaiba’s wild and reckless nature, they begin living together.
One day, when Yaiba visits Sayaka’s school, he has a fateful encounter with Takeshi Onimaru, a skilled kendo practitioner.
As Yaiba and Onimaru repeatedly clash, their relentless pursuit of strength awakens an ancient power, setting their destinies into motion.

278870.title: Your Forma
278870.evaluate:
In an alternate 2023, Your Forma—a magical “smart fiber” technology—has become a staple of everyday life after being created to treat a widespread outbreak of viral encephalitis. The invasive feature of these handy gadgets is that they record every sound, image, and even sensation experienced by the user.

Searching for evidence to solve the most difficult cases and probing people’s memories through Your Forma are all part of the workday for electronic investigator Echika Hieda. The problem is, she’s so good at her job that her assistants are literally losing their minds trying to keep up with her. Eventually, the higher-ups assign Echika an equal partner, Harold Lucraft, a smart but cunning android, after adding too many assistants to the hospital. Can this unlikely couple overcome their shared anxieties and stop a deadly technological disease from spreading across the world before it's too late?

278871.title: The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei: He Just Solves All the Mysteries
278871.evaluate:
School x Supernatural x Mystery. This story takes place before the exorcist Kyougokudou opened up a used bookstore...

Our setting is in Tokyo in 1948, just right after the war. Kanna Kusakabe had just become a second-year at a high school when she meets the new language teacher, Akihiko Chuuzenji. Mysterious supernatural things keep happening around Kanna. Once again today, Kanna is going to open the doors to the library prep room to seek help from the surly Chuuzenji-sensei who is waiting inside.

A high school supernatural mystery featuring the unlikely duo between a teacher and a high school girl is about to begin!
278871.seasonTitle: The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei: He Just Solves All the Mysteries
episodeTitles: The New Teacher with a Stern Face
The Man in the Blue Cloak

278872.title: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentoushou
278872.evaluate: Young Jinta and his sister are forced to leave their house during the Edo period and take sanctuary in a mountain village. Years later, Jinta has become an expert swordsman and has vowed to defend the rural shrine's maiden. Jinta faces the evil beast in the forest after being charged with killing a demon that poses a threat to the shrine, only to discover a startling reality. The demon describes what will happen in a century and seventy years, when Jinta will have to face the demon. As Jinta hunts a demon through time and has to confront his own evil side, an epic fantasy odyssey spanning several eras begins.
278872.seasonTitle: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentoushou

278873.title: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
278873.evaluate:
Born into a noble Count family governing the frontier of the Algland Empire, Liam is a reincarnated soul who, at a young age, inherits his family’s title.
Having spent his previous life constantly exploited due to his kindness, Liam reflects on his past mistakes and makes a bold decision—this time, he will become a ruthless, corrupt lord who oppresses his people!
Despite his best efforts to act like an evil lord, the people continue to praise and admire him—and his reputation only keeps rising!?
278873.seasonTitle: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!

278877.title: WITCH WATCH
278877.evaluate:
Moruji Otogi, a high school student with the power of an oni, suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his childhood friend, Nico, who is currently training to become a witch—as her familiar!

While Nico is thrilled to reunite with her childhood friend, Moruji has a greater mission—to protect her from a prophesied calamity as her destined familiar.

With Nico’s unpredictable magic causing all sorts of unexpected trouble, and the complications of a teenage boy and girl living together…

Their days ahead are bound to be chaotic, mysterious, and anything but ordinary!
episodeTitles: A Giant Rookie, Let’s Go to a Family Restaurant, the Flying Classroom
Fresh Transparent Fashions for Spring, Witch's Delivery Service, Lost Dogs and the Patter of Rain

278878.title: TO BE HERO X (Dub CN)
278878.evaluate: This is a world where heroes are made by people's trust. The hero who receives the most trust is honored as “X”. People’s trust can be statistically measured here, and these values are reflected on everyone’s wrists. As long as one accumulates enough trust points, an ordinary person can also gain superpowers and become a superhero to save the world. However, the constantly changing trust points make the path to becoming a hero full of uncertainties...

278879.title: The All-devouring Whale: Homecoming
278879.evaluate: Fan Lingxiao, a spiritual pet master with exceptional talents, was plotted against during the Level-A sect promotion competition and was devoured by Kun, his own spiritual pet. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named “Liu Fengmang” and was imprisoned in the White Mansion’s dungeon. Meanwhile, his own sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was in a perilous state. To uncover the truth of being devoured by Kun and revitalize his sect, Fan Lingxiao, accompanied by his existing spiritual pets, embarked on a brand-new adventure journey with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

278880.title: Word of Honor S2
278880.evaluate: Xie Kanhua was about to be executed in the Shanglin Celestial Palace. When Su Baiyi was rescuing him, the Shanglin Celestial Palace disintegrated, and Su Baiyi was taken away by Su Jian, the Demon Lord who had voluntarily confined himself in the secluded prison for twenty years. Then the Hero Conference of Xuanwei Town is held again, Bai Jile lures Divine Official Xue, the second-best martial artist in the world to participate, plunging the martial arts world into chaos. In order to save the injured Nangong Xi'er, Su Baiyi went to the North Kunlun with Su Jian to pay a visit to Su Suomo, the ancestor of the Su family, while Yuling and Feng Zuojun respectively headed to Qingcheng Mountain and the Demon Town to learn martial arts. Under the latent tension, the Yingzhou Immortal Island reappeared. The invaders from the island issued a provocation to the martial artists, saying that those who submit will prosper, while those who resist will perish...

278882.title: LINGCAGE 2
278882.evaluate: As the world has long been overcrowded, the action of venturing into the universe to seek a new homeland becomes a matter of great urgency. While everything is advancing in an orderly manner, the lunar phases suddenly undergo abnormal changes and the ground beneath erupts intense geological changes that last for decades. As a result, humanity is left with only a handful of survivors in this catastrophe. When people step onto this familiar yet strange land again from the ruins and abysses after everything returns to peace, they start to wonder if they can still dominate this world as they used to.

278883.title: GoWest：Overworked
278883.evaluate: Fifty years ago, the martial arts world was suddenly invaded by the “Hun Dun”. Murong Qiong established the Demon Sect to resist it, but they couldn’t manage to win despite arduous battles. The Divine Messenger Yi Zhihua descended and taught everyone the cultivation method of demonization, and they finally managed to defeat the Hun Dun. However, after the Divine Messenger left, the cultivation method went out of control as it spread in the martial arts world. Disappointed, Murong Qiong retired and his subordinate Yu Huabing seized the power, improved the cultivation method, and created an era of Punk True Qi, making the martial arts world thrive. But the price of prosperity was that all the cultivators became “Overworking fanatics”. Dongfang Sheng, harboring an idealistic and sincere aspiration, found Murong Qiong secluded in the GoWest Restaurant. He hoped that Murong Qiong would assist in restoring the glory of the martial arts world. The comical story thus began...

278884.title: Fire Force Season 3
278884.evaluate:
A scorching dark fantasy guided by flames—
The final chapter begins!

After fierce battles over the "Pillars" and the investigation mission into the Nether,
Shinra and his comrades have drawn closer to uncovering the great secrets of the world.

In response to their efforts, other Special Fire Force companies have pledged their support,
uniting as one to prevent the Great Cataclysm.

Now, the final battle begins, as Shinra—the hero—and the firefighters stand together to protect the world!

278885.title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
278885.evaluate:
"Make me put the underwears on." 
As the head of the school caste system, Takamine-san, the president of the student council, is unquestionably a deity! 

However, Shirota-kun, who lacks friends and a sense of presence, has changed his school life once he catches a glimpse of Shirota-kun's nude breasts one day...

Surprisingly, Takamine-san is a girl who can take off her panties and travel through time with her "Eternal Virgin Road" ability.
"Please put them on, Takamine-san!" is what Shirota-kun can't stop saying at such moments.
episodeTitles: You Are to Become My Closet
Let Me Redo It Until I’m Satisfied
I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best

278886.title: Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive?
278886.evaluate:
In a rural middle school, a boy and a girl vowed eternal friendship.
Bound by a shared dream, their bond remained unchanged for two years—without any romantic development…!
Himari Inuzuka, an outgoing girl who has never experienced first love, and Yuu Natsume, a quiet boy who loves flowers, continued their peaceful days as best friends in their small, two-person gardening club, even as they entered their second year of high school.
However, when Yuu unexpectedly reunites with his past first love, the balance between them begins to shift!
After discovering the feeling of love, can Himari  break free from the role of the "ideal best friend"?
episodeTitles: Soft Windflower and Queen of the Night

278887.title: Once Upon a Witch's Death
278887.evaluate:
Meg Raspberry, a young and inexperienced witch cursed with the "Death Sentence"—a fate that left her with only one year to live.

There was only one way to break the curse:
She had to create the legendary "Seed of Life", an artifact said to grant immortality to its bearer.

However, the key ingredient for the Seed of Life was something unexpected—fragments of emotion, specifically, the tears of joy shed by people in moments of happiness.
And so, Meg sets out on a journey, encountering all kinds of people in her quest to gather a thousand tears of joy—a journey that will change her fate forever.
episodeTitles: The Witch With a One Year Lifespan
The Witch Apprentice and the Lapis People
A Visit From the East by the Wise

278888.title: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
278888.evaluate: Philia comes from a family that has a reputation for producing generations of saints, and she is no different. She is so incredibly talented that many people find her unbearable, earning her the title of most powerful saint of all time. Her fiancé abruptly ends their engagement after deciding he can no longer stand her. He sells her to a foreign nation in desperate need of a saint of their own since he is so keen to never see her again. Philia now prepares for the future, fully anticipating more wretched treatment. She would be surprised, after all, to find that everyone would embrace her.
278888.seasonTitle: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom

278889.title: The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl
278889.evaluate:
In a world where everyone receives a blessing from an animal god upon turning 16, the timid Count’s daughter, Sophia Leeler, hopes for a peaceful school life. However, fate has other plans—she ends up receiving the blessing of the Gorilla God, said to be the strongest in combat!

As she struggles to keep a low profile, her rare and overwhelming power draws attention, leading to a scout offer from the Royal Knights as a squire. Despite her efforts to hide her strength, she quickly earns respect and admiration. Among those watching over her is the kind and dependable Louis Scarrel, an older squire attending the same academy, along with other promising young knights.

Thus begins an unexpected, heart-throbbing romantic comedy—born from the unstoppable power of a gorilla!
episodeTitles: The Gorilla Life of a Lady and Blessings
The Gorilla Signs of Affection That I Always Dreamed Of
A Gorilla Rhapsody of Sweets at the Royal Capital

278891.title: MAEBASHI WITCHES
278891.evaluate:
Being a Maebashi witch—doesn’t that sound super aesthetic!?
This is Maebashi City, Gunma Prefecture.
For first-year high school student Yuina Akagi, life was just “normal, I guess”, a little too ordinary...
Until one day...
"Then how about you try becoming a witch?"
With the sudden appearance of a mysterious frog named Keroppe, everything changes!
Her closet door now leads to a strange and magical space…
episodeTitles: What’s So Bad About Maintaining Status Quo?!
Your Clothes and Mouth Are Flipping
It’s Written Negligence but Read Honesty

278892.title: My Senior Brother is Too Strong
278892.evaluate: Cultivator Lv Shaoqing’s accidental acquisition of the immortal treasure “Spring and Autumn Ring” led the righteous immortal alliance to label him as a world-destroying demon and hunt him to death. But by some strange twist of fate, he was sent back a thousand years in time and found himself sharing a body with the very enemy who had killed him. Trapped within the enemy's lair, Lv Shaoqing fought wits and courage to reclaim control of the body for survival as well as anticipating the enemy’s actions to collect rare treasures. Eventually, through his remarkable intelligence and courage, Lv Shaoqing became the most despised playboy of the righteous path. At the same time, the hidden secrets of the cultivation world began to come to light. Lv Shaoqing counted with his fingers, and suddenly realized that the course of history had already been changed!
278892.seasonTitle: My Senior Brother is Too Strong

278893.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 2
278893.evaluate:
After her fierce conflict with Adonis and the brutal battle against Evil, Bell had shut herself away in her room. However, thanks to the unwavering support of her companions, she finds solace and reaffirms her determination to become a Nomad of the Journey once more.

As the Maiden of Reason, Bell delves deeper into the great mysteries of this world.

Meanwhile, consumed by despair, Adonis is taken in by the Hunger Alliance. Under the guidance of Drambuie, a figure lurking in the darkness of the alliance, and Bell’s own master, Cyan, Adonis is forged into the One Who Questions, a being who longs for the world’s end.

"Can you strike me down…?"
"Can you transcend me… and even the gods?"

What does the inevitable clash between Cyan’s two disciples—Bell and Adonis—truly signify?

And at the end of all battles, what reason will Bell uncover in this world?
episodeTitles: Homesickness. Now, It Sprouts in the Echo
A Plea. Paradise Entrusted With Death
Confrontation. Standing on Tiptoe for What I Yearned For

278894.title: WITCH WATCH(Thai Dub)
278894.evaluate:
Moruji Otogi, a high school student with the power of an oni, suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his childhood friend, Nico, who is currently training to become a witch—as her familiar!

While Nico is thrilled to reunite with her childhood friend, Moruji has a greater mission—to protect her from a prophesied calamity as her destined familiar.

With Nico’s unpredictable magic causing all sorts of unexpected trouble, and the complications of a teenage boy and girl living together…

Their days ahead are bound to be chaotic, mysterious, and anything but ordinary!

278898.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2(Thai Dub)
278898.evaluate:
A goddess's intervention allows Azusa to be reincarnated as an immortal witch in a different world.
She longs for a slow, quiet life, determined to avoid the deadly overwork that killed her in her last life. To make a little extra for her daily expenses, she nonchalantly slays slimes as a regular routine—for 300 years.
Before she realizes it… she has achieved MAX level, becoming the strongest being in the world!
278898.seasonTitle: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2(Thai Dub)

278900.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2(Dub Indo)
278900.evaluate:
A goddess's intervention allows Azusa to be reincarnated as an immortal witch in a different world.
She longs for a slow, quiet life, determined to avoid the deadly overwork that killed her in her last life. To make a little extra for her daily expenses, she nonchalantly slays slimes as a regular routine—for 300 years.
Before she realizes it… she has achieved MAX level, becoming the strongest being in the world!
278900.seasonTitle: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2(Dub Indo)

278901.title: Tales of Herding Gods(Thai Dub)
278901.evaluate: In Can Lao village, there lived nine enigmatic elders and the young Qin Mu who was raised by the elders. One day, the cow that Qin Mu was herding surprisingly spoke human language.Since then, Qin Mu has become more aware of the dangers and enchantments of the forsaken land of Da Xu: demons descend with the darkness, divine bones dance in the ruins, dragon bones protect their young, and a giant ship drags the sun... No matter what kind of danger he faces, Qin Mu is fearless. He integrates the skills passed down by the nine elders and vows to carve out his own realm with a peerless and domineering physique.

278902.title: WIND BREAKER Season 2(Dub Indo)
278902.evaluate:
The lone delinquent high schooler, Sakura, arrives at the infamous Furin High, known as the ultimate school for delinquents, aiming to rise to the top through sheer strength.
However, the Furin is no longer the lawless battleground it once was, which now called "Bofurin", it has transformed into a group dedicated to protecting the city.
As a member of Bofurin, Sakura gradually bonds with the people of the town. Through fierce battles against the Shishitoren Gang, he begins to grow.
Now, as class leader, he faces a brand-new enemy—ready to fight once again!

278903.title: The Beginning After the End (Thai Dub)
278903.evaluate: Grey, the strongest king in history, is the protagonist of the tale. Despite his unrivaled fame, fortune, and power, nobody supports him... and he doesn't trust anyone. One day, Grey dies unexpectedly and is reborn in a magical world as Arthur, a helpless baby. Arthur begins to discover joys in this new life that he was unaware of in his old one, surrounded by a loving family and friends. But his family is assaulted by bandits while traveling...
278903.seasonTitle: The Beginning After the End (Thai Dub)

278904.title: Fairies Albums Luoyang Arc
278904.evaluate: Fairies Albums Luoyang Arc follows Tao Yao, Mister Liu, Moya, and Gun Gun as they set out on a quest to find the missing Fairy Album in Luoyang City. Jiang Jun, Xian Shu, Fo Yan, Xuan Jiao, Ying Yuan, Ren Qu, and Xia Guai are among the many unusual and enigmatic creatures they meet along the route. They also face off against the formidable ultimate boss behind the Fairy Album in an exciting battle of cunning. There's a voyage of mystery, legend, and imagination ahead!

278905.title: Back as Immortal Lord
278905.evaluate: Yun Qingyan, a teenage warrior, was dragged into the fairy world for three thousand years before vanishing from the planet three years ago!  He became one of the 10 great fairy emperors, the Yun Emperor, thanks to his remarkable talent.  However, he made the decision to return to the human world at all costs because he missed his family and was fed up with the intrigues in the fairy realm.  His parents and sister mysteriously vanished when he returned to the human world, and he lost his magic weapon and nearly zeroed out his cultivation as a result of an occurrence that occurred during the journey from the fairy world to the human world.  He was pursued by major forces throughout this time...

278906.title: Psychic Princess S2
278906.evaluate: The prime minister of Guyu Kingdom's eldest daughter, Qian Yunxi, possesses superhuman abilities.  Since childhood, she has been viewed as unlucky, and she is compelled to marry into the Ye Palace.  When the prince Ye Youming sees how sincere and nice she is, he employs hundreds of tricks to demonstrate his generosity.  Because she believes the prince is malicious, Qian Yunxi argues with him.  Cohabitation turns into a tumultuous existence.

278908.title: The new chronicles of extraordinary Beings: Preface
278908.evaluate:
Hao Ren was a typical young man from a small city who was barely making ends meet while living in an old house. However, via a strange turn of events, he becomes a "universe police officer." A problem is developing in his domain, the Dream Plane Universe, as he struggles to oversee a home inhabited by strange, non-human residents that his enigmatic superiors have assigned him.

As he investigates further, Hao Ren discovers a link between the remnants of a vanished civilization in the Dream Plane and the strange species on Earth. Hao Ren quickly learns that slacking off is no longer an option when long-buried horrors, fallen deities, and ancient cataclysms reappear.
278908.seasonTitle: The new chronicles of extraordinary Beings: Preface

278909.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2
278909.evaluate:
The conversation starts when Momo Ayase, a high school student from a family of mediums, intervenes to shield her classmate Ken Takakura, also known as "Okarun" and a devoted occultist, from bullies in the classroom.

 Momo believes in ghosts but not aliens, whereas Okarun believes in aliens but not ghosts. Nevertheless, the two quickly clash.
 In an attempt to disprove one another, they place a daring wager: Okarun enters a spooky tunnel, while Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where UFOs have been reported.

 So begins a strange and exciting supernatural battle between the unknown, aliens, and ghosts!
episodeTitles: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
You Won't Get Away With This!

278910.title: My Dress-Up Darling Season 2
278910.evaluate:
Wakana Gojo and Marin Kitagawa become closer through the cosplay community following a destined experience.
They still have a ton of roles they want to play and costumes they want to construct.

Marin and Gojo's world keeps growing as they strengthen their relationships with their peers and make new friends who are also cosplayers.
And what about Marin's intense romantic interest in Gojo? Could this be the turning point for her?

278911.title: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses
278911.evaluate:
Despite his remarkable abilities, Hero Toto is unable to organize a party due to his excessive shyness, which keeps him stranded in the town where his adventure started.

 One day, three stunning women—Ciel, Anemone, and Gore—instantly ask him to a party.  Toto is giddy with anticipation at finally embarking on an adventure, but he is unaware that these women are determined to murder him!

 The socially nervous hero, who faints from the simple joy of being around ladies, is the target of three lethal companions, each of whom has their own motives for wanting him gone, in this deadly harem romcom!
278911.seasonTitle: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses
episodeTitles: The Shy Hero and the Three Princesses
The Shy Hero and His First Adventure
The Shy Hero and the Secret Date

278912.title: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin
278912.evaluate: Early sickness claimed Ira Takuto's life, and he was ultimately reincarnated in a world reminiscent of the fantasy turn-based strategy game Eternal Nations. He not only reincarnated as his favorite gaming character, but also as the god in charge of the malevolent Mynoghra society. Nothing, not even legendary race qualities, would prevent Mynoghra from reviving their civilization with his lovely hero unit, Sludge Witch Atou, at his side!
278912.seasonTitle: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin
episodeTitles: The Shy Hero and His First Adventure

279019.title: Private Tutor to the Duke’s Daughter
279019.evaluate: Allen, a bright young sorcerer, wants nothing more than to go back to a modest existence in the country after failing the last exam for his ideal position at the royal court. Regretfully, he is unable to pay for the train fare! Getting a job is his only option, but his one lead is anything but humble—Duke Howard, one of the most influential nobles in the realm, seeks a private tutor for his daughter, Tina. Even though Tina is a brilliant student, she cannot cast a single spell. Even worse, magical aptitude is required for the elite Royal Academy's entrance tests, which are quickly approaching! Can Tina overcome her magical impairment—a riddle that has eluded even the best sorcerers in the kingdom—with Allen's special kind of spellcasting?  Does the Duke, her father, even want him to?
279019.seasonTitle: Private Tutor to the Duke’s Daughter
episodeTitles: The Duke's Daughter Who Can't Use Magic
The Flower That Blooms After Tears

279020.title: WIND BREAKER Season 2 (Thai Dub)
279020.evaluate:
The lone delinquent high schooler, Sakura, arrives at the infamous Furin High, known as the ultimate school for delinquents, aiming to rise to the top through sheer strength.
However, the Furin is no longer the lawless battleground it once was, which now called "Bofurin", it has transformed into a group dedicated to protecting the city.
As a member of Bofurin, Sakura gradually bonds with the people of the town. Through fierce battles against the Shishitoren Gang, he begins to grow.
Now, as class leader, he faces a brand-new enemy—ready to fight once again!

279021.title: Uglymug, Epicfighter
279021.evaluate: Shigeru Yoshioka, 34, gets wrongfully accused of a crime, loses everything, including his faith in women, and becomes a reclusive recluse who withdraws from society. He discovers a means of traveling to a different universe one day.  Shigeru gives up his appearance in order to obtain an overwhelming 100 trillion and 5,100 parameters when a suspicious status panel appears on his computer.  After being reincarnated as an "Absolute God," he starts a new life on a different planet.

279022.title: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!
279022.evaluate: A white wizard named Lloyd gets expelled from the hero's group one day. By coincidence, Lloyd, who has lost his job, goes on a mission with an S-rank group. Nobody realized at the moment that Lloyd would become famous and the hero's party would fall apart. This is the tale of an outstanding support magic user who, oblivious to how he ultimately becomes unmatched, believes he is normal and turns into an adventurer.
279022.seasonTitle: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!

279023.title: Clevatess: The King of Devil Beasts, The Baby and the Brave of Undead
279023.evaluate: Alicia, who had longed to be a hero since childhood, was chosen by the king and became one of the thirteen heroes. Carrying the legendary sword, they set out on a journey to vanquish Clevatess, the King of Demon Beasts. However, this rash bravery has brought about a disaster that could wipe out all of humanity on the Continent, triggering the most severe crisis ever. Now, the last glimmer of hope left in the world lies with an infant entrusted to the King of Demon Beasts.
279023.seasonTitle: Clevatess: The King of Devil Beasts, The Baby and the Brave of Undead

279024.title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
279024.evaluate:
Living beneath her sister's shadow, a poor baron's daughter has never had anything. She has only ragged work clothes, no dresses, and her hair is full of hairballs. A wealthy and powerful aristocrat shows interest in her sister, but she passes away en route to her wedding.

Marie is sent to replace her sister as a bride because the baron is unable to pay the earl back for the dowry that has already been sold.  But isn't that impossible? Was the proposition, first of all, misunderstood? An intelligent earl and a fallen baron's daughter have a lovely and joyful love story.
episodeTitles: There’s No Way I Could Ever Take My Sister’s Place
The Life I Dreamed Of, and the Life Like a Dream

279025.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7TH PRINCE so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My MAGICAL ABILITY 2nd Season
279025.evaluate:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
279025.seasonTitle: I Was Reincarnated as the 7TH PRINCE so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My MAGICAL ABILITY 2nd Season

279026.title: Kaiju No. 8 Season 2
279026.evaluate:
Although Kafka Hibino is spared from being weaponized thanks to Defense Force Director Shinomiya’s judgment, he remains in confinement. As the new Third Division recruits head off to their assignments, Kafka is confronted by Gen Narumi—the formidable leader of the First Division and the Defense Force’s strongest soldier.

Narumi sees no value in Kafka as a team member, forcing Kafka to prove his worth by facing the immense power of Kaiju No. 8 head-on. Meanwhile, in the shadows, the sinister threat of Kaiju No. 9 draws ever closer…

279027.title: TOUGEN ANKI
279027.evaluate:
People who have Oni and Momotarou blood in their veins have a long-standing feud. The Momotarou defend the human world from the unruly Oni, who are reckless, impetuous, and chaotic. Shiki Ichinose is a careless and reckless adolescent who is proud of his expulsion from school and conscious of his disobedience. Shiki's foster father, Tsuyoshi, loves him despite his disobedient demeanor.
Soon after, when a Momotarou storms in seeking Shiki, Tsuyoshi's unselfish love is demonstrated in a dramatic episode. Being a Momotarou himself, Tsuyoshi has been concealing Shiki's Oni ancestry from him for years. The first time Shiki's Oni blood emerges, he becomes an untamed beast filled with anger and a desire for vengeance as he sacrifices his life to save Shiki and confesses everything in his final breath.
A instructor of Oni at the Rakshasa Academy, a facility for young Oni who need to learn and hone their abilities, Naito Mudano, notices Shiki's brief outburst. Shiki must to overcome his own demonic blood and learn to restrain his impulsive and stubborn personality before he can exact revenge on his father.
episodeTitles: If You Want To Make It, Keep on Winning

279028.title: Gachiakuta
279028.evaluate: Rudo resides in a floating town's slums, where the impoverished struggle to make ends meet while the wealthy have luxurious lives and just throw their trash into the abyss.  One day he is wrongfully convicted of murder and sentenced to an unthinkable punishment: banishment off the edge with the rest of the trash.  Rudo will have to learn a new power and join a group called the Cleaners who fight the giant trash beasts of the Pit if he hopes to have any chance of learning the truth and getting revenge on those who cast him into Hell. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has produced vicious monsters!

279029.title: Let's Go Karaoke!
279029.evaluate: Nothing worries Satomi Oka more than the upcoming final choir competition of his middle school career—right up until he is accosted by a stranger from the shadows who demands, "Let's go karaoke!" As a yakuza, Kyouji Narita doesn't scare easily, but a terrifying prospect has driven him to seek Satomi's help. The boss is holding a karaoke contest, with the loser forced to get a tattoo to be selected and torturously applied by the boss himself! Oka has been to many vocal rehearsals over the years, but never one-on-one karaoke sessions with a gangster!!

279030.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...
279030.evaluate: In an effort to become a popular and gregarious high school student, awkward and introverted Amaori Renako is leaving her lonely middle school life behind. Renako's complete opposite is the glamorous, self-assured Oduka Mai, who is rich, carefree, and a real fashion model. In spite of everything, the two females click right away. Before Mai's love revelation throws Renako's heart into a tailspin, she believes she may have found the best friend of her life.  Mai is adamant that they are meant to be lovers, despite Renako's attempts to show her that being best friends is preferable to being a girlfriend.
279030.seasonTitle: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

279031.title: Detectives These Days Are Crazy!
279031.evaluate:
Keiichirou Nagumo was once a high-school detective who could swiftly solve any case and unravel every mystery. But now, plagued by back pain, failing eyesight, fragile nerves, he's become a total middle-aged man abandoned by the times—he can't even use a smartphone!
"It's not that my talent has withered—just that I've lost a bit of youth," he claims.
Yet one day, a vibrant high-school girl named Mashiro suddenly shows up at the Detective Agency, asking to become his assistant.
 It seems she aims to be a detective...!?
The exciting daily life of a middle-aged detective and his quirky high-school girl assistant is about to begin!
episodeTitles: Aim for the Knees When Dealing with Ghosts
Ignorant Stalkers Are the Most Dangerous

279032.title: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
279032.evaluate: Hyakuan Momoyumi, a mystery "self-proclaimed sage" who has been barred from the afterlife, is Mogura. In order to get back, he travels the world and gathers ghost "lamps" for his lantern. But there is a unique benefit to meeting him: the capacity to perceive odd occurrences.
279032.seasonTitle: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole

279033.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2
279033.evaluate:
Erika Amano and Nagi Umino were unintentionally born together; one was brought up as the daughter of a hotel magnate, while the other was raised as the son of a diner owner. Their adoptive and biological parents propose an arranged engagement after they find out the truth. Now that they share a home, Nagi's already complex existence attracts his classmate Hiro, his sister Sachi, who is not connected by blood, and soon even his childhood first love.

In this romantic comedy, which is based on a case of mistaken identity, Nagi is surrounded by a complicated web of relationships, including a childhood friend, stepsister, crush, and fiancée. Fate takes an even more drastic turn this summer!

279034.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 4
279034.evaluate:
As the Four Guardian Beasts' resuscitation draws closer, the Shield Hero Naofumi Iwatani attempts to bring the frequently at odds Four Legendary Heroes together. Peace seemed to be achievable following the confrontation and reconciliation with the other three.

But because of a misinterpretation, some people think Raphtalia wants to take a kingdom, which makes her a target for assassins from the Kutenrou nation. Naofumi goes to Siltvelt, a demi-human country that reveres the Shield Hero, to put an end to the issue.  Despite being widely embraced, not all Siltvelt factions support him.  Kutenrou is experiencing political turmoil at the same time, and Raphtalia is viewed as a symbol of revolution. Can Naofumi be the beacon of light his friends need as the tensions rise and chaos spreads?
279034.seasonTitle: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 4

279035.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus
279035.evaluate:
New experiences come with a new stage.

Sakuta Azusagawa, a university student now, and his girlfriend, actress Mai Sakurajima, start a new chapter in their lives after he once encountered the peculiar consequences of Adolescence Syndrome. He meets Touko Kirishima, a girl dressed as Santa, at Yokohama University and quickly becomes entangled in more enigmatic events.

The strange keeps happening, from enigmatic online singers to precognitive dreams and spectral poltergeists.
Troubled girls' hearts falter once more since adolescence never really ends.
279035.seasonTitle: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus

279036.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
279036.evaluate: Subaru Ayase's son, Yuu Ayase, attends the prestigious Saika Academy, which is renowned for its development of potential. The Mikadono sisters, Miwa, Nico, and Kazuki, are all prodigies in shogi, martial arts, and performing arts, but Yuu is nothing compared to his mother. Yuu, in fulfillment of his mother's last desire to "build a happy family," moves in with her old acquaintance, who also happens to be the father of the sisters. Despite the sisters' chilly and alone state brought on by their extreme devotion to their crafts, Yuu's generosity and perseverance gradually start to heal their damaged relationships and unite the family.
279036.seasonTitle: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
episodeTitles: A Genius and a Mediocre Guy

279037.title: April Showers Bring May Flowers
279037.evaluate: Notwithstanding what her name would imply, Hana Tabata is not at all like a flower. Her limbs are far from thin, and her eyes are too tiny. Since she is "ugly," she is aware that she cannot have a fairy tale romance or cute stuff. Despite this, she continues to daydream every morning while caring for the lovely flower beds at the school that contrast with her appearance. Tabata meets her classmate, Yousuke Ueno, who is recognized for being both attractive and incredibly nice, during a chance meeting one day. Why would a well-liked student hang out with a minor character like her?  Although Tabata finds the scenario inexplicable, can Ueno demonstrate to her that appearances aren't everything?
episodeTitles: How to Act as an Extra
Ugly Girl and Flower on a High Peak

279038.title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
279038.evaluate:
Dennis has been banished from the Silver Wings Battalion, one of the most powerful guilds in the area, after being betrayed by people he thought were his friends. However, he doesn't give it much thought because he is eager to use his level 99 cooking abilities nonetheless. He chooses to open a diner in the country instead of staying in the city for this reason.

Dennis encounters Atrielle, a girl banished from her aristocratic family and forced into slavery, until he rescues her, as he is chasing his goal. Together, the two open the diner, and their first customer is... a knight in exile from another guild?  The legend of Dennis and his cafe, the town's talk of the town, begins here!

279039.title: Secrets of the Silent Witch
279039.evaluate: The world's only unchanted magecraft user is Monica Everett, the Silent Witch, a real hero who vanquished a fabled black dragon on her own. In reality, though, this young genius is incredibly bashful! True enough: In order to avoid speaking in front of others, she learnt to cast spells silently. Despite her power, she lacks confidence.  Monica has now been assigned to protect the second prince in secret. Can she maintain her composure in the face of the prince's persecutors and the social interaction fears?
episodeTitles: A Synchronous Person Comes Along and Says Something Reckless

279040.title: Captivated, by You
279040.evaluate: As he counts the stairs in the school, takes pictures of street signs, and dries sweet potatoes on the classroom balcony, Hayashi's candid, unapologetic manner subtly attracts the attention of both classmates and outsiders.  Hayashi is refreshingly and unabashedly authentic to himself in a society where conformity is the norm. Nikaidou, on the other hand, has put a lot of effort into creating a grim, dismal persona that puts his friends at bay. Even though a large portion of the school views Nikaidou negatively, one student manages to see behind the mask and, unfazed by tales of misfortune and supernatural abilities, starts to dismantle Nikaidou's meticulously constructed character...

279049.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2 (Dub Indo)
279049.evaluate:
The conversation starts when Momo Ayase, a high school student from a family of mediums, intervenes to shield her classmate Ken Takakura, also known as "Okarun" and a devoted occultist, from bullies in the classroom.

Momo believes in ghosts but not aliens, whereas Okarun believes in aliens but not ghosts. Nevertheless, the two quickly clash.
In an attempt to disprove one another, they place a daring wager: Okarun enters a spooky tunnel, while Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where UFOs have been reported.

So begins a strange and exciting supernatural battle between the unknown, aliens, and ghosts!

In an attempt to disprove one another, they place a daring wager: Okarun enters a spooky tunnel, while Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where UFOs have been reported.

So begins a strange and exciting supernatural battle between the unknown, aliens, and ghosts!

279312.title: Fei Ren Zai 3rd Season
279312.evaluate: How do the “famous” spirits and monsters of classical Chinese mythology survive in modern society? They’ve become our everyday neighbors—goddess‑obsessed otaku girls, warm‑hearted guys, office workers, and even dog‑like boyfriends—enacting funny, quirky little tales about joy and friendship, and weaving an incredible, otherworldly anime‑style仙境 out of our ordinary, bustling lives.

279728.title: My Dress-Up Darling Season 2 (Thai Dub)
279728.evaluate:
Wakana Gojo and Marin Kitagawa become closer through the cosplay community following a destined experience.
They still have a ton of roles they want to play and costumes they want to construct.

Marin and Gojo's world keeps growing as they strengthen their relationships with their peers and make new friends who are also cosplayers.
And what about Marin's intense romantic interest in Gojo? Could this be the turning point for her?

280098.title: My Dress-Up Darling Season 2 (Dub Indo)
280098.evaluate:
After Marin Kitagawa introduced Wakana Gojou to the world of cosplay, he has been creating her outfits with ease. Even so, he still has a lot to learn, and every new lesson seems to strengthen his love for sewing and for the hina dolls his grandfather taught him to make.

Meanwhile, Kitagawa finds it harder and harder to hide her feelings for Gojou. Friends and strangers alike constantly mistake them for a couple, much to Gojou's embarrassment. After all, in his eyes, their worlds are far too different for anyone to think they could be romantically linked. However, as Gojou spends more time with Kitagawa and realizes that his passions are not ridiculed by other people, a relationship between the two no longer seems so far-fetched.

280148.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill Season 2
280148.evaluate: They are extremely dismayed to find a mediocre salaryman when a magical world seeks to call heroes. Despite not being a hero, Mukoda Tsuyoshi possesses a tasty power thanks to this conjuring error: Online Grocery. And there's something about this contemporary cuisine that has incredible impacts. His culinary prowess combined with the restaurant's convenient location will have customers returning for more!
280148.seasonTitle: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill Season 2
episodeTitles: Earth Dragon Fillet, at Your Service
Earth Dragon Steak Three Stars Guaranteed

280149.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 3
280149.evaluate:
Everybody has a side they keep hidden from others—

During this era, nations across the world were locked in fierce, covert struggles for information. For over a decade, the Westalis and the rival nation of Ostania had been entangled in a relentless cold war.

Twilight, an elite spy working for WISE—the Western Intelligence Agency’s East Division—was assigned a top-secret mission: to monitor the movements of Donovan Desmond, the leader of Ostania’s National Unity Party and a looming threat to fragile East-West peace.

The mission carried a code name: Operation Strix.
episodeTitles: Berlint Panic, The Informant and Nightfall
Avoid Getting Tonitrus Bolts, ■■■■'s Memories I

280150.title: Tales of Wedding Rings Season 2
280150.evaluate:
After gathering the rings and challenging the Lord of the Abyss to a conclusive battle, Satou, Hime, and the others were able to corner their opponent and were only one step away from triumph. But Satou was so exhausted that she found herself in a perilous situation.

The group was able to temporarily reassemble after Arabasta saved them at the last second. At that moment, Morion, Hime's younger sister, emerged out of nowhere.

Satou and the princesses decided to go through training to bolster their abilities and fortify their ties in order to fight the Lord of the Abyss again; this program is called the "Bride's Trial." Through a series of hardships, Satou and Hime's bond deepened, while his relationships with Nefertiti, Garnet, Sapphire, and Amber also strengthened.

Will Satou and his friends be able to overcome the Lord of the Abyss and bring peace back this time?

This otherworldly newlywed dream is set to resurrect the "Bride's Trial"—a mission that could decide the fate of the entire globe!

280151.title: One-Punch Man (Season 3)
280151.evaluate:
For fun, Saitama turned into a hero. He developed unstoppable power via three years of specialized training, and today he is a hero who can defeat any foe with a single blow (One Punch).

Saitama starts official hero activities at the Hero Association alongside Genos, who happened to be his apprentice.

When the Monster Association unexpectedly shows up and kidnaps the executives' children, the Hero Association is forced into a crisis.  In order to free the hostages, the S-Class Heroes band together and plan to raid the Monster Association's hideout.

At the same time, the "human monster" Garou awakens inside the Monster Association's lair.

280152.title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
280152.evaluate: There is a grim past for Konoha Satou. As a teenager, she wrote self-indulgent fantasy romantic fiction, such as her Dark History. It is now a matter of life and death to remember every tiny detail, though, for she has turned into its most heinous villain. After evading the first two warning signs, Satou is abruptly abandoned when an enigmatic stranger—a character she doesn't remember creating in the original script—returns from the Lily Kingdom. Even though Yomi says she is her buddy, in such a perilous environment, can Satou really put her trust in a stranger?
280152.seasonTitle: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
episodeTitles: What’s Important Is Magic, Not Knowledge
Ballroom Dancing Over Bon Festival Dance
So You’re the One Who Led It, My Dark History!

280153.title: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero’s
280153.evaluate: One of those guys who people forget even exists is Oda Akira. He effortlessly transitions into his new duty as a silent assassin, though, and his modest demeanor pays off when his entire class is transported to a fantastical setting. He has too many unfitting details and suspiciously high starting numbers, so Akira knows something is off. Examining royal secrets, however, is a risky endeavor, and when Akira discovers a sinister plot, he also creates a formidable foe—the same monarch who brought him into the world! Can he find the power to make things right and exact his revenge with Amelia, the elf spirit medium?
280153.seasonTitle: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero’s
episodeTitles: The Assassin Takes On Nursing Duty
The Assassin Bonds with a Cat

280154.title: Tojima Tanzaburo Wants to Be a Masked Rider
280154.evaluate:
The goal of Toujima Tanzaburou's life has been to become a Kamen Rider. At 40, he is almost at the point of surrendering his childhood fantasy as reality has caught up with him.

That is, until his lifelong desire becomes something far more perilous as he becomes entangled in a surge of criminal activity spearheaded by the "Fake Shocker" group.

It swiftly transforms from a fictional hero's quest into a real one. It's almost time to start the ultimate Kamen Rider fantasy!
280154.seasonTitle: Tojima Tanzaburo Wants to Be a Masked Rider
episodeTitles: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
From Hate Comes Love, and Love Deepens

280155.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
280155.evaluate: During a ball, Scarlet's fiancé, Kyle, abruptly ends their engagement. She is wrongfully referred to as a "Villainess" and falsely accused of bullying. She is condemned by all the great families and aristocrats. She endured years of his foolishness and cruelty, but she can't stand it any longer! At the end of her rope, she requests one final favor: to punch him in the face. Scarlet's tale of retaliation against Kyle and his associates begins here! A fantasy about a fighter who is both elegant and defiant, and who refuses to be used!
280155.seasonTitle: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
episodeTitles: May I Beat These Evil Nobles (Pigs) to a Pulp for Some Satisfaction?
May I Just Make Having People Getting Acquainted With My Fist a Proper Lady's Pastime?
May I Resort to Beating a High Noble to a Pulp After Talking Things Out Didn't Work After All?

280156.title: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
280156.evaluate:
Luna Ishikawa is a special transfer student since she is a vampire. She has swiftly become the focus of attention in her class because to her calm manner. Normal interaction between her and Tatsuta Ootori, a perfectly normal guy, would be almost difficult. But when the two are unintentionally assigned to cleaning duties, that all changes!

Tatsuta's perception of Luna gradually changes once he and she become friends on their own: she is not the cool-headed girl everyone believes her to be. She can't even properly suck blood, in fact! Tatsuta offers to be Luna's practice partner because she is determined to help her get over her incompetence. By bringing excitement to their routine school days, the two slowly strive toward their delicious objective, honing Luna's bloodsucking abilities with each mouthful.
280156.seasonTitle: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
episodeTitles: Li’l Miss Vampire and Ball Sports/Li’l Miss Vampire and Club Tryouts

280157.title: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
280157.evaluate:
"This group doesn't require a weak magician who is limited to using magic for assistance. Alec Ygret, you've been fired."

Alec—a court wizard who had joined the crown prince's company to assist him in overcoming dungeons—was abruptly expelled from the group. Alec was at his wit's end when a buddy from the "magic academy" approached him. In addition, the crown prince's harassment had expelled him from the royal castle.

"Hi Alec. Do you want to join us in trying to defeat the dungeon once more?

Therefore, Alec embarks on his second trip in life with his former party buddies. It tells the tale of an abandoned former court magician who went on an adventure.

The "Lasting Period," a four-person party that was dubbed "legendary," began to gain international recognition four years ago.
280157.seasonTitle: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
episodeTitles: A Death Battle Against the Level 64 Boss!

280158.title: Hands Off: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun
280158.evaluate:
Kouyou Kotesashi is a gifted massage therapist with aspirations to work as a sports physician. He enrolls at Seiwa University Affiliated High School, a dominant sports institution, in order to obtain a scholarship to medical school.

Kouyou, who comes from a low-income household, works as a live-in employee at the school dorm to help pay his bills. But before long, he is encircled by a collection of exceptionally gifted but eccentric female athletes. His responsibilities included overseeing the dorm and taking care of the residents' physical and emotional health.

An exciting new chapter begins with a combination of rigorous training, cramped dorm living, and massage therapy!
episodeTitles: What did you come here for, Aoba-chan?
What did you come here for, Aoba-chan? 2

280160.title: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!
280160.evaluate:
In this world, the Classes and Skills granted by the Goddess shape a person’s entire future, with a Class bestowed at the age of ten.

Allele, son of the “Magic King” Leon and the “Sword Princess” Farah, was expected to inherit greatness—but instead, he was branded “Classless.” Disappointment and pity followed him everywhere.

Yet through sheer effort and unyielding will, Allele begins to gain powers beyond imagination—strength that ultimately surpasses even the talents of those blessed with a Class.

This is the tale of a boy born Classless, who through perseverance rises to be called a “Hero” and continues his pursuit of even greater power.
280160.seasonTitle: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!

280161.title: Pass the Monster Meat, Milady!
280161.evaluate: One must have some acquired tastes, just like any decent noble lady. Monsters are a somewhat unusual protein that Melphiera Marchalrayd tends to crave! But don't pass judgment! Even though monster meat has a poor reputation, Melphiera is determined to change the kingdom's perception of it by demonstrating that it can be utilized in fine cuisine! Sadly, Melphiera has been having a hard time finding the right person ever since she made her social debut—that is, until she meets the bold "Blood-Mad Duke" of Galbraith!
episodeTitles: Meat Jerky Symbolizes Our Promise, Skatzbitt

280163.title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
280163.evaluate:
Saku Chitose frequently receives insults. Known as "Class 5's womanizing scumbag," he is frequently defamed online by others who are envious of his fame. Fortunately, Saku's self-confidence is hardly affected by that. Outside of specialized online communities, his teachers trust him as a great student and his peers look up to him as a respectable person.

Saku makes new acquaintances and reconnects with his old pals, all of whom are members of the school's social elite, as his second year of high school begins. The enjoyment is interrupted, though, when Saku's homeroom teacher gives him the task of persuading Kenta Yamazaki, a classmate who has been shut out, to go back to school.  Saku goes to Kenta's residence the very following day, hoping to close things up as soon as possible. However, when he learns that Kenta is fully and solidly on the Saku hatred train, the endeavor becomes more difficult than he had anticipated. Saku needs to convince Kenta to return to school if he hopes to maintain his flawless reputation.
280163.seasonTitle: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
episodeTitles: Let’s Start Getting To Know Each Other

280164.title: A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai
280164.evaluate: A regular guy with a typical office job, Takeru Kamishiro is called to another world. In "Madeus," a magical and sword-wielding world, Takeru begins his new life with a variety of skills at his disposal!  He has extraordinary magic skills in addition to his enhanced physical capabilities, and he can "search" for valuable objects. Using his newly acquired cheating abilities, Takeru embarks on his new journey in the new Isekai!

280165.title: SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes
280165.evaluate: SI-VIS is a co-ed music group, led by Yosuke, shaking up the global music scene with their unmatched vocals and performances. However, they are actually heroes in disguise, battling against mysterious forces threatening the world. They convert audience energy at live performances into combat power. Luckily, the battles appear to be ordinary concerts to the public, keeping their identity a secret.

280166.title: Dad is a hero, Mom is a spirit, I'm a reincarnator.
280166.evaluate:
Being a girl of both spirit and human blood, eight-year-old Ellen has power over the elements—though not the traditional four-element kind. She has the power to transform her surroundings by manipulating the elements of the periodic table. On top of that, Ellen also has a great amount of scientific knowledge due to being a scientist in her past life.

During the war against a neighboring kingdom, Rovel Vankreift, the hero of the Kingdom of Tenbahl and eldest son of house Vankreift—as well as Ellen's father—was fatally injured. However, the spirit who fought by Rovel's side, Lady Origin, brought him to her realm to save him from the clutches of death. Lady Origin, who happens to be the Queen of the Spirit Realm as well as Ellen's eventual mother, is one of the most powerful spirits in existence, making little Ellen quite powerful in contrast to her innocent looks.

But even a family as happy as this one has its fair share of problems, as Ellen and her parents are forced to reconnect their old ties to the Vankreift household in order to defend their relatives' honor—all while hiding Ellen's dangerous existence from the public to preserve their undisturbed happiness.
280166.seasonTitle: Dad is a hero, Mom is a spirit, I'm a reincarnator.

280167.title: My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON
280167.evaluate:
The ultimate war between heroes and villains erupts as decades of good versus evil collide in a cataclysmic finale. Tomura Shigaraki has evolved beyond a mere successor to All For One—he now embodies the collapse of world order itself. Meanwhile, Izuku Midoriya, once a timid boy, has risen as the beacon of hope, carrying the weight of humanity’s future on his shoulders. Their fateful clash will redefine heroism and decide the destiny of all.

The Final War and Epilogue Arcs are involved in this season, delivering earth-shattering battles: All Might vs. All For One in a legendary duel, and Izuku Midoriya vs. Tomura Shigaraki.

Heroism or annihilation? The end of an era is here.
episodeTitles: The End of An Era, And ―

280168.title: GINTAMA - Mr.Ginpachi's Zany Class
280168.evaluate:
Here at Gintama High, Class 3-Z is everything from typical. Welcome!  As a teacher at Gintama High School, Ginpachi Sakata is the subject of the Gintama spin-off anime. As misfit high schoolers—an idol otaku, a hopeless slacker, a creepy stalker, an old-man lover, and a nasty delinquent—all jammed into one chaotic classroom, this wacky anime reimagines legendary characters.

Their homeroom teacher, Ginpachi Sakata, is in charge of this rowdy group. She is an unkempt educator with death-fish eyes who wears a lab coat that is always stained. Under his "direction," the Class 3-Z pupils transform the school into their own playground, fusing relatable juvenile pranks with Gintama's trademark craziness. Whether you're a die-hard otaku or a normie, prepare yourself for an extraordinary slice of life!
episodeTitles: My Tutor Always Says It's Okay If I Don't Score 100, 70 Is Good
People Never Change, That's Human Nature
The Usually Silent Guy Suddenly Plays the Fool, Not Sure How to React in Harming People, But Can't

280169.title: To Your Eternity Season 3
280169.evaluate:
The immortal being known as Fushi has triumphed over the Nokkers, the malevolent force that sought to annihilate humanity. Yet his duty is far from over. For centuries, he has spread his essence like roots of a tree, anchoring himself across the land to safeguard mankind.

Now, in a modern world basking in unprecedented peace, Fushi believes he can finally embrace happiness—new friends, a new home, and a life free from conflict.

But shadows of unease creep back. A lurking enemy preys on the cracks in human hearts, while the true purpose of the Beholder who created Fushi begins to unravel. A new trial is bestowed upon Fushi, and the time for a monumental choice is rapidly approaching.

The saga of the undying continues in the Modern Era Arc, where eternal life collides with the fragility of humanity.

280170.title: Mechanical Marie
280170.evaluate:
Arthur Louis Zetes, a wealthy, attractive, and successful man, is all too familiar with human greed. Distrustful of people and constantly doubting those around him, he demands the perfect servant—a robot maid. But with technology still limited, his butler cannot provide one and must instead seek the closest alternative.

Enter Marie Evans, a former child martial arts prodigy known for her emotionless demeanor. Crushed by debt, she seizes the chance to pose as a robot maid. Though Arthur is often harsh toward others, he finds himself unexpectedly charmed by his “robot.” In turn, Marie is quietly moved by his unexpected kindness and genuine enthusiasm toward her.

Thus begins the lighthearted everyday life of a wealthy heir and his very human (but “robotic”) maid.
episodeTitles: A Marie Full of Lies and Secrets

280171.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 5
280171.evaluate: Wang Ling, a dry noodle-loving immortal king, now faces his greatest challenge yet! With a novelist dad, a mysterious mom, a brand-new little sister, and the sudden arrival of a powerful little sister, Wang Nuan, the Wang family’s ordinary life is turned upside down. And figuring out how to be a good older brother becomes the latest challenge for the mighty immortal king. Surprisingly, Wang Nuan’s extraordinary power doesn’t shock the Wang family. Wang Ling starts early, teaching his sister to control her immense abilities. But her power catches the attention of the sinister organization Ye Kui and Bai Zhe, a top-tier prisoner from Enchanted Prison. Faced with threats from evil cultivators, Wang Ling makes a decision that defies tradition: he’ll take his sister along to teach these villains a lesson! This season, join the immortal king and his little sister as they dive into a life filled with humor and unexpected adventures!
280171.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 5
episodeTitles: What to Do If Being Stuck in Writing

280172.title: Jiang Ye
280172.evaluate: After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.

280173.title: The Gate of Mystical Realm
280173.evaluate: Shi Mu's destiny appears predestined to be different in a society that values warriors. He must travel the path of a warrior in order to discover the truth and atone for his sins because he is the adopted son of an aristocratic family. There are conflicting interests and formidable adversaries everywhere, from the four halls of Fengcheng to the conflict between sects. Every obstacle strengthens Shi Mu's resolve. Shi Mu ultimately comes to understand the influence of his ancestry, which not only alters his own fate but also has a significant impact on the futures of numerous others.

280178.title: So You're Raising a Warrior
280178.evaluate: Al, the first king-killer in the demon world and a contrastingly adorable dragon, has a perfect fighting score but is ready to die and longs for a happy retirement. He meets the sly human magician Le Fei and unintentionally becomes a fantastic parent, raising Le Fei's kid Dino.  Will Dino be a typical, contented kid, or will he courageously take up the Warrior's Holy Sword and confront his own fate?

280179.title: Reborn as a Cat
280179.evaluate: Myohee, who was ridiculed at work and orphaned at birth, has endured many hardships throughout her life.  However, Myohee believes she will never find a bright spot in her life after being defrauded by her one friend and being bankrupt.  She makes the decision to leap from a building to end her life, but the grim reaper stops her in mid-air, claiming that her time is not yet up.  She has been given a hundred more days to live—as a cat!  Before she realizes it, she is brought to the house of Mr. Cha, her attractive but distant boss.  If only Myohee can stay a cat, it looks like the ideal opportunity to give her the affection and attention she never experienced in her life!

280212.title: Gachiakuta (Thai Dub)
280212.evaluate: Rudo resides in a floating town's slums, where the impoverished struggle to make ends meet while the wealthy have luxurious lives and just throw their trash into the abyss. One day he is wrongfully convicted of murder and sentenced to an unthinkable punishment: banishment off the edge with the rest of the trash. Rudo will have to learn a new power and join a group called the Cleaners who fight the giant trash beasts of the Pit if he hopes to have any chance of learning the truth and getting revenge on those who cast him into Hell. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has produced vicious monsters!

280245.title: The Man From Dao Xiang Cun

280592.evaluate:
The account of the day after the heroic troop defeated the Demon King - the "after that" story.

280596.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN The Culling Game Part 1
