To protect his tribe's civilization, Lin Ye uses advanced knowledge to forge copper weapons and armor, and a great battle between advanced civilization and primitive barbarism is about to begin.
314464.seasonTitle: Inventing My Way Through the Primitive World

314465.title: Kitchen Smoke Over the Mountains
314465.evaluate:
Backpacker Shen Ji falls off a cliff and transmigrates into the body of a deep-mountain hunter girl, left to survive with her six-year-old adopted sister Qiao Qiao. Relying on her wilderness survival skills, she gathers wild vegetables, sets traps, and smokes fish and meat, not only surviving the famine but turning the mountains into a treasure trove with her sister.

When she goes down the mountain to repair their wooden cabin, she discovers that processed mountain goods sell for more money. Using her exceptional skills, she makes mushroom powder, ice jelly, and steamed cakes that become huge hits at the market. A year later, she has renovated the cabin and expanded the vegetable fields, and life is on track. At the autumn market, a traveling merchant buys out her entire stall and leaves an appointment for the future. Shen Ji calmly continues tidying up — life in the mountains is long, and the cooking smoke has just begun to rise.

314466.title: Has the Grand Secretary Met His Comeuppance Today?
314466.evaluate: In her past life, Princess Zhen Guo Xue Ning saw her entire family slaughtered and died with bitter regret. Her loved ones betrayed her and the throne was usurped, all because of the wild ambitions of the Grand Secretary and the Crown Prince. Reborn after a bath of blood, she returns with overwhelming hatred, no longer a naive noble lady. She unexpectedly encounters a fallen prince who is patient and cunning. From mutual suspicion to entrusting their lives to each other, they carefully lay out a shocking scheme. Amid treacherous palace intrigues and undercurrents in the court, they tear off hypocritical masks and gather evidence pointing directly at the villains. Finally, in the imperial throne room, Xue Ning swears by blood and stakes her life as testimony, publicly exposing the shocking conspiracy. Together with the prince, she overthrows the all-powerful Grand Secretary and the Crown Prince, exacts bloody revenge, and takes back the vast realm belonging to Great Yin!
314466.seasonTitle: Has the Grand Secretary Met His Comeuppance Today?

314467.title: My Brother Became the Regent Season 1
314467.evaluate: Modern siblings are accidentally transported to another world. The brother becomes Lin Potian, the Regent of Great Liang, who holds imperial power. After searching for three years, he finally finds his sister Lin Jiaojiao, who has fallen to the bottom of society and is publicly humiliated and rejected in marriage by the heir of Duke Anguo. He domineeringly declares her the State-Protecting Grand Princess. Using modern knowledge, he helps his sister build a Jiangnan intelligence empire, slaps down snobbish noble families, confronts the powerful Northern Di enemies, and cleanses treacherous officials from the court. The siblings join forces to rise from the bottom and secure the top power of Great Liang. Packed with satisfying moments from start to finish, it can be enjoyed in one go.
314467.seasonTitle: My Brother Became the Regent Season 1

314468.title: I Rule the Galaxy with a Girl Group Fleet
314468.evaluate: Modern youth Zhao Chen stays up late gaming and dozes off in class, then transmigrates into a fallen noble named Zhao Chen in the interstellar era. He binds a "Super Interstellar Fleet System" that can only recruit female soldiers. Overcoming resource shortages, outside doubts, and pressure from many sides, he builds the "Star Iris" fleet. Through star gate defense battles, an imperial military exercise comeback, and alien resource contests, he gradually gains a technological edge and establishes himself as a rising regional power, laying the foundation for future interstellar expansion.
314468.seasonTitle: I Rule the Galaxy with a Girl Group Fleet

314469.title: Love Missions Across the Galaxy S1
314469.evaluate:
Su Qian transmigrated into an interstellar beast world as the villainess.Forced to bind an otome system, she has to win over six commanders who loathe her to survive.
She only wants to earn enough points to escape and live freely.But the Silver Wolf, Elk, Golden Eagle, Lynx, Octopus, and Pirate—all once her enemies—are now utterly obsessed with her.
They block her way, eyes bloodshot:“Su Qian, you’re leaving after capturing our hearts. What about us?”
314469.seasonTitle: Love Missions Across the Galaxy S1

314470.title: Falling into the Wild
314470.evaluate: When the Li family falls from grace, Li Wanyi is forced to marry a man old enough to be her father. But Song Yubai, the man she has secretly loved for years, publicly announces that she is his wife. A marriage before love, with rumored girlfriends and gentle seniors taking turns interfering, leading to endless misunderstandings, jealousy, and dramatic confrontations. He angrily divorces her over a misunderstanding, then regrets it deeply and chases her desperately. In truth, they had secretly loved each other all along. He not only spoils her beyond measure but also uncovers the truth behind her father's framed conviction, bringing sweet revenge.

314471.title: Willows in the Evening Breeze
314471.evaluate:
Gold-digging heroine × top-tier powerful mature man | Adult push-and-pull | Experienced woman, untouched man | Forced entanglement | A high-status man humbles himself for love | Passion after a long drought | Slice-of-life plot | Happy ending
: "All the assets under my name will be yours. Stay, don't leave me, okay?"

314472.title: After Transmigrating into the Drama, the Doormat Becomes a Scumbag's Nightmare
314472.evaluate: In a short drama world, Fu Xinhan throws his wife Su Manning and daughter Fu Zhaodi out of the house for his mistress Su Tian'er, leaving them to freeze to death in the snow. A northeastern girl and the Little Wealth God possess them respectively. Su Manning becomes tough with her fists, beating anyone who insults her. Fu Zhaodi gains a special 'backlash' ability. The scumbag Fu Xinhan keeps failing and brings in his overseas-returned cousin Fu Jinyan, but Fu Jinyan falls in love with Su Manning at first sight after she saves him. The three join forces, and the scumbag repeatedly breaks down. Su Manning successfully divorces, and after getting drunk, her feelings for Fu Jinyan deepen. In the end, Fu Xinhan and his accomplices bring about their own miserable downfall, while Su Manning, Fu Zhaodi, and Fu Jinyan move forward together into a new life.
314472.seasonTitle: After Transmigrating into the Drama, the Doormat Becomes a Scumbag's Nightmare

314473.title: Doted to the Bone: The Reborn Educated Youth Wins the Tough Soldier's Heart
314473.evaluate: Reborn back in the 1970s, Song Shijin rises against fate with her mystic space and spirit spring! She tears apart her past-life enemies Huang Xiaoqin and Zhou Xulang, outsmarts toxic relatives, and joins forces with soldier Pei Huaichuan to break through layers of conspiracies. From seizing a teaching post to making money in the black market, and even repeatedly saving lives as a brave good Samaritan, she ultimately averts Pei Huaichuan's deadly calamity. The whole family reunites and moves to the city, starting a happy new life.
314473.seasonTitle: Doted to the Bone: The Reborn Educated Youth Wins the Tough Soldier's Heart

314474.title: The Immortal Furnace Daoist
314474.evaluate: Sixteen-year-old Gouwa was a lowly laborer bullied by everyone in Blackwater Village. After his parents died tragically, he was thrown into an abyss as a sacrifice. On the verge of death, he was unexpectedly chosen as the master by the pill furnace of Taishang Laojun, which had been dormant for three thousand years. Reborn from the flames, he changed his name to Wang Li and used the furnace to defy fate, refining spiritual food, turning waste pills into treasure, and entering an immortal sect. With a heaven-grade spiritual root, he shocked the sect and further obtained the pill scripture and an ancient bloodline inheritance. As the Blood Demon Lord revived, the Heaven's Secret Elder plotted behind the scenes, and the Immortal Court coveted the mortal world, a three-realm war was about to erupt. Wang Li used heaven and earth as his furnace to refine peerless divine pills, sweeping away powerful enemies and trampling the immortal world, rising from a lowly ant to become the supreme pill dao sovereign who awed all three realms.

314475.title: Game Invasion: I Have Ten Thousand Talents
314475.evaluate: When the game world 'Apocalypse Continent' invades reality, protagonist Lin Yi enters the other world to uncover the truth behind his brother's brutal death. There he awakens a unique all-purpose talent and grows into the 'Myriad Sequence One', fighting the evil organization 'Black Card Alliance' and its world-ending schemes across both worlds. Along the way, he gradually unites surviving forces from both realms and embarks on a journey to save them.
314475.seasonTitle: Game Invasion: I Have Ten Thousand Talents

314476.title: The Reborn General's Daughter and the Prince Who Overturns the Court
314476.evaluate: Shen Wanyin dies full of resentment and is reborn at the turning point of her fate. She remembers bitterly the pain of trusting the wrong man and dying in the Eastern Palace in her previous life. In this life, she casts aside her innocence, crushes the heartless scoundrel, and schemes step by step against the Eastern Palace's power plays. By a twist of fate, she becomes entangled with Xie Yunjin, Prince of Yan, who hides his sharp edge behind a harmless facade. From mutual testing to a powerful alliance, the two stir up storms in the court and settle every blood debt. On the day her revenge is complete, she leaves behind all glory, and together with Xie Yunjin, walks away from strife to live out their peaceful days in seclusion among the mountains and waters.
314476.seasonTitle: The Reborn General's Daughter and the Prince Who Overturns the Court

314477.title: The Regent's Comical Secret Agent Princess
314477.evaluate: Lan Xiyue, a modern secret agent and renowned master of medicine and poison known as the Ghost-Hand Miracle Doctor, wants to leave her organization and live a free life. She takes on one final mission—stealing the Purple Spirit Ring—as the price for her freedom. However, the organization never intended to let her go, so Lan Xiyue resolutely triggers her explosive device and dies together with her enemies. When she opens her eyes again, she finds herself in another world, having become a noble daughter of a marquis household with the same name, infamous for being a flirtatious and domineering troublemaker. Lan Xiyue thinks this is heaven granting her a retirement life, but unexpectedly, a system suddenly appears and tells her she has only one month left to live...
314477.seasonTitle: The Regent's Comical Secret Agent Princess

314478.title: Return of the Ruthless Princess: The Demon Lord's Endless Desire
314478.evaluate: She was the empire's first princess, with peerless beauty and extraordinary talent, doted on by the emperor and the retired emperor for fifteen years—yet on her coming-of-age day, her closest family betrayed her, her divine bone was brutally carved out, and she was cast into the abyss on the verge of death. But the abyss was not the end. A powerful soul from another world possessed her body at that moment. She devoured the golden lotus, forged sacred bones, and tamed ten thousand beasts, transforming in three years from an abandoned girl into a supreme ruler who makes the abyss tremble. Three years later, she stands alone at the edge of the abyss, gazing toward the empire with calm yet lethal eyes—those who once threw her into hell will soon witness her return, stepping over their bones.
314478.seasonTitle: Return of the Ruthless Princess: The Demon Lord's Endless Desire

314479.title: The World Grew Ten Thousand Times Over—So I Fought My Way Out
314479.evaluate: In the year 2067, 43 years after Earth expanded ten thousand times, Chen Ran, a lonely island youth in Huijiang Town, has been mocked as a "waste" for three years. Stuck at 432 kilograms and unable to break through, he suffers a broken engagement from a wealthy family and the crippling of his sister's martial arts. But after awakening the golden finger "Divine Platform Sacrifice," he rises by hunting blood beasts and growing stronger by eating their flesh, crushing town bullies, gang overlords, and Divine Alliance powerhouses along the way. From a bottom-tier waste on the isolated island, he becomes the leader of the human coalition. In the end, he wields his butcher blade to slay the Demon Emperor and shatter the ultimate scheme of Chun, an immortal who has fused with a human tree, protecting humanity's last hope. The story ends with an open conclusion, hinting that an even greater threat from the depths of the universe is approaching.
314479.seasonTitle: The World Grew Ten Thousand Times Over—So I Fought My Way Out

314480.title: The Righteous Way to the West: From Heavenly Soldier to Great Heavenly Lord
314480.evaluate: When Sun Wukong wreaks havoc in the Heavenly Palace, the Jade Emperor relies on the Punishment Deity Gu Jing to keep his throne secure, only to be shocked to find Gu Jing sleeping brazenly in the Queen Mother's palace without any restraint. Chaos spreads through the heavens: screams from the Moon Palace, tears from the Mysterious Lady of the Nine Heavens, and secret laughter from the Flower Fairy are all tied to this immensely powerful Punishment Deity. Gu Jing corrupts the heavens, shields female immortals, and controls the punishment of all three realms, his fearsome name shaking the world. He goes on to campaign west against Lingshan, unify the three paths, trample the underworld, and strike down the Ninth Heaven with his sword, creating an unprecedented legend. And the beginning of this heaven-defying saga starts at the moment the Seven Fairies are bathing...
314480.seasonTitle: The Righteous Way to the West: From Heavenly Soldier to Great Heavenly Lord

314481.title: The Time-Travel Convenience Store
314481.evaluate: Lin Chen, a graduate in cultural relic appraisal from a second-rate university, fails to find a job due to intense academic competition. He takes over his grandfather's old convenience store. While sorting through it, he accidentally discovers a hidden compartment and travels back in time to ancient Bianjing. Using his professional knowledge, he identifies a Ru kiln bowl and trades a lighter for the treasure. He befriends Zhao Yanran, the daughter of the richest man, and together they run the convenience store, quickly making it popular through modern marketing such as princess endorsements and delivery services. Lin Chen brings antiques back to the modern world and, with help from Su Wanqing, the heir of an antique family, co-founds 'Lin Chen Antique Shop'. In ancient times, the corrupt official Zhou Shixian frames the Zhao family after his interests are harmed. Lin Chen and Zhao Yanran gather evidence to fight back and ultimately clear the family's name.

314482.title: Guide to Winning Jiang Ruo: The Reborn Noble Daughter Turns the Tide
314482.evaluate: Jiang Ruo, terminally ill, binds to a quick-transmigration system to save herself and her sister. To survive and complete her missions, she must navigate between her targets: Shi Yubai, Demon Lord Cang Jue, Fifth Prince Jing Chengyuan, and Gatekeeper Rong Chu. Through deception, betrayal, redemption, and sacrifice, she discovers that every target is a fragment of the same soul. Caught between missions and true feelings, she fights to survive and gradually approaches the truth, vowing to gather all the fragments and find the one who has always been waiting for her.
314482.seasonTitle: Guide to Winning Jiang Ruo: The Reborn Noble Daughter Turns the Tide

314483.title: I Have a Mirror of Replication
314483.evaluate: Ordinary high school student Ji Qianming awakens a rare leaf-mark system called Mirror Flower after a bizarre car accident, gaining an incredible replication ability and stepping into a hidden battlefield against an invasion from the divine realm. Joining Gouchen Academy, he forms a team with genius Zhang Fan and sword master Yusheng Yuan. When his teammates are gravely wounded protecting others, Ji Qianming replicates a god-level healing mark and even accidentally seals the remnant soul of the ancient ferocious beast Zhuyan. Sent to a Western academy, he falls into a church conspiracy. In a deadly battle in London, he goes berserk with the power of the ferocious beast, is saved by a divine mark left by his father, and gains an ancient divine artifact. To protect a close friend targeted by the divine realm, he fakes his death and becomes the undercover agent Joker, rescues a mysterious girl who is the embodiment of fear, and finally accepts a mission to assassinate his close friend, starting a life-and-death protection under a double identity.
314483.seasonTitle: I Have a Mirror of Replication

314484.title: Alchemy Emperor of the Martial Dao: You Broke Off Our Engagement—Now You Regret It
314484.evaluate: In Cangyun City, young Ye Yan is humiliated when the Yun family breaks off his engagement, but he unexpectedly awakens the Myriad Dao Emperor Body and vows to defy fate. Relying on his emperor body, alchemy, and soul power, he defeats powerful enemies again and again, sweeps through Cangyun City, and enters Wanyan Academy to investigate the mystery of his father's disappearance. Fighting alongside Ming Ruoyu, a maiden with the Divine Phoenix Emperor Body, he crushes the Yun family's pride at the imperial alchemy competition and shakes the world by resisting tyranny. To save his beloved, find his father, and destroy the Yun family's schemes, Ye Yan battles through bloodshed, uncovering the secrets of his origins and the Saint King Runes, rising from a fallen youth into a peerless prodigy excelling in both alchemy and martial arts as he steps onto the pinnacle of the martial path.
314484.seasonTitle: Alchemy Emperor of the Martial Dao: You Broke Off Our Engagement—Now You Regret It

314485.title: The Mad Doctor Descends the Mountain
314485.evaluate: Shen Chuan, once addicted to gambling and abusive toward his wife, remained unrepentant even when his daughter desperately needed a bone marrow transplant, pushing his family to the brink of collapse. After being reborn, Shen Chuan unexpectedly awakens the spiritual awareness of the Shen family ancestor, gaining traditional Chinese medical secrets and special abilities. He defies arrogant experts in the hospital and cures his critically ill daughter. While working as a food delivery rider, he saves a corporate CEO and instantly becomes a private doctor. Facing gang provocations and schemes from petty rivals, he repels enemies with silver needles and sees through deceit with keen insight. In the end, Shen Chuan establishes a traditional Chinese medicine clinic, helps Yunxi resolve her crisis, and ultimately becomes a renowned doctor, achieving both family harmony and career success.
314485.seasonTitle: The Mad Doctor Descends the Mountain

314486.title: The Little Heavenly Master Who Says the Opposite
314486.evaluate: Five-and-a-half-year-old Hua Xiaoyu is the last surviving child of the Hua family of exorcists, and also the reincarnation of an ancestor. That ancestor once sealed the evil Peacock Mage, but was cursed through the bloodline: every generation is doomed to say the opposite of what they mean and to suffer the fate of solitude. Xiaoyu has astonishing talent but bears the heaviest curse, and a fatal calamity is approaching, dragging her five masters into danger as well. To break the curse, her fifth master Jiang Ning seeks out Qin Tianqi, a man of exceptionally good fortune, and takes Xiaoyu to the Shen family hotel to stage an accident. But they run into Shen Juan, the eldest young master of the Shen family. Since childhood, Shen Juan has been branded as someone who brings death to his relatives and was abandoned by his father. After returning home, his grandmother falls gravely ill, and he is further oppressed by his stepmother's Qin family. Yet Xiaoyu's reverse-speaking truth instead helps Shen Juan expose the Qin family's hypocrisy, save his grandmother, and reveal the affair between his fiancée and Qin Tianqi. It is also discovered that Shen Juan's alleged cursed fate was actually caused by a blood curse planted in him as a child, and that his luck had been stolen by Qin Tianqi. Xiaoyu and Shen Juan save each other, working together to break the curse and reclaim his destiny, while Shen Juan also rekindles an old bond with Jiang Ning.
314486.seasonTitle: The Little Heavenly Master Who Says the Opposite

314487.title: The General's Daughter Divorces Her Husband at the Wedding
314487.evaluate: Startled back to life, even a slacking noble lady shines! Liu Piaopiao was once a general's cherished daughter, but she went mad for love, gave her heart to the wrong man, and died full of regret. Reborn, she tears up the marriage contract and throws off her bridal veil. From then on, she abandons love-struck foolishness and refuses endless striving. Using "slacking off" as her armor and clear-headedness as her edge, she flees the wedding and becomes entangled with the seemingly carefree but deeply hidden Fifth Prince. On one side, a scumbag presses closer step by step; on the other, a true love offers gentle protection. Pretending to slack off, she secretly lays out her plans. In the whirlpool of power, she uses memories of her past life to turn the tables, protecting her family's glory and embracing a lifetime of deep love. Both satisfaction and sweetness are maxed out! Startled back to life, even a slacking noble lady shines! Liu Piaopiao was once a general's cherished daughter, but she went mad for love, gave her heart to the wrong man, and died full of regret. Reborn, she tears up the marriage contract and throws off her bridal veil. From then on, she abandons love-struck foolishness and refuses endless striving. Using "slacking off" as her armor and clear-headedness as her edge, she flees the wedding and becomes entangled with the seemingly carefree but deeply hidden Fifth Prince. On one side, a scumbag presses closer step by step; on the other, a true love offers gentle protection. Pretending to slack off, she secretly lays out her plans. In the whirlpool of power, she uses memories of her past life to turn the tables, protecting her family's glory and embracing a lifetime of deep love. Both satisfaction and sweetness are maxed out!
314487.seasonTitle: The General's Daughter Divorces Her Husband at the Wedding

314488.title: Return to the Peak!
314488.evaluate: Gu Changge went into hiding for eight years for his country. Upon his glorious return, he is misunderstood by his fiancée Su Wanqing. As rivals provoke him and villains scheme against him, he reveals his identity at a school founding ceremony—the school was actually named after him. The divine doctor, the god of war, and the dragon marshal all appear one after another, respectfully calling him teacher! He turns the tide to save his father-in-law, crushes the Feng family, and humiliates foreign enemies. In the end, he clears up all misunderstandings and marries Su Wanqing in glory!

314489.title: Reunited in the Twilight of Years
314489.evaluate: During the知青 (educated youth) sent-down movement, a young man deeply falls in love with a mountain village girl, but the wave of returning to the city forces them apart. After returning, the man builds a successful career and leads a stable life; the girl is forced to marry a cruel man and endures years of grievance and suffering. Years later, they unexpectedly reunite when she becomes a housemaid in his home, and their long-buried feelings reignite. This late love faces repeated obstacles: his adopted son deliberately schemes against them, her ex-husband seizes the chance to blackmail them, and elders strongly oppose the relationship. The man is manipulated into losing his memory and status, while the woman stays by his side and cares for him. After learning the truth about his origins, the man's biological son steps forward to resolve the crisis and punish the wrongdoers. Through many trials and reconciliations, the two overcome all barriers and finally join hands to spend the rest of their lives together, fulfilling the regrets of half a lifetime.
314489.seasonTitle: Reunited in the Twilight of Years

314490.title: I Did the Time—Now the CEO Is Sick with Regret
314490.evaluate: Chu Jiao and her lover Lu Heng built a business together, with a bright future ahead, until she was unexpectedly recognized by the Chu family as their long-lost true daughter. But she was betrayed by her biological father and took the fall for someone else, spending three years in prison. After her release, everything has changed. Reuniting with Lu Heng leads to endless misunderstandings, and her adoptive father is mistreated by the Chu family. The fake daughter Chu Shiqi schemes against her at every turn. Offending Lu Heng makes finding a job impossible, so Chu Jiao ends up working at his company. Amid family feuds and tangled love and hate, she breaks through every obstacle and turns the tables.
314490.seasonTitle: I Did the Time—Now the CEO Is Sick with Regret

314491.title: Return of the War Lord: Don't Mess with the Jade Heiress
314491.evaluate: Carrying a late friend's final wish, a top war lord hides his power and travels to Hong City alone to secretly protect his friend's orphaned daughter. When a stunning female CEO becomes trapped in mounting crises, she offers a huge reward to recruit a personal bodyguard. He casually goes to apply and crushes all competitors with unmatched strength, earning a place by her side. As dark forces outside the city eye them and internal family conflicts breed endless schemes, danger closes in step by step. He strategizes and uses overwhelming power to break through every trap, defusing one deadly crisis after another to keep her safe. As they spend time together day and night, tenderness grows between them, and they gradually fall for each other. In the end, they smash the masterminds behind the conspiracies, remove every obstacle, and share a lifetime of mutual love.
314491.seasonTitle: Return of the War Lord: Don't Mess with the Jade Heiress

314493.title: Two Lifetimes of Tortured Love
314493.evaluate: Fu Zhenxin rises from the ashes and returns as Fu Jiaxin, carrying her hatred. Joining forces with Gu Yizhen, she schemes step by step through business battles and hidden conspiracies to bring down their old enemy Fu Qingyu. The past misunderstanding as a stand-in stirs up love and pain, and a confrontation in the ancestral hall tears away every disguise, revealing the bond between past and present lives. In the end, she recognizes her true feelings and embraces a love that spans reincarnations.

314494.title: On My Wedding Night, I Discovered My New Family Are All Killers
314494.evaluate: Shen Su attends her sister's wedding but witnesses her sister being murdered. To uncover the truth, she takes her sister's place and marries into the suspicious Xu family. At the wedding banquet, the Xu family's strange behavior puts her on alert, and she begins a secret investigation. She suspects one person after another, then teams up with Xu Yiyang's younger brother to help him steal documents and rise to power. But after gaining control, he turns on Shen Su, imprisons her, and murders Xu Yiyang. At the funeral, he shifts the blame onto her. At the critical moment, Xu Yiyang appears alive—it turns out the car accident was a trap set by the two of them to film his crimes. In the end, the truth behind her sister's death is revealed, and Shen Su finally gets justice for her sister.
314494.seasonTitle: On My Wedding Night, I Discovered My New Family Are All Killers

314495.title: Love Missions Across the Galaxy S2
314495.evaluate:
Su Qian transmigrated into an interstellar beast world as the villainess.Forced to bind an otome system, she has to win over six commanders who loathe her to survive.
She only wants to earn enough points to escape and live freely.But the Silver Wolf, Elk, Golden Eagle, Lynx, Octopus, and Pirate—all once her enemies—are now utterly obsessed with her.
They block her way, eyes bloodshot:“Su Qian, you’re leaving after capturing our hearts. What about us?”
314495.seasonTitle: Love Missions Across the Galaxy S2

314496.title: Love Missions Across the Galaxy S3
314496.evaluate:
Su Qian transmigrated into an interstellar beast world as the villainess.Forced to bind an otome system, she has to win over six commanders who loathe her to survive.
She only wants to earn enough points to escape and live freely.But the Silver Wolf, Elk, Golden Eagle, Lynx, Octopus, and Pirate—all once her enemies—are now utterly obsessed with her.
They block her way, eyes bloodshot:“Su Qian, you’re leaving after capturing our hearts. What about us?”
314496.seasonTitle: Love Missions Across the Galaxy S3

314497.title: Three Years Before the Apocalypse
314497.evaluate: The apocalypse has not yet arrived, but the system activates ahead of time. The zombie tyrant from three years later is now a delicate and pitiful young lady, while the future invincible fierce beast is merely a kitten trapped in a cage. Living in a peaceful era, Su Bai earns survival points freely and strengthens himself constantly. When the apocalypse finally comes, he has already become a god on earth.

314498.title: Fresh Off the Wedding, Filing for Divorce—The Star Commander Panicked
314498.evaluate:
Although Su Luo married the most powerful and strongest man in the Alpha Star Empire, she was desperate to break off the engagement.
All she wanted was to escape this arranged marriage, never knowing that the seemingly cold and unapproachable His Royal Highness had long hidden all his sharp edges, quietly turning soft and clingy only for her.

In general, he was the ruthless imperial commander whom no one dared to disobey.
Yet alone with her, he would lower his eyes, his gaze reddening, and whisper 
“Are you leaving me again?”
~ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
Step by step, soft and gentle,
he used his tenderest side to trap every thought of escape in her heart.
This marriage—he would never let go, not in this lifetime.
314498.seasonTitle: Fresh Off the Wedding, Filing for Divorce—The Star Commander Panicked

314499.title: The Sword Master of Daxia
314499.evaluate:
The Great Snow Dragon Cavalry—the personal guard of the Grand Xia Sword Sovereign—was a legendary force composed of three thousand peak war gods. It was said that any who joined its ranks would etch their name into the annals of history, revered for eternity.
Yet none knew that the very Sword Sovereign, the invincible ruler of this world, was Lu Wuwei, the disgraced outcast of the Lu family, once scorned as the shame of the imperial capital seven years ago.
Now, Lu Wuwei has returned in silence—only to be met with disdain from his own betrothed, a renowned war goddess, and a ruthless corporate queen, both demanding to sever their engagements.
Watch as he shatters their arrogance with overwhelming power, humiliating every last fool who ever dared look down on him!

314500.title: Invincibility Begins at Foundation Building
314500.evaluate:
Ye Wu, the last remnant of an ancient cultivation era, secluded himself deep within the Hundred Thousand Mountains to forge his Foundation—emerging after just two days of meditation, only to discover that two millennia had slipped away like sand through his fingers.
he once-mighty Qingyun Sect had faded into myth, leaving behind only abandoned valleys and fragmented whispers of the past. Now, standing at the chasm of time itself, Ye Wu must navigate a world where everything he knew is dust... and his very existence defies the laws of heaven and earth.

314501.title: I Upset Millions of Cultivators
314501.evaluate:
Jiang Bei found himself inexplicably transported to the Starfall Continent, armed with a unique cultivation system that thrived on one thing: rage.
To survive and grow stronger, he embraced a daily routine of calculated chaos—purposefully provoking enemies and allies alike to fuel his power with their fury. His antics caught the attention of his long-lost brother, Jiang Nan, who dragged him into the ruthless world of true cultivators.
But everything changed when Jiang Bei uncovered a devastating secret:
His missing mother was none other than the legendary Witch of the Netherrealms, imprisoned in the demonic abyss. Now, armed with his rage-forged strength and his brother’s guidance, Jiang Bei vows to storm the forbidden Demon Domain—even if it means burning the heavens to ashes along the way.

314502.title: I Really Don't Want to Become an Immortal Saint
314502.evaluate: This is a world where literature holds supreme power. Scholars command all the essential things regarding literature. Li Chang'an, bringing memories of past life after his rebirth, steps into this world and the God decrees him the Sage Immortal!
314502.seasonTitle: I Really Don't Want to Become an Immortal Saint

314503.title: Return of the Tycoon
314503.evaluate:
A gentleman’s revenge is never too late—even after six years!
Six years ago, Ye Hao was framed by his brother and sent to prison. Now, six years later, he returns in glory, determined to reclaim everything that was taken from him. Those six years were both torment and tempering for Ye Hao.
Through relentless effort, he eventually forces his brother out of the family business and is chosen as its new leader. But instead of seeking revenge, Ye Hao chooses fairness and wisdom, leading the family enterprise toward a brighter and more prosperous future.

314504.title: I Brought a Military Novel to Another World—After Healing the Prince, He Insists on Being My Underling
314504.evaluate: Medical doctor Feng Qianqian transmigrates with a military novel into another world. After barely escaping a mass grave, she inherits the original host's dying wish and sets out to take revenge on the second concubine and her daughter of the Feng household. Relying on her ghost eyes, spatial medical skills, and modern weapons, she opens a clinic, saves the Seventh Prince Nangong Li, searches for her biological brother, and uncovers conspiracies. In the process, she reveals the power struggles of the court and the truth of her own origins. Ultimately, she joins forces with Nangong Li to quell the rebellion, gaining both love and honor.
314504.seasonTitle: I Brought a Military Novel to Another World—After Healing the Prince, He Insists on Being My Underling

314505.title: Bloody Twin Flowers
314505.evaluate:
Twelve years ago, the Su family, who held the core secret of a vast inheritance, was suddenly wiped out. The parents died tragically, while the eldest daughter Su Muyao and the younger daughter Su Muqing survived but were forced apart. The murderer Lu Zeyuan abducted Su Muyao, imprisoned and brainwashed her, shaping her into a docile and dependent Mrs. Lu while concealing her true identity. The younger sister Su Muqing narrowly escaped, went into hiding under the name Qingyu, endured plastic surgery to change her appearance, and spent years studying medicine in preparation for revenge.

As an adult, Qingyu used her exceptional medical skills to infiltrate the Lu household as the family doctor, steadily approaching the center of power. While pretending to be meek, she searched cautiously for her sister, only to discover that the Mrs. Lu she saw every day was actually Su Muyao, who had lost all her memories.

Facing an amnesiac loved one and a ruthless enemy, Qingyu maneuvers through the dangers of exposure, Lu Zeyuan's suspicion, and the crushing pressure of powerful family politics. She must awaken her sister's memory, expose Lu Zeyuan's crimes, and protect the Su family inheritance. In the end, the sisters join forces to tear apart the conspiracy and complete their revenge amid love and hate.

314506.title: Transmigrated Twice: I'll Rebuild a Golden Age
314506.evaluate: Lin Feng, a down-and-out web novelist, is pushed to the brink by debt collectors and accidentally awakens a two-way travel power after an electric shock. One moment he's in his rental apartment being hounded by the landlady and harassed by online loan companies; the next, he crosses into a corpse-strewn ancient battlefield. Even more incredible, he can bring things back and forth between the two worlds. A two-yuan pack of industrial refined salt becomes immortal salt worth its weight in gold in a famine-ravaged chaotic era. A one-yuan lighter becomes divine fire that can summon wind and rain in the eyes of superstitious ancients. A ten-yuan bar of soap becomes immortal balm frantically sought by nobles and officials. Modern knowledge builds cement city walls and homemade explosives, a crushing advantage over all cold weapons.
314506.seasonTitle: Transmigrated Twice: I'll Rebuild a Golden Age

314507.title: Kunlun's Thunder Rider
314507.evaluate: In 2050, the Kunlun Divine Stone appears. Qi Wenkai and other descendants of the Ten Heroes assemble to retrieve the stone from the Qixing Group, with Park Jingna following them in hope of redemption. While searching for their companions, they are ambushed by the Matsuda clan of Japan. Hero Zhang sacrifices himself, and the stone changes hands several times before being desperately reclaimed. Matsuda Sosuke leads a mecha army to seize the stone and gain supreme power. At the critical moment, the Great Xia Dragon Guards break through the clouds, three heroes return to their positions, and the Ten Heroes reunite to destroy the enemy mecha. The Matsuda father and son are captured. Nine motorcycles and a black horse charge toward the snowy peaks of Kunlun, as Great Xia declares that all who covet the stone will be punished no matter how far away they are.

314508.title: Mistaking the Demon Lord for My True Love
314508.evaluate: Ten years of secret love for a dream lover? Just a case of blindness! So what if she drunkenly slept with the Demon Lord disguised as the crown prince? She signs a master-servant contract and turns the Demon Lord feared across the three realms into her personal bodyguard! Her phoenix bloodline awakens, she tears apart the hypocritical false beloved, and tramples the scheming heavenly consort. Whoever covets her bloodline, she destroys their lair! She runs off with a baby in her belly, while the Demon Lord goes mad across the three realms, searching for her for three years at any cost. It turns out this seemingly accidental wrong love is a fated scheme spanning thirty thousand years. In this life, she refuses to be anyone's accessory and will only be the master of her own fate.
314508.seasonTitle: Mistaking the Demon Lord for My True Love

314509.title: They Call Me a Great Sage in Another World
314509.evaluate: Chu Feng embarks on a journey to find his family but unexpectedly awakens the divine power of speaking things into existence. During a scorching drought, he casually prays for rain, and sweet rain falls at once. A demon king comes seeking guidance, and Chu Feng's idle talk on dragon-snake transformation helps it break through and evolve into a flood dragon. Humans revere him as a god, and all demons honor him as their ancestor. Little do they know he is just saying random things, yet whenever someone gains enlightenment, a dao flame ignites in his dantian, automatically tempering his body and skyrocketing his cultivation!
314509.seasonTitle: They Call Me a Great Sage in Another World

314510.title: Billionaire’s Regret
314510.evaluate: Five years ago, Max was attacked, and Chloe risked her life to save him, leaving her arm with a permanent injury. Five years later, they unexpectedly reunite. During an argument, Chloe's old injury flares up, making Max suspicious. Chloe starts working at the group, but her controlling mother strictly prevents her from dating and even uses photoshopped pictures of muscular men to block suitors. At work, she is repeatedly bullied by the director. Max becomes convinced she is his savior and prepares a valuable diamond ring as thanks. However, the director schemes to have her cousin impersonate Chloe. Max falls for the lie and cruelly hurts his real savior. After the truth comes out and the villains are punished, the two finally clear up all misunderstandings and embrace the love they had long been waiting for.

314511.title: One Day Inside the Cauldron, a Hundred Years Outside—Invincible Upon Emergence
314511.evaluate: Li Xuan, young master of the Imperial Clan, is banished to the mortal world and starts as a worthless outcast, humiliated from the very beginning. In his moment of crisis, he awakens the God-Burying Cauldron and a trial system, seizing fortune meant for others and rebuilding his imperial foundation. He rescues a heroine blessed with phoenix energy and uses her admiration to rapidly cultivate godhood. He storms the Zhao estate to claim the Ancient Flame Body, devours an earth vein dragon spirit in the arena, and sweeps through Cangyang. He infiltrates the Divine Flame Sect, empties its treasure vault, reverses a blood sacrifice grand array, and wipes out the demonic sect. Facing pursuit from the upper realm and heavenly tribulation, his body becomes a saintly vessel and he shatters immortal weapons barehanded. Finally, with one sword strike he splits the heavenly gate and declares war on the immortal realm alongside the empress!
314511.seasonTitle: One Day Inside the Cauldron, a Hundred Years Outside—Invincible Upon Emergence

314512.title: Insectoid Apocalypse: Reset
314512.evaluate: Elite special agent Raymond gets a once-in-a-lifetime do-over: he’s reborn fully conscious, 72 hours before the xenomorph apocalypse wipes human civilization off the map.

314513.title: Forty Years of Laying Low—My Mom Runs the Whole Conglomerate
314513.evaluate: A 45-year-old ordinary mother is treated as a worthless live-in housekeeper by her husband, in-laws, and grown children. After an accident during the demolition of their old house, she discovers the truth about her life being switched when she was young: she was supposed to be the heir of a long-established local family business. Instead of immediately claiming her family, she uses the patience, budgeting skills, and judgment she developed over twenty years as a housewife to step by step reclaim her dignity, career, and life.
314513.seasonTitle: Forty Years of Laying Low—My Mom Runs the Whole Conglomerate

314514.title: Starlit Destiny
314514.evaluate: Lu Xingci, the top scorer of the college entrance exam, comes from a poor family and works part-time to support himself while entering Kyoto University. He has no idea that he is the only son of the Lu family, a top-tier wealthy household in the capital, and that his parents deliberately raised him in poverty. Shen Qinghan, the head of the Lu family's rival Shen family, is a cold and ruthless businesswoman facing pressure from her family to produce an heir. On the day Lu Xingci arrives in the capital, Shen Qinghan schemes to become entangled with him. The two go through misunderstandings and real-life trials, remaining committed to each other, and eventually marry and have a child, living in harmony. When Lu Xingci's true identity is revealed, both husband and wife are shocked. Only then does Shen Qinghan learn that her lover is the heir of the rival Lu family, and Lu Xingci realizes that his wife is the head of the Shen family, his family's enemy.

314515.title: Flower-Fruit Mountain: A New Destiny
314515.evaluate: Five hundred years ago, the Buddha used the Six-Eared Macaque to replace Sun Wukong and imprisoned the real Monkey King under Mount Lingshan. Bajie accidentally discovered the truth and risked his life to seek help from Patriarch Bodhi. The Patriarch stormed the Underworld, confronted the Buddha, reversed time, and rescued Wukong. Wukong defeated the Six-Eared Macaque and forced the Heavenly Court and Mount Lingshan to reveal the wrongful case publicly. He then found Tang Sanzang, Sha Wujing, and the Little White Dragon, and they all gathered at Flower-Fruit Mountain. The mountain had long been ruined, but they gave up their Buddhist positions and rebuilt it together, taking in those who had no place in the Three Realms. Immortals and gods came one after another, all marveling that Wukong had endured so much yet never retreated. As Flower-Fruit Mountain gathered immense power, Wukong also helped the Lunar Goddess recover the remnant soul of Chang'e, gathered Hou Yi's sun-shooting divine weapons, and became entangled in the ancient karma of the Golden Crow. An even greater storm is approaching.

314516.title: Stay Back, Grandson — Grandpa's About to Operate
314516.evaluate: An accident sends his soul across a century, and on an ordinary day in the seventh year of the Hongwu reign, he is born in the imperial palace of Yingtian. He is the most noble child in the Great Ming. The apple of Zhu Yuanzhang's eye. The eldest legitimate grandson of Zhu Biao. Yet he is also the Prince of Yuhuai, barely a footnote in the history books. Watching the still-healthy Crown Prince Zhu Biao, watching Hu Weiyong and the Lan Yu case before they erupt in bloodshed, watching his still-youthful uncle, Prince of Yan Zhu Di — Zhu Xiongying quietly makes up his mind: he must not only survive, but also become emperor...
314516.seasonTitle: Stay Back, Grandson — Grandpa's About to Operate

314517.title: Hong Kong in the Eighties: The Special Forces Heiress Dominates
314517.evaluate: Ye Qiao, a modern female special forces soldier, dies a hero in a cross-border counterterrorism mission. When she opens her eyes again, she has transmigrated into the turbulent Hong Kong of the 1980s, becoming the fiancée of Gu Pei, the eldest son of the Gu family. As one of the individuals she had been assigned to protect during a 21st-century security operation, she immediately recognizes Gu Pei as a key behind-the-scenes figure who will make major contributions to the nation's vital scientific endeavors in the future. Given a second chance at life, Ye Qiao has only one goal: to protect Gu Pei from being crushed by the chaos of the era or harmed by villains. With her formidable combat skills, she and Gu Pei fight their way through the dangerous world of Hong Kong, taking down pirates, pacifying triads, foiling conspiracies, and subduing criminals, becoming legends of Hong Kong.
314517.seasonTitle: Hong Kong in the Eighties: The Special Forces Heiress Dominates

314518.title: Crimson Alchemy Rising
314518.evaluate: Lin Xiaoman, a lowly servant of Guiyuan Sect, is gravely wounded by fellow disciples and left for dead at the base of a cliff. On the verge of death, he awakens the dual legacies of the Alchemy God and the Dao of Blissful Union, rebuilding his spiritual root and leaping to the Foundation Establishment stage. Concealing his power and pretending to be crippled, he defeats the top disciple in the outer sect tournament, drawing the wary attention of Elder Xuanfeng. Xuanfeng frames him for theft, cripples his cultivation, and expels him from the sect. Lin Xiaoman seizes the chance to fake his death and leaves for the wildlands with Chu Lingxi. Along the way, he gathers talented companions in alchemy, swordsmanship, demonic arts, artifact crafting, and a fox spirit ally. Together, they explore secret realms, expose the crimes of Xuanfeng and his brother, thwart the schemes of the righteous sects, and work together to purify an ancient evil demon. They relight the Eternal Flame, then set off for a new secret realm: the Silent Ruins.

314519.title: Rebirth of the Zombie King: I Subdue the Three Realms with Daoist Arts
314519.evaluate: Young Qin Feng is murdered by villains and abandoned in the wilderness. His Daoist aunt, heartbroken, uses the potent yin-life force of a zombie king's inner core to bring him back to life. From then on, he embarks on a unique cultivation path. Qin Feng can absorb all kinds of evil spirits and demons, refine them into Daoist talismans to boost his power, and is also skilled in orthodox Daoist rituals of stepping patterns and hand seals. Along his journey, all manner of spirits and cultivators come to both respect and fear him. With his special bloodline, peachwood sword, and copper coin magic tools, he deters evil from all directions and protects the peace of the world.
314519.seasonTitle: Rebirth of the Zombie King: I Subdue the Three Realms with Daoist Arts

314520.title: Little Gu Girl: Eradicating the Drug Scourge
314520.evaluate: Duoduo, a girl from the Miao mountains, was raised with poison skills and her life-bound golden silkworm Gu. When she first arrives in town and encounters human traffickers with ill intentions, she easily subdues them with a light sprinkle of medicinal powder and hands them over to the police. Following her Gu insect's guidance, Duoduo heads to the border to find her family and happens upon her father, a narcotics officer, surrounded by a large group of drug traffickers. She blows her Miao flute to summon venomous insects, routing the traffickers, and thereafter becomes a capable unofficial assistant to the police. The golden silkworm Gu can precisely identify new types of drugs, and her trained venomous insects can search for hidden traffickers. Against foreign drug lords, Duoduo has her own intimidating methods, making her a special guardian widely recognized along the border defense line.
314520.seasonTitle: Little Gu Girl: Eradicating the Drug Scourge

314521.title: Black Myth: Bajie Returns
314521.evaluate: In the primordial world, countless clans coexist—humans, demons, witch clans, immortals, and the Western faith. Innate spiritual roots and supreme treasures abound, while all forces struggle for dominion. Heaven, Earth, and Human paths check each other in hidden conflict. Zhu Bajie, the eldest disciple of the Human Sect, entered the mortal world with Wukong after Lingshan fell. Wukong departed beyond the heavens due to the shackles of the Chaos Demon Ape's origin, while Bajie lost all his powers from incense backlash and fell to the mortal realm. Relying on unyielding will, he united humanity, used the power of the Human path to climb back to the peak step by step, and finally resisted the Heavenly and Earthly paths, making the Human path supreme over the other two and ruling the primordial world.

314522.title: Beast Whisperer: The Girl Who Guards the Green Mountain
314522.evaluate: Modern veterinarian She Jiaojiao transmigrates after a car accident while avoiding a stray cat, waking up as a poor farm girl in ancient times. Her family is destitute and plagued by troublesome relatives. She unexpectedly awakens the ability to understand animal language. After rescuing a trapped pheasant, various birds and beasts come to her for healing. Wild hares, the snake king, golden eagles, leopard cats, and more repay her with wild delicacies, medicinal herbs, and clues to mineral veins. With the help of the animal kingdom, she buys farmland and a house, supports her brother's education, and fiercely fights back against her scheming relatives. When her tamed white tiger grows into a fierce beast and enemy elephant cavalry invades the border, She Jiaojiao leads an army of beasts to the battlefield. Using her animal language skills and clever tactics, she helps the military repel the enemy and quell the war.
314522.seasonTitle: Beast Whisperer: The Girl Who Guards the Green Mountain

314523.title: My Remaining Days, Offered to Jiuhua
314523.evaluate: On an ordinary evening during his junior year, Yang Sanqian is taking a walk around the school field when he sees a group of girls surrounding and bullying someone. The thin figure reminds him of Liu Linyue, whom he once secretly loved. After hesitating, he steps in and drives the group away. But when he turns around and their eyes meet, he realizes the girl before him is a stranger named Lu Jiuhua. The burning affection in his eyes instantly fades. He apologizes plainly and walks away without another word. This mistaken rescue sparks both attraction and resentment in Lu Jiuhua, and begins an unexpected and long-lasting bond between her and the earnest, persistent Yang Sanqian.
314523.seasonTitle: My Remaining Days, Offered to Jiuhua

314524.title: I Run the Household—Daddy's Got My Back
314524.evaluate: Wen Ruan, a vicious villain obsessed with ruling the world, is reborn as the beloved daughter of Qin Jiuzhou, a brutal and terrifying living demon king feared by all. In the past, Qin Jiuzhou was sinister and frenzied, bent on rejecting the world, but ever since his daughter began shouting about unifying the realm and plotting his rise to power, he has let go of old grudges. The once alcoholic and obsessive mad prince has transformed into the ultimate doting father, teaching his daughter kindness at night, willingly coaxed and indulged by her, even sneaking around just to vent his madness in secret. And with his fierce protectiveness, he finally decides to truly raise an army and rebel.
314524.seasonTitle: I Run the Household—Daddy's Got My Back

314526.title: My Blue Cat Can Level Up
314526.evaluate: When doomsday suddenly hits, animals across the city mutate together. Lin Wanwan wakes up to find her British Shorthair Erhu has turned into a giant cat king who can talk and sass. To rescue her best friend Su Qingxue, she rides her cat into the collapsing city, saves an infected husky named Tank, and fights through mutated giant pigeons, cheetahs, black bears, white tigers, and a mother elephant. As everyone keeps evolving, they discover the source of the disaster is a giant python mother hidden in the zoo's back mountain. In the end, Erhu, Tank, and a returning honey badger named Tietou team up for the final battle in the snake nest.
314526.seasonTitle: My Blue Cat Can Level Up

314527.title: Storm Over Hong Kong: Young Master Gu's Special Forces Wife
314527.evaluate: Modern female special forces soldier Ye Qiao dies a hero's death during a cross-border counterterrorism mission, only to open her eyes again in the turbulent Hong Kong of the 1980s, where she has become the fiancée of Gu Pei, eldest son of the Gu family. As one of the targets Ye Qiao once protected during a 21st-century security mission, she recognizes Gu Pei at a glance as one of the key behind-the-scenes figures who will make major contributions to the nation's most important projects. Given a second chance at life, Ye Qiao has only one goal: protect Gu Pei and keep him from being crushed by the chaos of the era or harmed by villains. With her formidable combat skills, she and Gu Pei sweep through the treacherous world of Hong Kong, battling pirates, pacifying gangs, foiling conspiracies, and subduing criminals, becoming legends of the city.
314527.seasonTitle: Storm Over Hong Kong: Young Master Gu's Special Forces Wife

314528.title: My Brother Is a Blood Bag
314528.evaluate: This is a suspenseful ethical novel about rebirth, revenge, and human choices. It begins when the richest man in Wucheng publicly announces he is looking for 100 children born through his sperm donation, setting off a fateful game of greed, betrayal, and redemption. The protagonist, Jiang Hao, shares a shabby rental with his friend Lu Qing. When Lu Qing excitedly tells Jiang Hao that he may be the tycoon's biological son, Jiang Hao, out of kindness, warns him that the tycoon is gravely ill and that the paternity claim may have another purpose. However, after the tycoon dies, all the recognized children receive huge inheritances. Lu Qing blames Jiang Hao for ruining his chance at wealth and brutally murders him on Jiang Hao's birthday. Before dying, Jiang Hao learns two cruel truths: first, Lu Qing was never the benefactor who saved him from the fire, but the very person who deliberately locked him in the classroom; second, the tycoon's paternity recognition was a scam from beginning to end. Behind the so-called inheritance rights was a human experiment scheme disguised as "blood replacement for longevity" by Changsheng Group, and those recognized children were merely lab rats. Fate gives Jiang Hao a chance to start over. When he wakes again and returns to the day Lu Qing told him about his origins, he chooses a completely different path: instead of earnestly persuading him, he watches coldly and respects the other man's choice to seek his own destruction. In this life, Jiang Hao moves out of the shared rental and secretly reports Changsheng Group's illegal experiments to the police. Meanwhile, driven by greed and desperate to prove he is a "qualified heir," Lu Qing takes excessive amounts of the experimental drug without authorization, causing severe damage to his body. While clinging to a rich young woman, Lin Man, he fantasizes about becoming the tycoon's young master. After the Changsheng Group scam is exposed, he ends up burdened with enormous debt and utterly d...
314528.seasonTitle: My Brother Is a Blood Bag

314530.title: Are You Crazy? You Call This Horror Instance the Underworld Labor Market?
314530.evaluate: When others enter horror instances, they risk their lives and struggle to escape. When Xu Yan enters a horror instance, it's a job interview and talent recruitment. The butcher in the operating room of Midnight Central Hospital? The resentful teacher in the abandoned campus? The bloodthirsty fiend in the cursed old village house? Others tremble in fear: Run! It's a supernatural entity! Xu Yan adjusts his gold-rimmed glasses, pulls out a gilded employment contract, and says, "Don't panic. I'm the Business Director of the Underworld Group, and I'm here to give you an offer." Are you insane? You're calling this deadly horror instance the underworld labor market?! From then on, all supernatural horror instances across the worlds became long-term recruitment events. The chainsaw butcher joins the eighteen levels of hell as Chief Torture Engineer. Resentful spirits and vengeful ghosts are incorporated into official underworld positions. Even instance bosses line up, begging Xu Yan for a stable job. The underworld expands recruitment, supernatural beings take up posts, and the horror world is directly turned into a talent supply base!
314530.seasonTitle: Are You Crazy? You Call This Horror Instance the Underworld Labor Market?

314531.title: I Woke Up in the Wrong World After Becoming Invincible
314531.evaluate:
Lin Bei, 25, a modern office worker who died from exhaustion, only loved reading web novels. He thought he'd be reborn as a loser and rise against all odds—but he woke up in the wrong world. He entered the sequel to 'All Heavens and Myriad Realms' called 'Heavenly Emperor Era', possessing the body of an ancient Heavenly Emperor sealed ten thousand years ago. The seal will break automatically in 24 hours, restoring his full power. But right now, he has no strength at all. Descendants of the ascendants who sealed him, various factions, and even minions of the Chaos Demon God are already closing in, determined to kill him before midnight.
Even worse, every time he uses power, the seal breaks faster and the countdown shortens. Within 24 hours, he must survive as a powerless nobody while searching for a way to fully control his power. When the clock strikes midnight, he must complete his transformation from 'office worker' to 'Heavenly Emperor'.
At the sealed land, Su Wanqing, head disciple of Xuantian Sect, accidentally enters the forbidden area and saves the 'unconscious' Lin Bei. She thinks he's a lost mortal, not knowing she just saved the sealed Heavenly Emperor.
Chu Tian, direct descendant of an ascendant and Holy Son of Xuantian Sect, vows to kill Lin Bei before he awakens. He relentlessly pursues him—setting sect trials, sending assassins at night, even using forbidden weapons. Each time Lin Bei is forced to act, the countdown shrinks rapidly. Su Wanqing gradually senses something wrong through their battles together, and finally learns the truth at a life-or-death moment. They go from opposition to fighting side by side, from testing to trusting, dancing on a knife's edge while fleeing from killers. The countdown ticks away second by second as waves of danger crash in.
The moment the seal breaks, Lin Bei sweeps through all enemies as the Heavenly Emperor. But the true enemy emerges—the Chaos Demon God, the mastermind who manipulated the ascendants into sealing t...
314531.seasonTitle: I Woke Up in the Wrong World After Becoming Invincible

314532.title: Delivery Guy in the Apocalypse
314532.evaluate: When the red mist descends, delivery man Chen Ye accidentally absorbs a zombie core and awakens terrifying power. While fleeing, he teams up with a grizzled veteran, a cunning thief, and a genius mechanic to form a scrappy survival squad. After a deadly battle with a giant zombie king, a mysterious young cultivator appears and reveals the shocking secret behind the red mist. The group evolves from struggling survivors into a formidable team capable of facing zombie hordes head-on. But the true horror — the Shadow Overlord, source of all zombies — descends with unstoppable might. The five stand together for a final battle that will decide the fate of humanity.

314533.title: Corporate Slave Girl: Running a Stall in the Imperial Harem
314533.evaluate: Modern corporate slave Su Niannian dies from overwork and transmigrates into the unfavored Seventh Princess of the Great Jing Dynasty, banished to the cold palace. Faced with scheming in the harem and a dull palace life, she refuses to be dragged into internal power struggles. Taking 'slacking off' as her life motto, she founds the 'Slacker Startup Guild', bringing modern workplace thinking, food, and business logic into the ancient world — developing snacks, designing palace clothing, promoting cross-border trade, and even introducing a 'slacking-office system' to reform the imperial court. Along the way, she forms a 'Slacker Alliance' with the seemingly cold but secretly doting Emperor Xiao Jue and the wise yet restrained deposed Empress Jiang Wanci. Together they foil Prime Minister Liu's rebellion plot, quell harem unrest, and push Great Jing toward a prosperous era of 'no overwork, high efficiency, and happy citizens'. In the end, Su Niannian plants the idea that 'slacking off is not giving up, but living efficiently' deep into Great Jing, building her own unique 'Slacker Dynasty'.
314533.seasonTitle: Corporate Slave Girl: Running a Stall in the Imperial Harem

314534.title: When the Apocalypse Came, I Raised Zombies in My Dorm
314534.evaluate: A zombie virus breaks out during a CET-6 exam. In his previous life, Zhang Hao was betrayed and killed by his ex-girlfriend. This time, he empties a supermarket in advance and sets deadly traps in his dorm. Facing his ex-girlfriend's pleas, a rich heir's threats, and other survivors trying to steal his supplies, he watches coldly and lures them all into a death trap. When the zombie horde arrives and the dorm building turns into hell, Zhang Hao has already moved his supplies to the rooftop, where he finally waits for rescue.
314534.seasonTitle: When the Apocalypse Came, I Raised Zombies in My Dorm

314535.title: My Great-Grandfather, Peerless and Radiant
314535.evaluate: The young woman A'rao's father was captured by Princess Zhao Hua to serve as her male consort and was tortured to death; her mother was also beaten to death in the street while blocking a palanquin to cry for justice. A'rao sells herself into the princess's mansion as a maidservant, waiting for a chance at revenge. She meets a mysterious, beautiful man named Qing Yang—who turns out to be her own great-grandfather, also here for revenge. The two team up, first plotting to eliminate the princess's accomplice, the male consort Zhu Shanling, then using a borrowed knife to turn the capital magistrate Zhang Cheng against the princess. Finally, Qing Yang uses a specially made incense to make the princess mentally unstable, causing her to go mad in public at a palace banquet and be imprisoned, then personally ends her life with white silk. After their great revenge is achieved, the great-grandfather and granddaughter leave side by side.

314536.title: My Brother, Born with Irresistible Charm
314536.evaluate: Song Ziling dies in childbirth bearing the child of Prince Xiao, Ji Yunxiao. The Song family is then framed for treason and massacred, leaving only sister Song Wan and reclusive brother Song Mo'an to escape. To avenge them, Song Mo'an approaches Crown Princess Ji Tinglan, who is obsessed with him, and uses her influence to lay plans. Song Wan disguises herself and infiltrates Prince Xiao's mansion to seek revenge. Together they expose Ji Yunxiao's conspiracy with Qiang spy Qiao Yin to embezzle military funds and seize the throne. After palace coups, wars, and life-or-death trials, Song Mo'an and Ji Tinglan gradually fall in love. In the end, the rebellion is quelled and their names are cleared. The new emperor ascends and dotes solely on Song Mo'an; Song Wan kills her enemy with her own hands, and peace prevails throughout the land.
314536.seasonTitle: My Brother, Born with Irresistible Charm

314537.title: Tales from the Journey West: Marshal Tianpeng Descends to Earth
314537.evaluate: Breaking away from the traditional Journey to the West framework, this story follows his rise and heartwarming bonds after being banished to the mortal realm. Once a glorious Marshal Tianpeng, his arrogance and obsession with fame led to disaster, and he was stripped of his immortal powers and cast down to earth. After his fall, he still clings to past glory, putting on a show of bravado while stumbling again and again. Mocked by others, targeted by a vengeful fox spirit, and even arrested after charging the Southern Heavenly Gate, he experiences the full bitterness of life.\n\nAt his lowest point, Bajie receives guidance from a wise benefactor and finally awakens. He lets go of his vanity, trains with real dedication, gradually regains his strength, and learns humility and responsibility. He fights back against the fox spirit, clears up misunderstandings with the villagers, earns the understanding of the heavenly court, and completes his redemption. Gao Cuilan, the discerning daughter of the Gao family, never values empty fame. At first she feels only aversion toward Bajie, but is eventually moved by his perseverance and transformation, quietly supporting him through his hardest days. The two grow from distant strangers into people who deeply care for each other. Centered on letting go of obsession and achieving personal growth, the drama blends comedy with warmth, giving Zhu Bajie a more vivid character arc and delivering a message of growth and kindness.
314537.seasonTitle: Tales from the Journey West: Marshal Tianpeng Descends to Earth

314539.title: The Two of Them
314539.evaluate:
Chen Siyue, president of a listed film and television group, comes from a prestigious family but has risen to power through her own exceptional abilities. Coldly glamorous and formidable, she is widely recognized as a powerhouse businesswoman in the industry. Her young assistant, Wu Tian, though junior in age, is sharp-minded and strategically brilliant, always devising plans to resolve crises for the group and becoming Chen Siyue's most trusted right hand.

After a major upheaval, Chen Siyue falls into an unprecedented low point and sinks into despair. In desperation, Wu Tian's drastic action unexpectedly jolts her back to her senses, subtly shifting their previously purely professional relationship. Through long-term partnership and unwavering loyalty in times of crisis, the habitually dominant Chen Siyue gradually develops an indescribable dependence and attraction toward the composed and decisive Wu Tian.

As workplace power struggles, hidden agendas, and mysteries of identity emerge one after another, Wu Tian remains steadfastly by Chen Siyue's side, using wisdom as a blade to clear the storms ahead. Amid repeated tests and emotional push-and-pull, their feelings quietly blossom. Through restraint and perseverance, their hearts connect as they face the treacherous business world and secrets of the past together, unfolding a deeply bonded story of mutual salvation and intense emotional tension.

314540.title: Hatred in the Noble Mansion: The Reborn Daughter Kills Her Way to the Top
314540.evaluate: In her previous life, Shen Li, daughter of the richest merchant in Jiangnan, married into the declining Jian'an Marquis household with a grand dowry and immense wealth. She gave up her business talents to devote herself to her husband Gu Qingzhou, pouring her fortune into his career. Yet her deep devotion was repaid with the cruelest betrayal. Gu Qingzhou not only used her dowry to cover family debts and bribe officials, but also carried on an affair with his dependent cousin Liu Rushuang. When Shen Li was secretly given a sterility drug by Liu Rushuang and lay bedridden, she was met with a cup of poisoned wine forced on her by Gu Qingzhou. As she died, she watched the treacherous pair seize her wealth and take her life. A thunderbolt strikes, and heaven has eyes! When she opens her eyes again, Shen Li is reborn into the third month of her marriage — the very day Gu Qingzhou comes bearing bird's nest soup, trying to sweet-talk her into handing over control of her dowry. This life, the virtuous noble wife is dead, and a vengeful demon crawled back from hell has awakened. Facing the vampire-like Gu family, Shen Li no longer endures. She strikes with thunderous force. They want household power? She summons twenty accountants to audit the books in public, tears apart corrupt stewards, and grips the marquis household's finances firmly in her own hands. They want to live off her? She cuts off all funding to the Gu family, serving plain vegetables and tofu every day, forcing the self-proclaimed upright Gu Qingzhou to desperation, signing high-interest underground loans. They try to frame her with witchcraft? She turns the plot around, bribes the shaman to expose the scheme publicly, making the scheming cousin a target of public disgrace. When Gu Qingzhou and Liu Rushuang are driven into a corner and attempt to drug Shen Li to ruin her reputation at the old matriarch's birthday banquet and swallow her fortune, Shen Li coldly sets an intricate trap. Swapping the plan and kic...
314540.seasonTitle: Hatred in the Noble Mansion: The Reborn Daughter Kills Her Way to the Top

314541.title: The Gummy Brothers
314541.evaluate: Su Wanqing loses her family and is left drowning in debt overnight. With nowhere else to turn, she seeks out Chen Mo, a childhood friend she has always clashed with. Back then they bickered constantly; now he is a rising business mogul with capital in hand, while she has nothing but her ruined pride. Looking at the once-spoiled young lady now fallen so low, Chen Mo says coldly, "You want to settle the debt? Fine. Give me a child, and the debt is cleared." Humiliated and furious, Su Wanqing is forced to accept in her desperate situation. Living under the same roof, the former rivals now see each other day and night, and amid their constant clashes, unexpected feelings begin to grow. Chen Mo seems domineering and harsh, yet secretly clears away her troubles and protects her; Su Wanqing thinks it is only a transaction, but finds herself moved by his quiet tenderness. As the truth behind the debt and old family grudges surface one by one, she finally learns that this relationship that began as debt repayment has long concealed his unspoken love for many years. The two overcome misunderstandings and obstacles, turning a contractual companionship into a lifelong bond of true love.

314542.title: Destined Martial God: I Defy Fate to Command the World
314542.evaluate: Su Yu accidentally transmigrates into a novel and becomes the young master of the Su family, a villain clan destined to be destroyed by the heaven-chosen protagonist Chu Feng in a high-martial urban world. At the very start, he runs into the original owner groveling to propose to Jiang Wanyue, only to be publicly humiliated and have the engagement broken. He decisively slaps back, withdraws the betrothal gifts, and publicly annuls the engagement himself, completely tearing off all pretense and activating the Villain of Destiny System. Step by step, Su Yu steals Chu Feng's opportunities, frames him for murdering his master, helps his father become a Human Sovereign, and leads the Su family to rise. Along the way, he relentlessly slaps down Jiang Wanyue and Chu Feng, reverses his family's doomed fate, and rises from cannon-fodder villain to the strongest villain who rules heaven and earth, turning the heaven-chosen protagonist into nothing more than a stepping stone on his path of growth.
314542.seasonTitle: Destined Martial God: I Defy Fate to Command the World

314545.title: Oh No, This Villain Was Raised by the Heroine! Even the Male Lead Is Stunned
314545.evaluate: After dying from staying up too late, I transmigrated into a clichéd novel as Chen Yu, a rich second-generation heir ruined by a scheming goddess and the system-backed male lead. Awakening a crazy system designed to deal with scumbags and scheming women, I immediately refuse to pay for Liu Ruyan, clean out the Liu family parasites in the company, publicly expose her affair with Chu Feng, and completely cancel the engagement. I forcefully reclaim the group's shares, intercept Chu Feng's investment opportunities, poach his key subordinates, and crush the male lead who has a god-tier investment system step by step. From a doormat to a domineering power player, I swear to protect the family business, make those scumbags pay, and rise to the top of the business world.
314545.seasonTitle: Oh No, This Villain Was Raised by the Heroine! Even the Male Lead Is Stunned

314546.title: Deep Space Ruins: My Warship Can Devour Stars
314546.evaluate: Scavenger Lin Xinghe accidentally activates an ancient civilization's ultimate warship in space ruins—the Star Devourer. From then on, this bottom-tier young man who made a living picking through junk embarks on a counterattack, devouring stars and crushing empires. From being hunted by the Black Skull pirates to blasting an entire fleet apart with one shot, from charging alone into the Imperial patrol camp to tearing apart a thirty-meter heavy mech with his bare hands, Lin Xinghe proves with absolute power that before the universe, an empire is nothing but an ant. When the emperor parasitized by the insect swarm attempts to sacrifice the entire galaxy in the name of immortality, Lin Xinghe pilots the Star Devourer, evolved into a Bermuda-class interstellar fortress, in the ultimate showdown between god and false god. Refusing the throne and heading for the origin abyss of the gods—his era has only just begun.
314546.seasonTitle: Deep Space Ruins: My Warship Can Devour Stars

314547.title: Top-Tier Sword Cultivator: Founding a Sect in the Apocalypse
314547.evaluate: Ming Chen, a top-tier sword cultivator from the cultivation world, is struck by a heavenly tribulation while attempting to break through to the Spirit Transformation stage and accidentally transmigrates into a hopeless apocalyptic world overrun by "Anomalies" and zombies. In this world devoid of spiritual energy and shrouded in black fog, Ming Chen refuses to give up. Relying on the profound heritage of the Qingyun Sect's inheritor, he begins a life of overwhelming counterattack. He treats the apocalypse as a training ground to rebuild his sect, starting with subduing an S-rank Anomaly as his servant. He then takes in a group of extraordinarily gifted disciples: the resilient girl Hua Ning with an ultimate wood spirit root, the calm team leader Wu Zhixiao with a mutated lightning spirit root, the humorous young man Zhang Yuan with an ultimate fire spirit root, and more. Ming Chen not only uses cultivation methods to purify contaminated flora and fauna and refine miraculous medicines, but also combines modern thermal weapons with cultivation spells, building an impregnable "Qingyun Sect Branch." As his strength recovers and the sect grows, his goal evolves from mere self-preservation to becoming a leader who protects humanity. Facing increasingly powerful Anomaly tides, predatory survivor bases with ill intentions, and the threat of the mastermind behind it all, the "Underworld Lord," Ming Chen leads his disciples through countless hardships, carving out hope from the ruins. The story's climax involves cross-border reinforcements from the Qingyun Sect's Enforcement Hall in the cultivation world, and Ming Chen ultimately breaking through to the Mahayana stage, slaying the Underworld Lord, and purifying the root of the apocalypse. In the end, Ming Chen not only establishes a permanent passage connecting the two worlds but, with the support of his master, Daoist Qing Song, founds the "Qingyun Enlightenment Academy," sowing the seeds of cultivation civilization on the wa...
314547.seasonTitle: Top-Tier Sword Cultivator: Founding a Sect in the Apocalypse

314548.title: Memoirs from a Psychiatric Hospital
314548.evaluate: Psychiatrist Lin Ze falls into a coma after his patient Cao Jiu jumps from a building, and his consciousness shuttles through multiple layers of dreams. At times he is a doctor witnessing strange patients and supernatural phenomena; at other times he finds himself being treated as a patient, and the boundary between reality and illusion gradually collapses. Warnings appearing in mirrors, recurring rooftop scenes, and fragmented memories with mixed identities emerge one after another. As hypnotherapy strips away layers of disguise, Lin Ze must find the only truth in his collapsing cognition: who is really the patient, and who is dreaming whose dream? A psychological mystery about self-redemption unfolds through intertwining reality and illusion.

314549.title: After My Best Friend Left, I Married Her Husband
314549.evaluate: At 48, Lin Xiuyun was once the high-profile chairwoman of Yunxiu Group. Her ex-husband Ge Erqiang was a compulsive gambler who embezzled company funds and colluded with rival Zhao Tiancheng to steal core business secrets, leading the company to bankruptcy. Lin Xiuyun fell from the top, burdened with debt and public criticism, and hid away in ordinary life, working as a housekeeper to make a living. She always remembered her late best friend, architect Wang Guilan, who was her mentor and soulmate. Wang Guilan passed away three years ago, leaving behind her husband Chen Jianguo to live alone. A talented retired design institute director, he was trapped in grief over his wife and lived in disarray. Entrusted by Wang Guilan's last wish, Lin Xiuyun entered Chen Jianguo's home as a housekeeper. Their first meeting erupted into conflict over a department store blueprint stained with coffee. The drawing was Wang Guilan's treasured work, and Chen Jianguo angrily drove Lin Xiuyun away. As they spent time together, the ice gradually thawed: Lin Xiuyun was professional, capable, gentle, and resilient; Chen Jianguo was gruff but soft-hearted, lonely and devoted. In the little moments of daily life, amid the scent of jasmine, they saw each other's true hearts and feelings quietly grew. The peace was shattered when Ge Erqiang returned, extorting money and exposing Lin Xiuyun's past as chairwoman, accusing her of scheming, which broke the relationship.
